en_def: to say that someone or something is wrong or bad, expressing disapproval
hi_nuance: In Hindi, 'आलोचना करना' and 'बुराई करना' often overlap; in English 'criticise' is fairly neutral in professional feedback (constructive criticism) rather than only harsh personal insult — 'criticise the work, not the person' is common workplace advice. Note British 'criticise' vs American 'criticize'.

examples.en: The manager criticised the report for being too long.
examples.hi: मैनेजर ने रिपोर्ट की आलोचना की क्योंकि वह बहुत लंबी थी।

examples.en: Please don't criticise him in front of the whole team.
examples.hi: कृपया पूरी टीम के सामने उसकी आलोचना मत करो।

examples.en: Critics criticised the new security policy as too strict.
examples.hi: आलोचकों ने नई सुरक्षा नीति को बहुत सख़्त बताते हुए आलोचना की।

examples.en: She was criticised for not testing the code properly.
examples.hi: कोड को ठीक से टेस्ट न करने के लिए उसकी आलोचना की गई।

examples.en: It's easy to criticise, but harder to offer solutions.
examples.hi: आलोचना करना आसान है, लेकिन समाधान देना कठिन है।

common_mistake.wrong: He criticised on my work in the meeting.
common_mistake.right: He criticised my work in the meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'criticise' is directly transitive — no preposition 'on' follows it; Hindi speakers add 'on' by analogy with 'comment on'.

cloze.sentence: The teacher ____ my essay for having too many grammar mistakes.

en_def: to respect and value someone or something greatly
hi_nuance: Hindi 'तारीफ़ करना' is used both for praising looks and for respecting qualities; 'admire' in English leans towards respect for qualities or achievements — for appearance alone, English more often says 'compliment her on her dress' than 'admire her dress'.

examples.en: I really admire how calmly she handles pressure.
examples.hi: मैं वाक़ई सराहना करता हूँ कि वह दबाव में कितनी शांति से काम लेती है।

examples.en: Everyone admires his dedication to the project.
examples.hi: हर कोई प्रोजेक्ट के प्रति उसके समर्पण की सराहना करता है।

examples.en: We stood there, admiring the view from the hill.
examples.hi: हम वहीं खड़े होकर पहाड़ी से दिखने वाले नज़ारे की प्रशंसा कर रहे थे।

examples.en: I admire the way she explained the bug to a non-technical client.
examples.hi: मुझे उसका यह तरीक़ा पसंद है कि उसने ग़ैर-तकनीकी ग्राहक को बग कितनी अच्छी तरह समझाया।

examples.en: He admires his mentor and hopes to become as skilled one day.
examples.hi: वह अपने मेंटर की प्रशंसा करता है और एक दिन उतना ही कुशल बनना चाहता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I admire to your patience.
common_mistake.right: I admire your patience.
common_mistake.why: 'admire' takes a direct object with no preposition; Hindi speakers sometimes insert 'to', translating the Hindi postposition literally.

cloze.sentence: Colleagues ____ her for staying calm during the server outage.

en_def: to succeed in finishing something or achieving a result
hi_nuance: Close to 'achieve', but 'accomplish' focuses more on completing a piece of work, while 'achieve' focuses on reaching a goal or result; both often translate to 'हासिल करना/पूरा करना' in Hindi, so learners overuse 'achieve' even for simple tasks — say 'accomplish a task', 'achieve a goal'.

examples.en: The team accomplished the migration ahead of schedule.
examples.hi: टीम ने तय समय से पहले माइग्रेशन पूरा कर लिया।

examples.en: What did you accomplish this week?
examples.hi: इस हफ़्ते आपने क्या पूरा किया?

examples.en: It feels good to accomplish something difficult.
examples.hi: किसी मुश्किल काम को पूरा करने में अच्छा महसूस होता है।

examples.en: She accomplished more in one month than most do in three.
examples.hi: उसने एक महीने में उतना काम पूरा किया जितना ज़्यादातर लोग तीन महीनों में करते हैं।

examples.en: We still have a lot to accomplish before the audit.
examples.hi: ऑडिट से पहले हमें अभी बहुत कुछ पूरा करना है।

common_mistake.wrong: I could accomplish to finish the report on time.
common_mistake.right: I managed to finish the report on time.
common_mistake.why: 'accomplish' is never followed by 'to' + verb; for 'succeeded in doing', use 'manage to' instead.

cloze.sentence: By the end of the quarter, the team had ____ all its security goals.

en_def: to work together with someone to achieve something or to help them
hi_nuance: Hindi 'सहयोग करना' can sound like doing someone a casual favour; 'cooperate' in English, especially in formal contexts like 'cooperate with the investigation', means actively working together or complying, not just helping out.

examples.en: The two teams need to cooperate to fix the outage quickly.
examples.hi: आउटेज को जल्दी ठीक करने के लिए दोनों टीमों को मिलकर काम करना होगा।

examples.en: She refused to cooperate with the auditors.
examples.hi: उसने ऑडिटरों के साथ सहयोग करने से मना कर दिया।

examples.en: If everyone cooperates, we can finish by Friday.
examples.hi: अगर सब सहयोग करें तो हम शुक्रवार तक ख़त्म कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The company promised to cooperate fully with the police investigation.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने पुलिस जांच में पूरा सहयोग करने का वादा किया।

examples.en: It's hard to cooperate with someone who never listens.
examples.hi: किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ सहयोग करना मुश्किल है जो कभी सुनता ही नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please cooperate me in this task.
common_mistake.right: Please cooperate with me on this task.
common_mistake.why: 'cooperate' is intransitive and needs 'with' before a person and 'on' before a task; Hindi speakers drop 'with' because 'सहयोग करना' behaves like a direct-object verb.

cloze.sentence: The vendor agreed to ____ with our security team during the audit.

en_def: to take someone's attention away from what they are doing
hi_nuance: Hindi 'ध्यान भटकाना' is used the same way, but Indian English learners often say 'disturb' instead of 'distract' for this meaning — 'disturb' means to interrupt or annoy, while 'distract' specifically means to pull attention away.

examples.en: Loud notifications distract me while I'm coding.
examples.hi: कोड लिखते समय तेज़ नोटिफ़िकेशन मेरा ध्यान भटका देते हैं।

examples.en: Don't distract your brother, he's studying for the exam.
examples.hi: अपने भाई का ध्यान मत भटकाओ, वह परीक्षा के लिए पढ़ रहा है।

examples.en: The phishing email used an urgent subject line to distract the user from checking the sender.
examples.hi: फ़िशिंग ईमेल ने एक अर्जेंट विषय-पंक्ति से यूज़र का ध्यान भेजने वाले की जांच से हटा दिया।

examples.en: She was distracted by her phone during the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग के दौरान उसका ध्यान फ़ोन से भटक गया।

examples.en: Try not to get distracted by minor bugs; fix the critical one first.
examples.hi: छोटे-मोटे बग से ध्यान मत भटकने दो; पहले सबसे गंभीर बग ठीक करो।

common_mistake.wrong: The noise disturbed my attention from the screen.
common_mistake.right: The noise distracted my attention from the screen.
common_mistake.why: Indian English often uses 'disturb' where English uses 'distract'; 'disturb' means to interrupt or annoy, while 'distract' means to pull attention away.

cloze.sentence: A pop-up ad ____ him just as he was about to click 'submit'.

en_def: to describe something as bigger, better, worse or more important than it really is
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers commonly say 'बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताना' for storytelling exaggeration; the English phrase 'not to exaggerate, but...' is used to soften a strong statement — a handy pattern in professional speech.

examples.en: He tends to exaggerate how long tasks take.
examples.hi: वह कामों में लगने वाले समय को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताता है।

examples.en: I'm not exaggerating — the queue was two hours long.
examples.hi: मैं बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर नहीं बोल रहा — क़तार दो घंटे लंबी थी।

examples.en: Don't exaggerate the risk in the report; give the actual numbers.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट में जोखिम को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर मत बताओ; असली आंकड़े दो।

examples.en: She exaggerated her role in the project during the interview.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू में उसने प्रोजेक्ट में अपनी भूमिका को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताया।

examples.en: News channels sometimes exaggerate small security incidents.
examples.hi: न्यूज़ चैनल कभी-कभी छोटी सुरक्षा घटनाओं को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर पेश करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Don't over-exaggerate the problem.
common_mistake.right: Don't exaggerate the problem.
common_mistake.why: 'exaggerate' already means to overstate, so adding 'over-' is redundant — a common habit among Indian English speakers used for extra emphasis.

cloze.sentence: He always ____ his achievements when talking to new clients.

en_def: to copy the way someone speaks, behaves, or does something
hi_nuance: 'नक़ल करना' in Hindi can carry a negative sense (cheating in an exam); in English 'imitate' is usually neutral or positive (children imitate parents, actors imitate voices) — for exam cheating, English uses 'copy' or 'cheat', not 'imitate'.

examples.en: Children often imitate their parents' behaviour.
examples.hi: बच्चे अक्सर अपने माता-पिता के व्यवहार की नक़ल करते हैं।

examples.en: He can imitate his boss's voice perfectly.
examples.hi: वह अपने बॉस की आवाज़ की हूबहू नक़ल कर सकता है।

examples.en: The malware imitates a legitimate system process to avoid detection.
examples.hi: यह मैलवेयर पकड़े जाने से बचने के लिए एक असली सिस्टम प्रोसेस की नक़ल करता है।

examples.en: New employees often imitate the habits of senior staff.
examples.hi: नए कर्मचारी अक्सर वरिष्ठ स्टाफ़ की आदतों की नक़ल करते हैं।

examples.en: This phishing site imitates our company's login page exactly.
examples.hi: यह फ़िशिंग साइट हमारी कंपनी के लॉगिन पेज की हूबहू नक़ल करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: He imitated in the exam and got caught.
common_mistake.right: He copied in the exam and got caught.
common_mistake.why: 'imitate' means to copy behaviour or style, not to copy answers dishonestly; Hindi 'नक़ल' is used for both, which causes this mix-up.

cloze.sentence: This fake login page was designed to ____ the bank's real website.

en_def: to fail to take care of someone or something, or to fail to do something you should do
hi_nuance: Hindi 'लापरवाही करना' (to be careless) and 'उपेक्षा करना' (to ignore) overlap; 'neglect' in English specifically means failing in a duty of care — neglect your health, neglect a duty — while general carelessness is simply 'be careless'.

examples.en: He neglected his health while working long hours.
examples.hi: वह लंबे घंटों तक काम करते हुए अपनी सेहत की उपेक्षा करता रहा।

examples.en: The team neglected to update the server patches for months.
examples.hi: टीम ने महीनों तक सर्वर पैच अपडेट करने में लापरवाही की।

examples.en: Don't neglect small warnings — they often point to bigger problems.
examples.hi: छोटी चेतावनियों की उपेक्षा मत करो — वे अक्सर बड़ी समस्याओं की ओर इशारा करती हैं।

examples.en: She felt neglected after her manager stopped giving feedback.
examples.hi: मैनेजर द्वारा फ़ीडबैक देना बंद करने के बाद उसे उपेक्षित महसूस हुआ।

examples.en: The company was fined for neglecting basic data-protection rules.
examples.hi: बुनियादी डेटा-सुरक्षा नियमों की उपेक्षा करने के लिए कंपनी पर जुर्माना लगाया गया।

common_mistake.wrong: He neglected about the report deadline.
common_mistake.right: He neglected the report deadline.
common_mistake.why: 'neglect' is directly transitive (neglect something) or takes 'to' + verb (neglect to do something) — never 'neglect about'.

cloze.sentence: If you ____ regular backups, you risk losing all your data.

en_def: to look like or be similar to someone or something
hi_nuance: Hindi 'जैसा दिखना/लगना' is often expressed with 'look like' in learner English; 'resemble' is more formal and does not need 'like' after it, unlike 'look like'.

examples.en: She resembles her mother a lot.
examples.hi: वह अपनी माँ से बहुत मिलती-जुलती है।

examples.en: This phishing email closely resembles an official bank notice.
examples.hi: यह फ़िशिंग ईमेल एक आधिकारिक बैंक नोटिस से काफ़ी मिलता-जुलता है।

examples.en: The new office layout resembles our old one in Bangalore.
examples.hi: नए ऑफ़िस का ले-आउट हमारे बैंगलोर वाले पुराने ऑफ़िस जैसा है।

examples.en: Their business model resembles that of a well-known startup.
examples.hi: उनका बिज़नेस मॉडल एक जानी-मानी स्टार्टअप कंपनी जैसा है।

examples.en: The two error messages resemble each other, which caused confusion.
examples.hi: दोनों एरर मैसेज एक-दूसरे से मिलते-जुलते हैं, जिससे भ्रम हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: This website resembles like the real one.
common_mistake.right: This website resembles the real one.
common_mistake.why: 'resemble' already means 'to look like', so adding 'like' after it is redundant — a mix-up between 'resemble' and 'look like'.

cloze.sentence: The fake invoice ____ the company's real template so closely that no one noticed.

en_def: to accept or bear something unpleasant without complaining or reacting strongly
hi_nuance: Hindi 'बर्दाश्त करना' is used the same way, but note the difference between 'tolerate' (put up with something unpleasant — tolerate noise, tolerate rudeness) and 'accept/allow' (to permit officially) — 'we do not tolerate harassment' is a strong formal statement, not just casual 'sahna'.

examples.en: I can't tolerate this kind of rude behaviour at work.
examples.hi: मैं ऑफ़िस में इस तरह के बदतमीज़ी वाले व्यवहार को बर्दाश्त नहीं कर सकता।

examples.en: The company does not tolerate any form of data misuse.
examples.hi: कंपनी डेटा के किसी भी तरह के दुरुपयोग को बर्दाश्त नहीं करती।

examples.en: She tolerated the noisy office for months before complaining.
examples.hi: उसने शिकायत करने से पहले महीनों तक शोर-शराबे वाले ऑफ़िस को सहन किया।

examples.en: We tolerate small delays, but not missed deadlines.
examples.hi: हम छोटी देरी बर्दाश्त कर लेते हैं, पर डेडलाइन मिस होना नहीं।

examples.en: He has zero tolerance for careless mistakes in production code.
examples.hi: प्रोडक्शन कोड में लापरवाही से हुई ग़लतियों के लिए उसमें बिल्कुल सहनशीलता नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: We will not tolerate to this kind of behaviour.
common_mistake.right: We will not tolerate this kind of behaviour.
common_mistake.why: 'tolerate' takes a direct object with no preposition after it; adding 'to' is a common error influenced by phrases like 'object to'.

cloze.sentence: The security team will not ____ unpatched systems on the network.

en_def: to strongly advise or encourage someone to do something
hi_nuance: Hindi 'आग्रह करना' (to request insistently) is close, but 'urge' is stronger and often used in formal or warning contexts (urge caution, urged to update passwords); it is followed by 'someone to do something', not 'that someone do'.

examples.en: The bank urged customers to change their passwords immediately.
examples.hi: बैंक ने ग्राहकों से तुरंत अपना पासवर्ड बदलने का आग्रह किया।

examples.en: I urge you to read the contract carefully before signing.
examples.hi: मैं आपसे आग्रह करता हूँ कि हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले अनुबंध ध्यान से पढ़ें।

examples.en: Doctors are urging people to get regular check-ups.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर लोगों से नियमित जांच कराने का आग्रह कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: Her manager urged her to take the promotion.
examples.hi: उसके मैनेजर ने उसे प्रमोशन लेने के लिए ज़ोर दिया।

examples.en: Security experts urge companies to enable two-factor authentication.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा विशेषज्ञ कंपनियों से टू-फ़ैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन चालू करने का आग्रह करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I urge that you should update the system.
common_mistake.right: I urge you to update the system.
common_mistake.why: 'urge' is followed by 'someone + to + verb', not by a 'that' clause with 'should', which Hindi speakers use by analogy with 'suggest that'.

cloze.sentence: The IT team ____ all employees to install the security patch today.

en_def: refusing to change your mind or way of doing things, even when it would be sensible to
hi_nuance: Hindi 'ज़िद्दी' is used for both difficult children and adults who refuse to change opinions — English 'stubborn' works the same way but is mildly negative; for a positive spin on the same trait, English uses 'persistent' or 'determined'.

examples.en: My grandfather is too stubborn to see a doctor.
examples.hi: मेरे दादा जी इतने ज़िद्दी हैं कि डॉक्टर के पास जाने को तैयार ही नहीं होते।

examples.en: He's stubborn about using the old system instead of the new one.
examples.hi: वह नए सिस्टम के बजाय पुराने सिस्टम का इस्तेमाल करने पर अड़ा रहता है।

examples.en: She remained stubborn and refused to change the password policy.
examples.hi: वह ज़िद पर अड़ी रही और पासवर्ड नीति बदलने से इनकार करती रही।

examples.en: Don't be so stubborn — sometimes it's okay to ask for help.
examples.hi: इतने ज़िद्दी मत बनो — कभी-कभी मदद मांगना ठीक होता है।

examples.en: The stubborn bug refused to go away even after three fixes.
examples.hi: यह ज़िद्दी बग तीन फ़िक्स के बाद भी ख़त्म नहीं हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: He is very stubborn for his opinion.
common_mistake.right: He is very stubborn about his opinion.
common_mistake.why: 'stubborn' pairs with 'about' when referring to a topic or issue, not 'for'; Hindi postposition patterns get carried over incorrectly.

cloze.sentence: The client was ____ and refused to accept any changes to the design.

en_def: having a strong desire to be successful, powerful, or to achieve something difficult
hi_nuance: 'महत्वाकांक्षी' is a fairly formal Hindi word, matching the register of 'ambitious'; note that 'ambitious' can describe both people (an ambitious engineer) and plans (an ambitious deadline/project) — the second sense, meaning 'difficult to achieve', is often missed by learners.

examples.en: She's very ambitious and wants to become a CTO one day.
examples.hi: वह बहुत महत्वाकांक्षी है और एक दिन सीटीओ बनना चाहती है।

examples.en: The project has an ambitious deadline of just two weeks.
examples.hi: इस प्रोजेक्ट की डेडलाइन बहुत महत्वाकांक्षी है — सिर्फ़ दो हफ़्ते।

examples.en: Ambitious employees often ask for extra responsibility.
examples.hi: महत्वाकांक्षी कर्मचारी अक्सर अतिरिक्त ज़िम्मेदारी मांगते हैं।

examples.en: It's an ambitious plan to migrate the entire system in a month.
examples.hi: पूरे सिस्टम को एक महीने में माइग्रेट करने की योजना काफ़ी महत्वाकांक्षी है।

examples.en: He is ambitious but always willing to help his team.
examples.hi: वह महत्वाकांक्षी है लेकिन हमेशा अपनी टीम की मदद करने को तैयार रहता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He has ambitious to become a manager.
common_mistake.right: He is ambitious to become a manager.
common_mistake.why: 'ambitious' is an adjective (be ambitious), while 'ambition' is the noun (have ambitions); learners confuse the two forms.

cloze.sentence: Their ____ plan to release the update in one week seems unrealistic.

en_def: firm and constant in your support for a person, organisation, or set of beliefs
hi_nuance: Hindi 'वफ़ादार' is often used for personal relationships and pets; in English business contexts, 'loyal customers' and 'loyal employees' are equally common — don't limit 'loyal' to only close personal relationships.

examples.en: He has been a loyal employee for over ten years.
examples.hi: वह दस साल से ज़्यादा समय से एक वफ़ादार कर्मचारी रहा है।

examples.en: Loyal customers get an extra discount every month.
examples.hi: वफ़ादार ग्राहकों को हर महीने अतिरिक्त छूट मिलती है।

examples.en: A good leader stays loyal to the team even in hard times.
examples.hi: एक अच्छा लीडर मुश्किल समय में भी टीम के प्रति वफ़ादार रहता है।

examples.en: She remained loyal to the company despite better offers elsewhere.
examples.hi: बेहतर ऑफ़र मिलने के बावजूद वह कंपनी के प्रति वफ़ादार बनी रही।

examples.en: His dog is fiercely loyal and never leaves his side.
examples.hi: उसका कुत्ता बेहद वफ़ादार है और उसका साथ कभी नहीं छोड़ता।

common_mistake.wrong: She is loyal with the company.
common_mistake.right: She is loyal to the company.
common_mistake.why: 'loyal' takes the preposition 'to', not 'with'; Hindi speakers sometimes use 'with' by analogy with 'साथ' (with/along).

cloze.sentence: Even after the layoffs, most employees stayed ____ to the company.

en_def: lasting or intended to last forever or for a very long time; not temporary
hi_nuance: Hindi 'स्थायी' is the direct match; in Indian workplaces, 'permanent' often refers specifically to job status (permanent employee vs. contract employee) — a very common and important usage to learn.

examples.en: After six months, she was made a permanent employee.
examples.hi: छह महीने बाद, उसे स्थायी कर्मचारी बना दिया गया।

examples.en: This is a permanent fix, not a temporary workaround.
examples.hi: यह एक स्थायी समाधान है, कोई अस्थायी उपाय नहीं।

examples.en: The damage to the file was permanent — it couldn't be recovered.
examples.hi: फ़ाइल को हुआ नुकसान स्थायी था — उसे वापस पाना संभव नहीं था।

examples.en: We're looking for a permanent solution to the server crashes.
examples.hi: हम सर्वर क्रैश की समस्या का स्थायी हल ढूंढ रहे हैं।

examples.en: He moved to Bangalore on a permanent basis last year.
examples.hi: वह पिछले साल स्थायी रूप से बैंगलोर आ गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am working here on permanent basis since two years.
common_mistake.right: I have been working here on a permanent basis for two years.
common_mistake.why: Indian English often drops the article 'a' before 'permanent basis' and uses 'since' with a duration instead of 'for'; standard English needs the article and 'for + duration'.

cloze.sentence: After the successful trial period, his contract was made ____.

en_def: far away in distance, or (of work) done from home or outside the main office
hi_nuance: The traditional Hindi sense is 'दूरस्थ' (a remote village), but in modern Indian work culture 'remote' mostly refers to work-from-home ('remote job', 'remote team') — this newer sense is now more common in daily conversation than the geographic one.

examples.en: The company now offers fully remote positions.
examples.hi: कंपनी अब पूरी तरह से रिमोट (घर से काम करने वाली) पोस्ट ऑफ़र करती है।

examples.en: They live in a remote village with no proper internet access.
examples.hi: वे एक दूरस्थ गाँव में रहते हैं जहाँ ठीक से इंटरनेट भी नहीं है।

examples.en: Our security team works remotely, spread across three countries.
examples.hi: हमारी सुरक्षा टीम रिमोट तरीक़े से काम करती है, तीन देशों में फैली हुई।

examples.en: There's a remote chance the server will recover on its own.
examples.hi: बहुत कम संभावना है कि सर्वर अपने आप ठीक हो जाएगा।

examples.en: He accessed the system through a remote connection.
examples.hi: उसने रिमोट कनेक्शन के ज़रिए सिस्टम तक पहुँच बनाई।

common_mistake.wrong: I am working from remote.
common_mistake.right: I am working remotely.
common_mistake.why: 'remote' is an adjective with the adverb form 'remotely', not a noun used with 'from'; the correct pattern is 'work remotely' or 'a remote job', not 'work from remote'.

cloze.sentence: An attacker used a ____ connection to access the server without physical access.

en_def: sometimes but not often; from time to time
hi_nuance: Hindi 'कभी-कभी' covers both 'sometimes' and 'occasionally', but 'occasionally' in English suggests something rarer and more irregular — useful for describing frequency precisely in professional writing such as incident reports.

examples.en: We occasionally work late when there's a release.
examples.hi: जब कोई रिलीज़ होता है तो हम कभी-कभी देर तक काम करते हैं।

examples.en: The server occasionally slows down during peak hours.
examples.hi: पीक आवर्स के दौरान सर्वर कभी-कभार धीमा हो जाता है।

examples.en: She occasionally travels to the Mumbai office for meetings.
examples.hi: वह मीटिंग के लिए कभी-कभी मुंबई ऑफ़िस जाती है।

examples.en: Occasionally, old backups fail to restore correctly.
examples.hi: कभी-कभार, पुराने बैकअप ठीक से रीस्टोर नहीं होते।

examples.en: He occasionally forgets to log out of shared systems.
examples.hi: वह कभी-कभी साझा सिस्टम से लॉग आउट करना भूल जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I occasionally am late for work.
common_mistake.right: I am occasionally late for work.
common_mistake.why: Adverbs of frequency like 'occasionally' usually go after the verb 'to be', not before it; Hindi word order often places the adverb earlier in the sentence.

cloze.sentence: The alert system ____ sends false warnings, so we double-check before reacting.

en_def: a way of behaving that someone usually shows, especially one that is hard to change
hi_nuance: Hindi 'प्रवृत्ति' is fairly formal; in daily speech Hindi speakers often just say 'आदत' (habit), but 'tendency' in English is a bit more neutral than 'habit', describing a pattern rather than a fixed routine.

examples.en: He has a tendency to postpone difficult conversations.
examples.hi: उसमें मुश्किल बातचीत को टालने की प्रवृत्ति है।

examples.en: There's a growing tendency to work remotely after the pandemic.
examples.hi: महामारी के बाद रिमोट तरीक़े से काम करने की प्रवृत्ति बढ़ रही है।

examples.en: The system shows a tendency to crash under heavy load.
examples.hi: यह सिस्टम भारी लोड में क्रैश होने की प्रवृत्ति दिखाता है।

examples.en: She has a tendency to double-check everything, which slows her down.
examples.hi: उसमें हर चीज़ दोबारा जांचने की आदत है, जिससे उसका काम धीमा हो जाता है।

examples.en: There is a tendency among new engineers to ignore documentation.
examples.hi: नए इंजीनियरों में दस्तावेज़ों को नज़रअंदाज़ करने की प्रवृत्ति होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: He has tendency to be late.
common_mistake.right: He has a tendency to be late.
common_mistake.why: 'tendency' is a countable noun and almost always needs the article 'a' before it; Hindi has no articles, so learners often drop it.

cloze.sentence: There is a ____ among junior developers to skip writing tests.

en_def: the opinion that people generally have about someone or something, based on past behaviour or character
hi_nuance: Hindi 'साख' is often used in financial/credit contexts, 'प्रतिष्ठा' more generally for respect and status; 'reputation' in English covers both a company's public image and a person's professional standing — 'build/damage a reputation' is a key workplace collocation.

examples.en: The company has a strong reputation for data security.
examples.hi: कंपनी की डेटा सुरक्षा के मामले में मज़बूत प्रतिष्ठा है।

examples.en: One security breach can seriously damage a company's reputation.
examples.hi: एक ही सुरक्षा उल्लंघन किसी कंपनी की प्रतिष्ठा को गंभीर रूप से नुकसान पहुँचा सकता है।

examples.en: He has earned a reputation as a careful, reliable engineer.
examples.hi: उसने एक सावधान और भरोसेमंद इंजीनियर के रूप में अपनी साख बनाई है।

examples.en: The restaurant has a good reputation for fast service.
examples.hi: इस रेस्तरां की तेज़ सेवा के लिए अच्छी प्रतिष्ठा है।

examples.en: Rumours can hurt someone's reputation even if they are false.
examples.hi: अफ़वाहें झूठी होने पर भी किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुँचा सकती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The company has good reputation in the market.
common_mistake.right: The company has a good reputation in the market.
common_mistake.why: 'reputation' is countable when describing a specific quality (a good reputation), so it needs the article 'a'; Hindi has no equivalent article to remind learners.

cloze.sentence: A single data leak can ruin a company's ____ overnight.

en_def: feeling or showing that you believe someone has done something wrong or dishonest, without proof
hi_nuance: Hindi 'संदिग्ध' describes the person or thing that causes doubt, while 'शंकालु' describes a person who doubts easily — English 'suspicious' covers both directions ('a suspicious email' and 'I'm suspicious of this email'); the preposition is 'suspicious of', not 'suspicious about', for people or things you distrust.

examples.en: Report any suspicious email to the IT security team immediately.
examples.hi: किसी भी संदिग्ध ईमेल की सूचना तुरंत आईटी सुरक्षा टीम को दें।

examples.en: The guard became suspicious when the man refused to show his ID.
examples.hi: जब उस आदमी ने अपना आईडी दिखाने से मना कर दिया तो गार्ड को शक़ हुआ।

examples.en: She was suspicious of the unusually low price of the laptop.
examples.hi: उसे लैपटॉप की असामान्य रूप से कम क़ीमत पर शक़ हुआ।

examples.en: The system flagged the login attempt as suspicious.
examples.hi: सिस्टम ने लॉगिन प्रयास को संदिग्ध बताया।

examples.en: He looked at me suspiciously when I asked about the missing files.
examples.hi: जब मैंने गायब फ़ाइलों के बारे में पूछा तो उसने मुझे शक़ भरी नज़रों से देखा।

common_mistake.wrong: I am suspicious about him since he lied once.
common_mistake.right: I am suspicious of him since he lied once.
common_mistake.why: 'suspicious' pairs with the preposition 'of' when it means distrust of a person, not 'about'; 'about' is reserved for suspicion about a situation or fact ('suspicious about the plan').

cloze.sentence: The bank called to check a ____ transaction on my card.

en_def: honest and genuine in what you say or feel, without pretending
hi_nuance: Hindi 'सच्चा/ईमानदार' is used broadly for honesty; 'sincere' in English is specifically about genuine feeling (a sincere apology, sincere thanks) rather than general honesty about facts, which is closer to 'honest' or 'truthful'.

examples.en: Please accept my sincere apologies for the delay.
examples.hi: देरी के लिए कृपया मेरी सच्चे दिल से माफ़ी स्वीकार करें।

examples.en: He gave a sincere thank-you speech at the farewell party.
examples.hi: उसने विदाई पार्टी में सच्चे दिल से धन्यवाद भाषण दिया।

examples.en: I have a sincere interest in learning about network security.
examples.hi: नेटवर्क सुरक्षा सीखने में मेरी सच्ची दिलचस्पी है।

examples.en: Her sincere concern for the team made everyone trust her.
examples.hi: टीम के लिए उसकी सच्ची चिंता ने सबका भरोसा जीत लिया।

examples.en: We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all volunteers.
examples.hi: हम सभी स्वयंसेवकों के प्रति अपना हार्दिक आभार व्यक्त करना चाहेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am sincere that I made a mistake.
common_mistake.right: I sincerely admit that I made a mistake.
common_mistake.why: 'sincere' describes feelings or statements (a sincere apology), not a fact being admitted; learners often use it where 'truly' or 'honestly' fits better.

cloze.sentence: She ended the email with a ____ apology for the confusion.

en_def: to say or do something that stops someone while they are speaking or doing something
hi_nuance: Hindi 'टोकना' is used for interrupting speech; 'interrupt' in English also applies to processes (interrupt a program, interrupt the power supply) — a technical usage security engineers use often, as in 'interrupt handler' and 'power interruption'.

examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the client is on the line.
examples.hi: बीच में टोकने के लिए माफ़ी, लेकिन क्लाइंट लाइन पर है।

examples.en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm explaining the fix.
examples.hi: जब मैं फ़िक्स समझा रहा हूँ तो कृपया मुझे मत टोकिए।

examples.en: A power interruption caused the server to restart unexpectedly.
examples.hi: बिजली में रुकावट के कारण सर्वर अचानक रीस्टार्ट हो गया।

examples.en: He kept interrupting the meeting with unrelated questions.
examples.hi: वह असंबंधित सवालों से बार-बार मीटिंग में बाधा डालता रहा।

examples.en: The alarm interrupted our conversation.
examples.hi: अलार्म ने हमारी बातचीत में बाधा डाल दी।

common_mistake.wrong: Don't interrupt in between when I am talking.
common_mistake.right: Don't interrupt me while I am talking.
common_mistake.why: 'interrupt' already means 'to break in between', so adding 'in between' is redundant; 'interrupt' also needs a direct object (interrupt someone), not just 'interrupt in'.

cloze.sentence: A brief power ____ caused the backup system to kick in automatically.

en_def: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal
hi_nuance: Hindi 'आरोप लगाना' is close, but note the English grammar pattern 'accuse someone of doing something' (with 'of', not 'for') — a very common preposition mistake for Hindi speakers.

examples.en: She accused her colleague of leaking confidential data.
examples.hi: उसने अपने सहकर्मी पर गोपनीय डेटा लीक करने का आरोप लगाया।

examples.en: He was wrongly accused of stealing the laptop.
examples.hi: उस पर ग़लत तरीक़े से लैपटॉप चुराने का आरोप लगाया गया।

examples.en: The report accuses the vendor of ignoring the security guidelines.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट में वेंडर पर सुरक्षा दिशा-निर्देशों की अनदेखी करने का आरोप लगाया गया है।

examples.en: Don't accuse anyone until we have solid evidence.
examples.hi: जब तक हमारे पास ठोस सबूत न हो, किसी पर आरोप मत लगाओ।

examples.en: She felt hurt when she was accused of being careless.
examples.hi: जब उस पर लापरवाह होने का आरोप लगा, तो उसे बुरा लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: He accused me for breaking the rule.
common_mistake.right: He accused me of breaking the rule.
common_mistake.why: 'accuse' always takes 'of' before the wrongdoing, never 'for'; Hindi speakers often use 'for' by analogy with 'blame someone for'.

cloze.sentence: The email wrongly ____ the employee of sharing passwords with outsiders.

en_def: causing embarrassment or difficulty; not smooth, comfortable, or graceful
hi_nuance: Hindi 'अजीब' often just means 'strange', but 'awkward' is more specific — it describes social discomfort (an awkward silence) or physical clumsiness (an awkward angle); 'strange' and 'awkward' are not always interchangeable.

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after he asked about the layoffs.
examples.hi: जब उसने छंटनी के बारे में पूछा तो एक असहज सन्नाटा छा गया।

examples.en: It felt awkward explaining the mistake to the whole team.
examples.hi: पूरी टीम को अपनी ग़लती समझाना असहज लगा।

examples.en: The cable was in an awkward position, hard to reach.
examples.hi: केबल एक अजीब जगह पर था, जहाँ तक पहुँचना मुश्किल था।

examples.en: Meeting my ex-manager at the client's office was quite awkward.
examples.hi: अपने पुराने मैनेजर से क्लाइंट के ऑफ़िस में मिलना काफ़ी असहज था।

examples.en: He gave an awkward smile and changed the topic.
examples.hi: उसने असहज मुस्कान दी और विषय बदल दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I felt very awkward for him.
common_mistake.right: I felt awkward around him.
common_mistake.why: 'awkward for someone' isn't standard when describing your own discomfort; use 'awkward around/with someone', and reserve 'feel sorry for' for sympathy.

cloze.sentence: There was an ____ pause when nobody knew who had deleted the file.

en_def: ready and happy to do something if needed
hi_nuance: Hindi 'तैयार' is used both for 'ready' (prepared) and 'willing' (agreeable); 'willing' in English specifically signals agreement or consent to do something and is followed by 'to' + verb — 'willing to help', not 'willing for help'.

examples.en: She's willing to work extra hours before the release.
examples.hi: वह रिलीज़ से पहले अतिरिक्त घंटे काम करने को तैयार है।

examples.en: Are you willing to relocate to another city for this job?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस नौकरी के लिए दूसरे शहर जाने को तैयार हैं?

examples.en: He wasn't willing to compromise on the design.
examples.hi: वह डिज़ाइन में समझौता करने को तैयार नहीं था।

examples.en: The vendor is willing to offer a discount for a long-term contract.
examples.hi: वेंडर लंबे अनुबंध के लिए छूट देने को तैयार है।

examples.en: I'm willing to help, but I need more information first.
examples.hi: मैं मदद करने को तैयार हूँ, लेकिन पहले मुझे और जानकारी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: I am willing for help you.
common_mistake.right: I am willing to help you.
common_mistake.why: 'willing' is always followed by 'to' + base verb, not 'for'; Hindi speakers sometimes use 'for' because of literal translation patterns.

cloze.sentence: The new intern is always ____ to stay late and learn.

en_def: not often; almost never
hi_nuance: Hindi 'शायद ही कभी' is the closest match; note 'rarely' already carries a negative meaning, so it should never be combined with 'not' ('I don't rarely go' is wrong) — a common double-negative mistake.

examples.en: He rarely checks his email after 6 pm.
examples.hi: वह शाम 6 बजे के बाद शायद ही कभी अपना ईमेल चेक करता है।

examples.en: Our production servers rarely go down these days.
examples.hi: आजकल हमारे प्रोडक्शन सर्वर शायद ही कभी डाउन होते हैं।

examples.en: She rarely misses a deadline.
examples.hi: वह शायद ही कभी कोई डेडलाइन मिस करती है।

examples.en: Such attacks are rarely reported to the police.
examples.hi: ऐसे हमलों की शिकायत पुलिस को शायद ही कभी की जाती है।

examples.en: I rarely use the office printer since I work remotely.
examples.hi: मैं रिमोट से काम करता हूँ इसलिए ऑफ़िस प्रिंटर का इस्तेमाल शायद ही कभी करता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I don't rarely go to the gym.
common_mistake.right: I rarely go to the gym.
common_mistake.why: 'rarely' is already a negative-frequency adverb, so adding 'don't' creates an incorrect double negative; Hindi negation patterns don't map the same way onto English frequency adverbs.

cloze.sentence: This kind of vulnerability is ____ found in modern systems.

en_def: the opinion or feeling you get about someone or something, especially without much thought or information
hi_nuance: Hindi 'छाप छोड़ना' (to leave a mark) matches 'make an impression'; note this 'impression' is different from 'influence' — Hindi speakers sometimes confuse 'impress' (to make someone admire you) with 'influence' (to affect someone's decisions).

examples.en: She made a great impression in her first interview.
examples.hi: उसने अपने पहले इंटरव्यू में शानदार छाप छोड़ी।

examples.en: My first impression of the new tool was that it's too complicated.
examples.hi: नए टूल के बारे में मेरी पहली धारणा यह थी कि यह बहुत जटिल है।

examples.en: He gives the impression of being very confident, even when he isn't.
examples.hi: वह बहुत आत्मविश्वासी होने का प्रभाव देता है, भले ही वह न हो।

examples.en: The presentation left a lasting impression on the clients.
examples.hi: प्रेज़ेंटेशन ने ग्राहकों पर स्थायी प्रभाव छोड़ा।

examples.en: I was under the impression that the meeting was cancelled.
examples.hi: मुझे यह धारणा थी कि मीटिंग रद्द हो गई है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have an impression that he is angry.
common_mistake.right: I get the impression that he is angry.
common_mistake.why: 'have an impression' is not the natural collocation; English uses 'get/have the impression that' with the definite article, or simply 'have a feeling that'.

cloze.sentence: My first ____ of the new security dashboard was that it's very easy to use.

en_def: official or formal agreement allowing someone to do something
hi_nuance: Hindi 'इजाज़त' is used the same way; a key technical usage for security engineers is 'file permissions' or 'access permissions' — the plural 'permissions' is common in tech contexts, unlike everyday use where it is usually uncountable.

examples.en: You need written permission to access the production database.
examples.hi: प्रोडक्शन डेटाबेस तक पहुँचने के लिए आपको लिखित अनुमति चाहिए।

examples.en: He asked for permission to leave early.
examples.hi: उसने जल्दी जाने की इजाज़त मांगी।

examples.en: The app requests permission to access your contacts.
examples.hi: यह ऐप आपके संपर्कों तक पहुँचने की अनुमति मांगता है।

examples.en: Without proper permissions, the script can't modify system files.
examples.hi: उचित परमिशन के बिना, स्क्रिप्ट सिस्टम फ़ाइलों को बदल नहीं सकती।

examples.en: She gave permission for the interview to be recorded.
examples.hi: उसने इंटरव्यू रिकॉर्ड करने की अनुमति दी।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me the permission to enter.
common_mistake.right: Give me permission to enter.
common_mistake.why: 'permission' is usually uncountable in general use, so it does not take 'the' or 'a'; learners over-apply the article from Hindi noun-marking habits.

cloze.sentence: The intern didn't have ____ to access the customer database.

en_def: information or a story that people talk about, which may or may not be true
hi_nuance: Hindi 'अफ़वाह' is a direct match. Note the British spelling 'rumour' vs American 'rumor'. 'Rumour has it that...' is a common fixed phrase worth learning for casual conversation.

examples.en: There's a rumour that the company is planning layoffs.
examples.hi: अफ़वाह है कि कंपनी छंटनी की योजना बना रही है।

examples.en: Don't spread rumours without checking the facts.
examples.hi: तथ्यों की जांच किए बिना अफ़वाहें मत फैलाओ।

examples.en: Rumour has it that we're getting a new security tool next month.
examples.hi: अफ़वाह है कि हमें अगले महीने एक नया सुरक्षा टूल मिलने वाला है।

examples.en: The rumour turned out to be completely false.
examples.hi: यह अफ़वाह पूरी तरह से झूठी निकली।

examples.en: He denied the rumours about leaving the company.
examples.hi: उसने कंपनी छोड़ने की अफ़वाहों का खंडन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I heard a rumour about that he is leaving.
common_mistake.right: I heard a rumour that he is leaving.
common_mistake.why: 'rumour that + clause' doesn't need 'about'; Hindi speakers add 'about' by analogy with 'the news about him'.

cloze.sentence: A ____ started spreading that the office would shift to a fully remote model.

en_def: careful to avoid danger or mistakes, especially by thinking ahead
hi_nuance: Hindi 'सावधान' is often used as an alert or command ('Be careful!'), while 'cautious' describes an ongoing careful attitude or approach; in security contexts, 'a cautious approach to new links' fits as well as 'a careful approach'.

examples.en: Be cautious when clicking links in unexpected emails.
examples.hi: अनपेक्षित ईमेल में लिंक पर क्लिक करते समय सतर्क रहें।

examples.en: The bank has adopted a more cautious approach to online transactions.
examples.hi: बैंक ने ऑनलाइन लेन-देन को लेकर एक अधिक सतर्क तरीक़ा अपनाया है।

examples.en: She's cautious about sharing personal information online.
examples.hi: वह ऑनलाइन निजी जानकारी साझा करने को लेकर सतर्क रहती है।

examples.en: Investors are cautious after the recent market crash.
examples.hi: हाल ही में हुए बाज़ार क्रैश के बाद निवेशक सतर्क हैं।

examples.en: Drive cautiously; the roads are wet after the rain.
examples.hi: सावधानी से गाड़ी चलाएँ; बारिश के बाद सड़कें गीली हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Be cautious for scam calls.
common_mistake.right: Be cautious about scam calls.
common_mistake.why: 'cautious' pairs with the preposition 'about' (or 'of'), not 'for'; Hindi speakers often use 'for' by analogy with 'careful for someone's safety'.

cloze.sentence: Employees are advised to be ____ about emails asking for login details.

en_def: a feeling of trust in your own abilities, or in someone or something else
hi_nuance: Hindi distinguishes 'आत्मविश्वास' (self-confidence) from 'भरोसा' (trust in others); English 'confidence' covers both — 'confidence in yourself' and 'confidence in the system' — so context decides which Hindi word fits the translation.

examples.en: Her confidence grew after she fixed the critical bug alone.
examples.hi: अकेले गंभीर बग ठीक करने के बाद उसका आत्मविश्वास बढ़ गया।

examples.en: Customers lost confidence in the company after the data breach.
examples.hi: डेटा उल्लंघन के बाद ग्राहकों का कंपनी पर भरोसा कम हो गया।

examples.en: He spoke with confidence during the security briefing.
examples.hi: उसने सुरक्षा ब्रीफ़िंग के दौरान आत्मविश्वास के साथ बात की।

examples.en: I have full confidence in the new encryption system.
examples.hi: मुझे नई एन्क्रिप्शन प्रणाली पर पूरा भरोसा है।

examples.en: Practising interviews helped build her confidence.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू का अभ्यास करने से उसका आत्मविश्वास बढ़ा।

common_mistake.wrong: I have confidence on him.
common_mistake.right: I have confidence in him.
common_mistake.why: 'confidence' takes the preposition 'in' (confidence in someone/something), not 'on'; Hindi 'पर भरोसा' literally maps to 'on', causing this mix-up.

cloze.sentence: The team's quick response restored customer ____ in the platform.

en_def: to succeed in doing or getting something after effort
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'achieve success' for everything; in English you achieve a goal, a result, a target — and 'succeed in' is more natural than 'achieve to'.

examples.en: She achieved her goal of running a marathon.
examples.hi: उसने मैराथन दौड़ने का अपना लक्ष्य हासिल किया।

examples.en: We achieved a 20% increase in sales this year.
examples.hi: इस साल हमने बिक्री में 20% की बढ़ोतरी हासिल की।

examples.en: You can achieve anything if you work hard.
examples.hi: अगर आप मेहनत करें तो कुछ भी हासिल कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The team achieved excellent results in the test.
examples.hi: टीम ने परीक्षण में बेहतरीन नतीजे हासिल किए।

examples.en: He has achieved a lot in a short time.
examples.hi: उसने थोड़े समय में बहुत कुछ हासिल किया है।

examples.en: What do you hope to achieve by complaining?
examples.hi: शिकायत करके आप क्या हासिल करना चाहते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: I want to achieve to become a manager.
common_mistake.right: I want to become a manager.
common_mistake.why: 'achieve' takes a noun object (achieve a goal), never 'achieve to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: After years of practice, he finally ____ his dream of playing professionally.

en_def: something that helps you or puts you in a better position
hi_nuance: Hindi 'फ़ायदा' covers both 'advantage' and 'benefit'; use 'advantage' when comparing options, 'benefit' for good effects. The preposition is 'advantage of', not 'advantage in' for things.

examples.en: The main advantage of living here is the short commute.
examples.hi: यहाँ रहने का मुख्य फ़ायदा छोटा सफ़र है।

examples.en: Speaking two languages is a big advantage.
examples.hi: दो भाषाएँ बोलना एक बड़ा फ़ायदा है।

examples.en: They took advantage of the discount and bought two.
examples.hi: उन्होंने छूट का फ़ायदा उठाया और दो ख़रीद लिए।

examples.en: Our team has the advantage of experience.
examples.hi: हमारी टीम को अनुभव की बढ़त हासिल है।

examples.en: Is there any advantage in waiting?
examples.hi: क्या इंतज़ार करने में कोई फ़ायदा है?

examples.en: He used his height to his advantage in basketball.
examples.hi: उसने बास्केटबॉल में अपनी लंबाई का फ़ायदा उठाया।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many advantages in this phone.
common_mistake.right: There are many advantages to this phone.
common_mistake.why: Use 'advantage to/of' for a thing; 'advantage in' is only for an activity (advantage in waiting).

cloze.sentence: One ____ of working from home is that you save money on travel.

en_def: to have an influence on someone or something; to cause a change
hi_nuance: Learners mix up 'affect' (verb) and 'effect' (noun). Hindi 'असर डालना' = affect; 'असर' = effect. Never write 'it will effect me'.

examples.en: The weather affected our travel plans.
examples.hi: मौसम ने हमारी यात्रा की योजनाओं को प्रभावित किया।

examples.en: Lack of sleep can affect your memory.
examples.hi: नींद की कमी आपकी याददाश्त पर असर डाल सकती है।

examples.en: The new law will affect thousands of workers.
examples.hi: नया क़ानून हज़ारों कर्मचारियों को प्रभावित करेगा।

examples.en: How did the news affect him?
examples.hi: उस ख़बर का उस पर क्या असर हुआ?

examples.en: The bug affects only older versions of the app.
examples.hi: यह बग सिर्फ़ ऐप के पुराने संस्करणों को प्रभावित करता है।

examples.en: Prices are affected by demand.
examples.hi: क़ीमतें माँग से प्रभावित होती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The delay will effect our schedule.
common_mistake.right: The delay will affect our schedule.
common_mistake.why: 'affect' is the verb; 'effect' is the noun (have an effect on).

cloze.sentence: The strike ____ trains across the whole country.

en_def: a decision or arrangement that two or more people accept
hi_nuance: 'सहमति' (agreeing) and 'समझौता' (a deal) are both 'agreement'. Say 'reach/come to an agreement', not 'do an agreement'.

examples.en: The two companies signed an agreement last week.
examples.hi: दोनों कंपनियों ने पिछले हफ़्ते एक समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए।

examples.en: We finally reached an agreement on the price.
examples.hi: आख़िरकार हम क़ीमत पर सहमत हो गए।

examples.en: Everyone nodded in agreement.
examples.hi: सबने सहमति में सिर हिलाया।

examples.en: There is no agreement about who should pay.
examples.hi: इस बात पर कोई सहमति नहीं है कि भुगतान कौन करे।

examples.en: The agreement ends in December.
examples.hi: यह समझौता दिसंबर में समाप्त होता है।

examples.en: Are we in agreement, then?
examples.hi: तो क्या हम सहमत हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: We did an agreement with the vendor.
common_mistake.right: We made an agreement with the vendor.
common_mistake.why: Use make/reach/sign with 'agreement', not 'do'.

cloze.sentence: After hours of talks, both sides came to an ____.

en_def: what you are trying to achieve; a purpose
hi_nuance: Indian English overuses 'aim' in the sense of ambition ('my aim in life'). In everyday English, 'goal' is more common; 'aim' as a verb + 'to' is very natural: 'we aim to finish by Friday'.

examples.en: The aim of the meeting is to fix the schedule.
examples.hi: बैठक का उद्देश्य समय-सारणी तय करना है।

examples.en: We aim to reply to every email within a day.
examples.hi: हमारा लक्ष्य हर ईमेल का जवाब एक दिन में देना है।

examples.en: Her main aim is to improve her English.
examples.hi: उसका मुख्य लक्ष्य अपनी अंग्रेज़ी सुधारना है।

examples.en: The campaign aims to raise a million rupees.
examples.hi: इस अभियान का उद्देश्य दस लाख रुपये जुटाना है।

examples.en: He aimed the camera at the bird.
examples.hi: उसने कैमरा पक्षी की ओर तान दिया।

examples.en: What is the aim of this exercise?
examples.hi: इस अभ्यास का उद्देश्य क्या है?

common_mistake.wrong: My aim is to became an engineer.
common_mistake.right: My aim is to become an engineer.
common_mistake.why: After 'to' use the base form, not the past form.

cloze.sentence: We ____ to launch the new version before the holidays.

en_def: to tell people something officially or publicly
hi_nuance: Hindi 'बताना' is often translated as 'announce' even for private news; 'announce' is for public or official news. For one person, use 'tell'.

examples.en: The company announced a new phone yesterday.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने कल एक नए फ़ोन की घोषणा की।

examples.en: They announced their engagement on Instagram.
examples.hi: उन्होंने इंस्टाग्राम पर अपनी सगाई का ऐलान किया।

examples.en: The results will be announced on Monday.
examples.hi: नतीजे सोमवार को घोषित किए जाएँगे।

examples.en: The pilot announced a short delay.
examples.hi: पायलट ने थोड़ी देरी की घोषणा की।

examples.en: She announced that she was leaving the team.
examples.hi: उसने घोषणा की कि वह टीम छोड़ रही है।

examples.en: The government has announced new tax rules.
examples.hi: सरकार ने नए कर नियमों की घोषणा की है।

common_mistake.wrong: He announced me that he got the job.
common_mistake.right: He told me that he got the job.
common_mistake.why: 'announce' does not take a person as its object; use 'tell someone' or 'announce to someone'.

cloze.sentence: The winner will be ____ at the end of the show.

en_def: happening once a year, or relating to a whole year
hi_nuance: Indian English often says 'yearly' or 'per annum' in speech; 'annual' is the normal adjective ('annual report', 'annual leave'). 'Annually' is the adverb.

examples.en: The annual report is published in March.
examples.hi: वार्षिक रिपोर्ट मार्च में प्रकाशित होती है।

examples.en: We get twenty days of annual leave.
examples.hi: हमें बीस दिन की वार्षिक छुट्टी मिलती है।

examples.en: The town holds an annual music festival.
examples.hi: शहर में हर साल एक संगीत उत्सव होता है।

examples.en: Her annual salary is about eight lakh rupees.
examples.hi: उसका सालाना वेतन लगभग आठ लाख रुपये है।

examples.en: The doctor recommends an annual check-up.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर सालाना जाँच की सलाह देते हैं।

examples.en: Membership is renewed annually.
examples.hi: सदस्यता हर साल नवीनीकृत की जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I get twenty leaves in a year.
common_mistake.right: I get twenty days of annual leave a year.
common_mistake.why: 'leave' is uncountable in English; say 'days of leave' or 'annual leave'.

cloze.sentence: Our ____ sales meeting takes place every January.

en_def: according to what you have heard or what seems true, though you are not certain
hi_def: ज़ाहिर तौर पर, सुनने में आया है कि
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'it seems' for everything; 'apparently' is the natural way to report second-hand information and often goes at the start of the sentence.

examples.en: Apparently, the meeting has been cancelled.
examples.hi: सुनने में आया है कि बैठक रद्द कर दी गई है।

examples.en: He's apparently moving to Pune next month.
examples.hi: ज़ाहिर तौर पर वह अगले महीने पुणे जा रहा है।

examples.en: Apparently it's going to rain all weekend.
examples.hi: लगता है पूरे वीकेंड बारिश होने वाली है।

examples.en: The shop was apparently closed for repairs.
examples.hi: दुकान ज़ाहिर तौर पर मरम्मत के लिए बंद थी।

examples.en: Apparently, nobody told him about the change.
examples.hi: ज़ाहिर है, किसी ने उसे बदलाव के बारे में नहीं बताया।

examples.en: She was apparently very upset about it.
examples.hi: ज़ाहिर तौर पर वह इस बात से बहुत परेशान थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Apparently I have seen him yesterday.
common_mistake.right: Apparently he was there yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'apparently' reports what you heard, not what you yourself saw; and 'have seen' cannot go with 'yesterday'.

cloze.sentence: ____, the train was delayed because of a signal failure.

en_def: to make a formal request for something such as a job; also, to be relevant to someone
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'apply for a job' (आवेदन) and 'this rule applies to you' (लागू). Hindi speakers say 'apply to the job' — it's 'apply for a job' and 'apply to a company'.

examples.en: I applied for the job online.
examples.hi: मैंने ऑनलाइन नौकरी के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: You can apply to three universities.
examples.hi: आप तीन विश्वविद्यालयों में आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The discount applies to students only.
examples.hi: यह छूट सिर्फ़ छात्रों पर लागू होती है।

examples.en: Apply the cream twice a day.
examples.hi: क्रीम दिन में दो बार लगाएँ।

examples.en: Those rules don't apply here.
examples.hi: वे नियम यहाँ लागू नहीं होते।

examples.en: Over two hundred people applied.
examples.hi: दो सौ से ज़्यादा लोगों ने आवेदन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I applied to the post of analyst.
common_mistake.right: I applied for the post of analyst.
common_mistake.why: 'apply for' + the job/thing you want; 'apply to' + the organisation.

cloze.sentence: She ____ for a visa three months before the trip.

en_def: to come near to someone or something; also, a way of dealing with a problem (noun)
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'approach someone' to mean 'ask for a favour or contact' — that is fine, but note 'approach' takes no preposition: 'approach the manager', not 'approach to the manager'.

examples.en: A man approached me and asked for directions.
examples.hi: एक आदमी मेरे पास आया और रास्ता पूछा।

examples.en: We need a different approach to this problem.
examples.hi: हमें इस समस्या के लिए एक अलग तरीक़ा चाहिए।

examples.en: Winter is approaching.
examples.hi: सर्दी नज़दीक आ रही है।

examples.en: She approached the topic carefully.
examples.hi: उसने विषय को सावधानी से उठाया।

examples.en: The deadline is fast approaching.
examples.hi: अंतिम तिथि तेज़ी से पास आ रही है।

examples.en: His approach to teaching is very practical.
examples.hi: पढ़ाने का उसका तरीक़ा बहुत व्यावहारिक है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will approach to the HR team.
common_mistake.right: I will approach the HR team.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'approach' takes a direct object; no 'to'.

cloze.sentence: As we ____ the city, the traffic got heavier.

en_def: suitable or right for a particular situation
hi_nuance: Hindi 'ठीक' is often rendered as 'proper'; 'appropriate' is the natural word for clothes, behaviour, language for a situation. The preposition is 'appropriate for/to'.

examples.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a job interview.
examples.hi: नौकरी के इंटरव्यू के लिए जींस उचित नहीं है।

examples.en: Is this film appropriate for children?
examples.hi: क्या यह फ़िल्म बच्चों के लिए उपयुक्त है?

examples.en: Please choose the appropriate option.
examples.hi: कृपया उपयुक्त विकल्प चुनें।

examples.en: It wasn't appropriate to laugh at that moment.
examples.hi: उस पल हँसना उचित नहीं था।

examples.en: We will take appropriate action.
examples.hi: हम उचित कार्रवाई करेंगे।

examples.en: Use language that is appropriate to the audience.
examples.hi: ऐसी भाषा इस्तेमाल करें जो श्रोताओं के लिए उपयुक्त हो।

common_mistake.wrong: This dress is not appropriate in the office.
common_mistake.right: This dress is not appropriate for the office.
common_mistake.why: Use 'appropriate for' + place/situation.

cloze.sentence: Shorts are not ____ clothing for a temple visit.

en_def: to plan or organise something; to put things in a particular order
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'arrange' for money ('arrange the funds') — this is fine but sounds formal. For meetings, 'arrange' is natural; 'fix a meeting' is Indian English, 'set up a meeting' is standard.

examples.en: I've arranged a meeting for Thursday.
examples.hi: मैंने गुरुवार के लिए बैठक की व्यवस्था की है।

examples.en: Can you arrange for someone to pick me up?
examples.hi: क्या आप किसी को मुझे लेने के लिए भेजने का इंतज़ाम कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
examples.hi: उसने फूलों को एक गुलदान में सजाया।

examples.en: We arranged to meet outside the station.
examples.hi: हमने स्टेशन के बाहर मिलना तय किया।

examples.en: The books are arranged by author.
examples.hi: किताबें लेखक के हिसाब से लगाई गई हैं।

examples.en: Everything has been arranged for the trip.
examples.hi: यात्रा के लिए सब इंतज़ाम हो चुका है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will arrange the meeting with him tomorrow itself.
common_mistake.right: I will arrange the meeting with him for tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'itself' for emphasis is Indian English; use 'for' + the day of the meeting.

cloze.sentence: The hotel can ____ a taxi to the airport for you.

en_def: to try to do something, especially something difficult
hi_nuance: 'attempt' is a little more formal than 'try'. Indian exam English says 'attempt the question' — that is correct. Say 'make an attempt', not 'give an attempt'.

examples.en: He attempted to climb the mountain in winter.
examples.hi: उसने सर्दियों में पहाड़ पर चढ़ने का प्रयास किया।

examples.en: This is my second attempt at the driving test.
examples.hi: यह ड्राइविंग टेस्ट का मेरा दूसरा प्रयास है।

examples.en: She made no attempt to hide her anger.
examples.hi: उसने अपना गुस्सा छिपाने की कोई कोशिश नहीं की।

examples.en: Attempt all the questions in section A.
examples.hi: खंड A के सभी प्रश्न हल करने का प्रयास करें।

examples.en: The attempt failed, but we learned a lot.
examples.hi: प्रयास असफल रहा, लेकिन हमने बहुत कुछ सीखा।

examples.en: Thieves attempted to break into the office.
examples.hi: चोरों ने दफ़्तर में घुसने की कोशिश की।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave three attempts for the exam.
common_mistake.right: I made three attempts at the exam.
common_mistake.why: 'make an attempt at' is the correct collocation.

cloze.sentence: She passed the exam on her first ____.

en_def: to go to an event, meeting, class, or place
hi_nuance: Indian English: 'attend a call' (answer the phone) and 'attend to a customer' are fine, but 'attend a meeting' takes no preposition. Also 'I attended the interview' is correct.

examples.en: About fifty people attended the workshop.
examples.hi: लगभग पचास लोग कार्यशाला में शामिल हुए।

examples.en: I couldn't attend the wedding because of work.
examples.hi: काम की वजह से मैं शादी में नहीं जा सका।

examples.en: Which school did you attend?
examples.hi: आप किस स्कूल में पढ़े थे?

examples.en: Please attend the meeting on time.
examples.hi: कृपया बैठक में समय पर उपस्थित हों।

examples.en: A nurse attended to the injured man.
examples.hi: एक नर्स ने घायल आदमी की देखभाल की।

examples.en: All staff must attend the safety training.
examples.hi: सभी कर्मचारियों को सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण में शामिल होना होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I attended to the meeting yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I attended the meeting yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'attend' + event has no preposition; 'attend to' means to deal with or look after.

cloze.sentence: Only half the class ____ the lecture on Friday.

en_def: the way you think and feel about something, shown in your behaviour
hi_nuance: In Indian English 'attitude' alone often means arrogance ('he has attitude'). In standard English you must say 'a bad attitude'; 'attitude' by itself is neutral. Preposition: attitude to/towards.

examples.en: She has a positive attitude to work.
examples.hi: काम के प्रति उसका रवैया सकारात्मक है।

examples.en: His attitude towards customers needs to change.
examples.hi: ग्राहकों के प्रति उसका रवैया बदलना चाहिए।

examples.en: I don't like your attitude.
examples.hi: मुझे तुम्हारा रवैया पसंद नहीं है।

examples.en: Attitudes to marriage have changed a lot.
examples.hi: शादी के प्रति नज़रिया बहुत बदल गया है।

examples.en: With that attitude, you'll never finish.
examples.hi: इस रवैये से तुम कभी काम पूरा नहीं कर पाओगे।

examples.en: The new manager has a relaxed attitude.
examples.hi: नए मैनेजर का रवैया आराम भरा है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is showing too much attitude these days.
common_mistake.right: He has a bad attitude these days.
common_mistake.why: 'attitude' alone is neutral in standard English; add 'bad' to mean arrogance.

cloze.sentence: A can-do ____ helps you succeed in any job.

en_def: to make someone or something come to a place or be interested
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'attract' mainly for romance; in English it is common for business: 'attract customers, attract attention, attract investment'.

examples.en: The festival attracts thousands of visitors every year.
examples.hi: यह उत्सव हर साल हज़ारों पर्यटकों को आकर्षित करता है।

examples.en: Bright colours attract bees.
examples.hi: चमकीले रंग मधुमक्खियों को आकर्षित करते हैं।

examples.en: The company needs to attract younger customers.
examples.hi: कंपनी को युवा ग्राहकों को आकर्षित करना है।

examples.en: Her speech attracted a lot of attention.
examples.hi: उसके भाषण ने बहुत ध्यान खींचा।

examples.en: What attracted you to this job?
examples.hi: आपको इस नौकरी की ओर किस चीज़ ने खींचा?

examples.en: Low prices attract more buyers.
examples.hi: कम क़ीमतें ज़्यादा ख़रीदारों को खींचती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am attracted with this offer.
common_mistake.right: I am attracted to this offer.
common_mistake.why: 'attracted to' is the fixed preposition.

cloze.sentence: Free samples are a good way to ____ new customers.

en_def: able to be used, bought, or obtained; free to meet or talk
hi_nuance: Indian English overuses 'available' for people: 'Is he available?' is fine, but 'I am not available' to mean 'I am busy' can sound cold. Note the spelling: avail-able, not 'availble'.

examples.en: Tickets are available online from Monday.
examples.hi: टिकट सोमवार से ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध होंगे।

examples.en: Is Dr Shah available this afternoon?
examples.hi: क्या डॉ. शाह आज दोपहर उपलब्ध हैं?

examples.en: The report is available in three languages.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट तीन भाषाओं में उपलब्ध है।

examples.en: There are no rooms available tonight.
examples.hi: आज रात कोई कमरा उपलब्ध नहीं है।

examples.en: I'm available for a call after two.
examples.hi: मैं दो बजे के बाद कॉल के लिए उपलब्ध हूँ।

examples.en: Make sure the data is available to everyone.
examples.hi: सुनिश्चित करें कि डेटा सभी के लिए उपलब्ध हो।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the needful and revert when you are available.
common_mistake.right: Please handle this and get back to me when you're free.
common_mistake.why: 'do the needful' and 'revert' are Indian English; 'get back to me' is standard.

cloze.sentence: The new model will be ____ in stores next week.

en_def: knowing that something exists or is happening
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers write 'I am aware about'; standard English is 'aware of' or 'aware that'. 'Kindly be aware' sounds stiff — use 'please note'.

examples.en: Are you aware of the new policy?
examples.hi: क्या आपको नई नीति की जानकारी है?

examples.en: I wasn't aware that the meeting had moved.
examples.hi: मुझे पता नहीं था कि बैठक का समय बदल गया है।

examples.en: She is well aware of the risks.
examples.hi: उसे जोखिमों की पूरी जानकारी है।

examples.en: Drivers should be aware of cyclists.
examples.hi: ड्राइवरों को साइकिल चालकों के प्रति सतर्क रहना चाहिए।

examples.en: He suddenly became aware of someone behind him.
examples.hi: उसे अचानक महसूस हुआ कि उसके पीछे कोई है।

examples.en: We are aware of the problem and are fixing it.
examples.hi: हमें समस्या की जानकारी है और हम उसे ठीक कर रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am aware about the issue.
common_mistake.right: I am aware of the issue.
common_mistake.why: 'aware of' is the correct preposition.

cloze.sentence: Please make everyone ____ of the fire exits.

en_def: a state where different things are in the correct amounts; the money in an account; steady position
hi_nuance: In India 'balance' is also used for leftover things ('give me the balance food') — standard English says 'the rest'. 'Balance' for money in the bank is correct everywhere.

examples.en: It's hard to find a balance between work and family.
examples.hi: काम और परिवार के बीच संतुलन बनाना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: He lost his balance and fell.
examples.hi: उसका संतुलन बिगड़ा और वह गिर गया।

examples.en: My account balance is low this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने मेरे खाते में बैलेंस कम है।

examples.en: You need to balance your diet.
examples.hi: आपको अपने खान-पान में संतुलन रखना चाहिए।

examples.en: The company must balance cost and quality.
examples.hi: कंपनी को लागत और गुणवत्ता में संतुलन रखना होगा।

examples.en: Can you check my balance, please?
examples.hi: क्या आप मेरा बैलेंस देख सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: Keep the balance food in the fridge.
common_mistake.right: Keep the rest of the food in the fridge.
common_mistake.why: 'balance' for leftovers is Indian English; use 'the rest' or 'the remaining'.

cloze.sentence: A good manager knows how to ____ praise and criticism.

en_def: to act in a particular way, especially towards other people
hi_nuance: Hindi 'व्यवहार करना' → 'behave', but 'behave yourself' means 'be good'. Indian English says 'he behaved badly with me'; standard is 'behaved badly towards me'.

examples.en: The children behaved well at the party.
examples.hi: पार्टी में बच्चों ने अच्छा बर्ताव किया।

examples.en: Behave yourself while I'm out.
examples.hi: मैं बाहर हूँ तब तक ठीक से रहना।

examples.en: He behaved as if nothing had happened.
examples.hi: वह ऐसे पेश आया जैसे कुछ हुआ ही न हो।

examples.en: She behaved very rudely towards the waiter.
examples.hi: उसने वेटर के साथ बहुत बदतमीज़ी से बर्ताव किया।

examples.en: The software behaves differently on older phones.
examples.hi: यह सॉफ़्टवेयर पुराने फ़ोन पर अलग तरह से काम करता है।

examples.en: Adults should know how to behave in public.
examples.hi: बड़ों को पता होना चाहिए कि सार्वजनिक जगह पर कैसे रहा जाए।

common_mistake.wrong: He behaved very badly with his colleagues.
common_mistake.right: He behaved very badly towards his colleagues.
common_mistake.why: 'behave towards' someone; 'with' is Hindi interference (के साथ).

cloze.sentence: The dog ____ perfectly during the whole journey.

en_def: a feeling that something is true or exists
hi_nuance: 'belief' (noun) vs 'believe' (verb) — the spelling differs. 'Belief in' something. Hindi 'विश्वास' is also 'trust', which in English is a different word.

examples.en: It's my belief that hard work pays off.
examples.hi: मेरा विश्वास है कि मेहनत रंग लाती है।

examples.en: She has a strong belief in education.
examples.hi: शिक्षा में उसका गहरा विश्वास है।

examples.en: Religious beliefs should be respected.
examples.hi: धार्मिक मान्यताओं का सम्मान होना चाहिए।

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind.
examples.hi: आम धारणा के विपरीत, चमगादड़ अंधे नहीं होते।

examples.en: His belief in himself never wavered.
examples.hi: ख़ुद पर उसका विश्वास कभी नहीं डगमगाया।

examples.en: The result was beyond belief.
examples.hi: नतीजा विश्वास से परे था।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a strong believe in God.
common_mistake.right: I have a strong belief in God.
common_mistake.why: 'belief' is the noun; 'believe' is the verb.

cloze.sentence: Contrary to popular ____, coffee does not dehydrate you.

en_def: a helpful or good effect; also money or extras given by an employer or government
hi_nuance: Verb pattern: 'benefit from something' or 'something benefits you'. Hindi speakers say 'get benefitted' — passive 'be benefited' is rare; use active 'benefit from'.

examples.en: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
examples.hi: नियमित व्यायाम के कई स्वास्थ्य लाभ हैं।

examples.en: The job comes with good benefits like health insurance.
examples.hi: नौकरी के साथ स्वास्थ्य बीमा जैसी अच्छी सुविधाएँ मिलती हैं।

examples.en: Who will benefit from the new road?
examples.hi: नई सड़क से किसे फ़ायदा होगा?

examples.en: The training benefited the whole team.
examples.hi: प्रशिक्षण से पूरी टीम को फ़ायदा हुआ।

examples.en: I'll give him the benefit of the doubt.
examples.hi: मैं उस पर शक न करके उसे मौक़ा दूँगा।

examples.en: The changes are for the benefit of the students.
examples.hi: ये बदलाव छात्रों के फ़ायदे के लिए हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Students will be benefitted by this scheme.
common_mistake.right: Students will benefit from this scheme.
common_mistake.why: Use the active 'benefit from'; the passive form is unnatural here.

cloze.sentence: Small businesses will ____ most from the tax cut.

en_def: to say that someone is responsible for something bad
hi_nuance: Patterns: 'blame someone for something' or 'blame something on someone'. Hindi speakers say 'blame on me' — drop 'on' when the person follows directly.

examples.en: Don't blame me for the delay.
examples.hi: देरी के लिए मुझे दोष मत दो।

examples.en: They blamed the accident on bad weather.
examples.hi: उन्होंने दुर्घटना का दोष ख़राब मौसम पर डाला।

examples.en: Who is to blame for this mess?
examples.hi: इस गड़बड़ी के लिए कौन ज़िम्मेदार है?

examples.en: I don't blame you for being angry.
examples.hi: तुम्हारे गुस्से में मैं तुम्हें गलत नहीं मानता।

examples.en: She took the blame to protect her brother.
examples.hi: उसने अपने भाई को बचाने के लिए दोष अपने ऊपर ले लिया।

examples.en: It's easy to blame others for your problems.
examples.hi: अपनी समस्याओं के लिए दूसरों को दोष देना आसान है।

common_mistake.wrong: Everyone blamed on me for the failure.
common_mistake.right: Everyone blamed me for the failure.
common_mistake.why: 'blame' + person directly; 'on' is used only in 'blame X on Y'.

cloze.sentence: You can't ____ the team for a decision the client made.

en_def: lasting only a short time; using few words
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'in short' or 'in brief' a lot; 'briefly' is the natural adverb. As a verb, 'brief someone' means give them information before a task.

examples.en: We had a brief conversation in the corridor.
examples.hi: गलियारे में हमारी थोड़ी देर बात हुई।

examples.en: Please keep your answers brief.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने जवाब संक्षिप्त रखें।

examples.en: There was a brief pause before she replied.
examples.hi: जवाब देने से पहले वह थोड़ी देर रुकी।

examples.en: The manager briefed us on the new project.
examples.hi: मैनेजर ने हमें नए प्रोजेक्ट के बारे में जानकारी दी।

examples.en: In brief, the plan didn't work.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, योजना काम नहीं आई।

examples.en: Let me explain briefly.
examples.hi: मुझे संक्षेप में समझाने दीजिए।

common_mistake.wrong: Tell me in brief about yourself.
common_mistake.right: Tell me briefly about yourself.
common_mistake.why: 'in brief' summarises at the end of a text; the adverb 'briefly' modifies the verb.

cloze.sentence: The doctor gave a ____ explanation and left.

en_def: the amount of money available for a purpose, and a plan for spending it
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'within the budget' correctly but often say 'budget is less'; natural English is 'the budget is tight' or 'we're over budget'.

examples.en: We have a budget of two lakh for the wedding.
examples.hi: शादी के लिए हमारा बजट दो लाख है।

examples.en: The project went over budget.
examples.hi: प्रोजेक्ट बजट से ज़्यादा ख़र्च में चला गया।

examples.en: They offer budget hotels near the station.
examples.hi: वे स्टेशन के पास सस्ते होटल उपलब्ध कराते हैं।

examples.en: I need to budget carefully this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने मुझे सोच-समझकर ख़र्च करना होगा।

examples.en: The marketing budget was cut by half.
examples.hi: मार्केटिंग बजट आधा कर दिया गया।

examples.en: Is this within our budget?
examples.hi: क्या यह हमारे बजट में है?

common_mistake.wrong: Our budget is very less for this trip.
common_mistake.right: Our budget is very tight for this trip.
common_mistake.why: 'very less' is not English; use 'tight', 'small', or 'limited'.

cloze.sentence: We can't hire anyone else; the ____ won't allow it.

en_def: a planned series of activities to achieve a goal, such as in politics, advertising, or social change
hi_nuance: The 'g' is silent: /kæmˈpeɪn/. Hindi speakers sometimes say 'campaigning' for canvassing door-to-door — that is correct; a 'campaign' can also be an ad campaign.

examples.en: The election campaign starts next month.
examples.hi: चुनाव अभियान अगले महीने शुरू होता है।

examples.en: They launched a campaign against plastic bags.
examples.hi: उन्होंने प्लास्टिक की थैलियों के ख़िलाफ़ मुहिम शुरू की।

examples.en: The new ad campaign was a big success.
examples.hi: नया विज्ञापन अभियान बहुत सफल रहा।

examples.en: She is campaigning for cleaner air.
examples.hi: वह स्वच्छ हवा के लिए अभियान चला रही है।

examples.en: The campaign raised money for the flood victims.
examples.hi: इस मुहिम ने बाढ़ पीड़ितों के लिए धन जुटाया।

examples.en: Volunteers joined the campaign in large numbers.
examples.hi: स्वयंसेवक बड़ी संख्या में अभियान में शामिल हुए।

common_mistake.wrong: They did a campaign for road safety.
common_mistake.right: They ran a campaign for road safety.
common_mistake.why: You run/launch/lead a campaign, not 'do' one.

cloze.sentence: The charity's ____ helped thousands of children get vaccinated.

en_def: having the ability or skill to do something
hi_nuance: 'capable of + -ing', never 'capable to'. Hindi 'काबिल' also means 'deserving', but 'capable' only means 'able'.

examples.en: She is capable of running the whole department.
examples.hi: वह पूरा विभाग चलाने में सक्षम है।

examples.en: The car is capable of 200 km/h.
examples.hi: यह कार 200 किमी/घंटा की रफ़्तार पकड़ सकती है।

examples.en: He's a very capable engineer.
examples.hi: वह बहुत काबिल इंजीनियर है।

examples.en: I didn't think he was capable of lying.
examples.hi: मुझे नहीं लगता था कि वह झूठ बोल सकता है।

examples.en: We need capable people in this team.
examples.hi: हमें इस टीम में सक्षम लोग चाहिए।

examples.en: Are you capable of handling this alone?
examples.hi: क्या तुम इसे अकेले संभाल सकते हो?

common_mistake.wrong: He is capable to do this job.
common_mistake.right: He is capable of doing this job.
common_mistake.why: 'capable of' + -ing is the fixed pattern.

cloze.sentence: The new server is ____ of handling ten times more traffic.

en_def: the series of jobs a person has in a particular area of work over their life
hi_nuance: Stress is on the second syllable: ca-REER. Hindi speakers say 'career' for a single job; a career is your whole working life in a field. Also 'career' ≠ 'carrier'.

examples.en: She has had a long career in banking.
examples.hi: बैंकिंग में उसका लंबा करियर रहा है।

examples.en: He wants a career in cybersecurity.
examples.hi: वह साइबर सुरक्षा में करियर बनाना चाहता है।

examples.en: This course could help your career.
examples.hi: यह कोर्स आपके करियर में मदद कर सकता है।

examples.en: After ten years, he changed careers.
examples.hi: दस साल बाद उसने अपना पेशा बदल लिया।

examples.en: She reached the top of her career at forty.
examples.hi: चालीस की उम्र में वह अपने करियर के शिखर पर पहुँची।

examples.en: Do you have any career advice for graduates?
examples.hi: क्या स्नातकों के लिए आपके पास करियर की कोई सलाह है?

common_mistake.wrong: I want to do career in IT.
common_mistake.right: I want to have a career in IT.
common_mistake.why: You 'have/build/pursue a career', with the article 'a'.

cloze.sentence: He began his ____ as a junior developer in 2015.

en_def: something difficult that tests your ability; also, to question whether something is right
hi_nuance: Positive tone: a 'challenge' is a difficulty you can rise to, so it is common in job interviews ('I enjoy a challenge'). 'Challenging' = difficult but interesting, not just 'hard'.

examples.en: Learning a new language is a real challenge.
examples.hi: नई भाषा सीखना एक असली चुनौती है।

examples.en: The biggest challenge was finding good staff.
examples.hi: सबसे बड़ी चुनौती अच्छे कर्मचारी ढूँढ़ना थी।

examples.en: She challenged the decision in court.
examples.hi: उसने अदालत में उस फ़ैसले को चुनौती दी।

examples.en: I'm looking for a more challenging role.
examples.hi: मैं ज़्यादा चुनौतीपूर्ण भूमिका की तलाश में हूँ।

examples.en: He challenged me to a game of chess.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे शतरंज खेलने की चुनौती दी।

examples.en: We faced many challenges during the move.
examples.hi: घर बदलने के दौरान हमें कई चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ा।

common_mistake.wrong: This project was very challengeable.
common_mistake.right: This project was very challenging.
common_mistake.why: The adjective is 'challenging'.

cloze.sentence: Working with a remote team is a ____, but it can be done.

en_def: the qualities that make a person who they are; also a person in a story, or a letter/symbol
hi_nuance: In Indian English 'character' often means moral reputation ('character certificate'); in everyday English it means personality. A 'character' can also be an eccentric person ('he's a real character').

examples.en: She has a strong character.
examples.hi: उसका चरित्र मज़बूत है।

examples.en: The main character in the film is a detective.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म का मुख्य पात्र एक जासूस है।

examples.en: Passwords must contain at least eight characters.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड में कम से कम आठ अक्षर होने चाहिए।

examples.en: Living abroad builds character.
examples.hi: विदेश में रहने से व्यक्तित्व मज़बूत होता है।

examples.en: The old town has a lot of character.
examples.hi: पुराने शहर की अपनी अलग ही ख़ासियत है।

examples.en: It's out of character for him to be late.
examples.hi: देर से आना उसके स्वभाव के ख़िलाफ़ है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very characterful man.
common_mistake.right: He is a man of strong character.
common_mistake.why: 'characterful' is rare; use 'of strong character' or 'has a strong character'.

cloze.sentence: Every ____ in the novel has a secret.

en_def: to say something is true, though it may not be; to ask for something you have a right to
hi_nuance: 'claim' suggests doubt: 'he claims he was ill' means you may not believe him. Don't use it for facts you accept. Insurance and expense 'claims' are the noun sense.

examples.en: He claims he never received the email.
examples.hi: उसका दावा है कि उसे ईमेल कभी मिला ही नहीं।

examples.en: You can claim your travel expenses.
examples.hi: आप अपने यात्रा ख़र्च का दावा कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The company claims its product is the fastest.
examples.hi: कंपनी दावा करती है कि उसका उत्पाद सबसे तेज़ है।

examples.en: Nobody has claimed the lost bag.
examples.hi: खोए हुए बैग को लेने कोई नहीं आया।

examples.en: She made an insurance claim after the accident.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना के बाद उसने बीमा का दावा किया।

examples.en: The flood claimed dozens of lives.
examples.hi: बाढ़ ने दर्जनों लोगों की जान ले ली।

common_mistake.wrong: The report claims that the server crashed at 3 pm, which we confirmed in the logs.
common_mistake.right: The report states that the server crashed at 3 pm, which we confirmed in the logs.
common_mistake.why: 'claim' implies doubt; for verified facts use 'state' or 'report'.

cloze.sentence: The seller ____ the phone was brand new, but it was clearly used.

en_def: a written or spoken opinion or remark about something
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'pass a comment' (Indian English for making a remark, often rude). Standard: 'make a comment' or 'comment on'. 'No comment' is a fixed phrase for refusing to speak.

examples.en: She made a helpful comment on my essay.
examples.hi: उसने मेरे निबंध पर एक उपयोगी टिप्पणी की।
