examples.en: He refused to comment on the rumours.
examples.hi: उसने अफ़वाहों पर टिप्पणी करने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: The video got thousands of comments.
examples.hi: वीडियो पर हज़ारों कमेंट आए।

examples.en: Do you have any comments on the proposal?
examples.hi: क्या प्रस्ताव पर आपकी कोई टिप्पणी है?

examples.en: Please leave your comments below.
examples.hi: कृपया नीचे अपनी प्रतिक्रिया दें।

examples.en: 'No comment,' said the minister.
examples.hi: 'कोई टिप्पणी नहीं,' मंत्री ने कहा।

common_mistake.wrong: He passed a comment about my dress.
common_mistake.right: He made a comment about my dress.
common_mistake.why: 'pass a comment' is Indian English; use 'make a comment' or 'comment on'.

cloze.sentence: The manager asked everyone to ____ on the draft by Friday.

en_def: to do something wrong or illegal; to promise firmly to do something
hi_nuance: Two senses: 'commit a crime' (negative) and 'commit to a plan' (promise). Indian English uses 'committed' for 'promised' ('I have committed to him') — correct, but 'commit to' always needs 'to'.

examples.en: He committed a serious crime.
examples.hi: उसने एक गंभीर अपराध किया।

examples.en: We are committed to finishing on time.
examples.hi: हम समय पर काम पूरा करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध हैं।

examples.en: I can't commit to a date yet.
examples.hi: मैं अभी किसी तारीख़ का वादा नहीं कर सकता।

examples.en: She committed the whole poem to memory.
examples.hi: उसने पूरी कविता याद कर ली।

examples.en: Don't commit to more than you can deliver.
examples.hi: जितना कर सकते हो उससे ज़्यादा का वादा मत करो।

examples.en: Remember to commit your code before you leave.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले अपना कोड कमिट करना याद रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: I have committed him that I will finish today.
common_mistake.right: I have committed to finishing today.
common_mistake.why: 'commit' + 'to' + -ing; you don't commit a person.

cloze.sentence: The company has ____ to reducing waste by 30%.

en_def: to share information, ideas, or feelings with others
hi_nuance: 'communicate with' someone; 'communicate something to' someone. Indian corporate English often says 'communicate him' — a person needs 'to' or 'with'.

examples.en: We communicate mostly by email.
examples.hi: हम ज़्यादातर ईमेल से संवाद करते हैं।

examples.en: She communicates well with clients.
examples.hi: वह ग्राहकों के साथ अच्छे से बात करती है।

examples.en: Please communicate the changes to your team.
examples.hi: कृपया बदलाव अपनी टीम को बताएँ।

examples.en: Babies communicate by crying.
examples.hi: बच्चे रोकर अपनी बात बताते हैं।

examples.en: The two systems can't communicate with each other.
examples.hi: दोनों सिस्टम एक-दूसरे से संवाद नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: Good leaders communicate clearly.
examples.hi: अच्छे नेता स्पष्ट रूप से बात करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please communicate him the new timings.
common_mistake.right: Please communicate the new timings to him.
common_mistake.why: The thing is the object; the person takes 'to'.

cloze.sentence: It's hard to ____ when half the team is in another time zone.

en_def: the people living in one area, or a group sharing an interest, religion, or profession
hi_nuance: In India 'community' often means caste or religious group. In English it is broader: the local community, the developer community, the online community.

examples.en: The whole community came together after the flood.
examples.hi: बाढ़ के बाद पूरा समुदाय एकजुट हो गया।

examples.en: There's a big Gujarati community in Leicester.
examples.hi: लेस्टर में एक बड़ा गुजराती समुदाय है।

examples.en: The open-source community fixed the bug quickly.
examples.hi: ओपन-सोर्स समुदाय ने बग जल्दी ठीक कर दिया।

examples.en: The new park will benefit the local community.
examples.hi: नए पार्क से स्थानीय समुदाय को फ़ायदा होगा।

examples.en: She works at the community centre.
examples.hi: वह सामुदायिक केंद्र में काम करती है।

examples.en: A sense of community is important in a village.
examples.hi: गाँव में सामुदायिक भावना ज़रूरी है।

common_mistake.wrong: Which community you belong to?
common_mistake.right: Which community do you belong to?
common_mistake.why: Questions need the auxiliary 'do'; this question is also often too personal in Western contexts.

cloze.sentence: The library is the heart of our ____.

en_def: to look at two or more things to see how they are similar or different
hi_nuance: 'compare X with Y' (find differences) or 'compare X to Y' (say X is like Y). 'Compared to' / 'in comparison with'. Hindi speakers say 'compare between' — drop 'between'.

examples.en: Compare the two phones before you buy.
examples.hi: ख़रीदने से पहले दोनों फ़ोन की तुलना करें।

examples.en: Compared to last year, sales are up.
examples.hi: पिछले साल की तुलना में बिक्री बढ़ी है।

examples.en: Don't compare yourself with others.
examples.hi: ख़ुद की तुलना दूसरों से मत करो।

examples.en: She compared the city to a beehive.
examples.hi: उसने शहर की तुलना मधुमक्खी के छत्ते से की।

examples.en: My problems are small compared with his.
examples.hi: उसकी तुलना में मेरी समस्याएँ छोटी हैं।

examples.en: Let's compare prices online.
examples.hi: चलो ऑनलाइन क़ीमतों की तुलना करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's compare between the two options.
common_mistake.right: Let's compare the two options.
common_mistake.why: 'compare' takes the objects directly; 'between' is not used.

cloze.sentence: The report ____ the cost of living in five cities.

en_def: to give all your attention to something
hi_nuance: 'concentrate on', never 'concentrate in' or 'concentrate at'. Hindi 'ध्यान देना' is also 'pay attention to', which is more for listening; 'concentrate' is for mental effort.

examples.en: I can't concentrate with the TV on.
examples.hi: टीवी चालू होने पर मैं ध्यान नहीं लगा पाता।

examples.en: Concentrate on your breathing.
examples.hi: अपनी साँसों पर ध्यान लगाओ।

examples.en: We should concentrate on the main problem first.
examples.hi: हमें पहले मुख्य समस्या पर ध्यान देना चाहिए।

examples.en: She found it hard to concentrate after lunch.
examples.hi: दोपहर के खाने के बाद उसे ध्यान लगाना मुश्किल लगा।

examples.en: Most of the jobs are concentrated in big cities.
examples.hi: ज़्यादातर नौकरियाँ बड़े शहरों में केंद्रित हैं।

examples.en: Let me concentrate; this is tricky.
examples.hi: मुझे ध्यान लगाने दो; यह पेचीदा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please concentrate in your studies.
common_mistake.right: Please concentrate on your studies.
common_mistake.why: 'concentrate on' is the fixed preposition.

cloze.sentence: It's hard to ____ when people keep interrupting.

en_def: a feeling of worry; something that matters to you; (verb) to involve or worry someone
hi_nuance: 'concerned about' = worried; 'concerned with' = involved in. Indian English 'concerned person/department' means the relevant one — correct but formal. 'To whom it may concern' is a letter opener.

examples.en: Parents expressed concern about safety.
examples.hi: अभिभावकों ने सुरक्षा को लेकर चिंता जताई।

examples.en: I'm concerned about his health.
examples.hi: मुझे उसकी सेहत की चिंता है।

examples.en: That's none of your concern.
examples.hi: यह तुम्हारा मामला नहीं है।

examples.en: This report concerns the security audit.
examples.hi: यह रिपोर्ट सुरक्षा ऑडिट से संबंधित है।

examples.en: Please contact the person concerned.
examples.hi: कृपया संबंधित व्यक्ति से संपर्क करें।

examples.en: Our main concern is cost.
examples.hi: हमारी मुख्य चिंता लागत है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am concerned with the deadline.
common_mistake.right: I am concerned about the deadline.
common_mistake.why: 'concerned about' = worried; 'concerned with' means involved in.

cloze.sentence: Doctors have raised ____ about the new drug's side effects.

en_def: the state something is in; a rule that must be accepted; a health problem
hi_nuance: Three senses: 'in good condition' (state), 'on one condition' (शर्त), 'a heart condition' (illness). Hindi speakers use 'condition' for weather — say 'weather conditions' (plural) or just 'weather'.

examples.en: The car is in excellent condition.
examples.hi: कार बहुत अच्छी हालत में है।

examples.en: I'll help you on one condition.
examples.hi: मैं एक शर्त पर तुम्हारी मदद करूँगा।

examples.en: She has a heart condition.
examples.hi: उसे दिल की बीमारी है।

examples.en: Working conditions have improved a lot.
examples.hi: काम करने की परिस्थितियाँ काफ़ी सुधरी हैं।

examples.en: Driving conditions were dangerous after the storm.
examples.hi: तूफ़ान के बाद गाड़ी चलाने की स्थिति ख़तरनाक थी।

examples.en: Read the terms and conditions carefully.
examples.hi: नियम और शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़ें।

common_mistake.wrong: The condition of the weather is very bad today.
common_mistake.right: The weather is very bad today.
common_mistake.why: 'condition of the weather' is Hindi-style (मौसम की हालत); English just says 'the weather'.

cloze.sentence: The flat was in poor ____ when we moved in.

en_def: to say or show that something is definitely true or arranged
hi_nuance: Indian English: 'please confirm the same' (over-formal). Say 'please confirm' or 'please confirm that…'. 'Confirmed ticket' is Indian Railways English but understood.

examples.en: Please confirm your booking by email.
examples.hi: कृपया ईमेल से अपनी बुकिंग की पुष्टि करें।

examples.en: The tests confirmed the diagnosis.
examples.hi: जाँचों ने निदान की पुष्टि की।

examples.en: Can you confirm that you received the file?
examples.hi: क्या आप पुष्टि कर सकते हैं कि आपको फ़ाइल मिल गई?

examples.en: The date hasn't been confirmed yet.
examples.hi: तारीख़ अभी पक्की नहीं हुई है।

examples.en: She confirmed she would attend.
examples.hi: उसने पुष्टि की कि वह आएगी।

examples.en: The logs confirm the attack came from outside.
examples.hi: लॉग पुष्टि करते हैं कि हमला बाहर से हुआ था।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly confirm the same at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Please confirm as soon as possible.
common_mistake.why: 'the same' and 'at the earliest' are Indian bureaucratic English.

cloze.sentence: The airline ____ my seat by text message.

en_def: to make someone unable to think clearly; to mix up two things
hi_nuance: 'I am confused' (feeling) vs 'it is confusing' (thing). Hindi speakers say 'I am confusing' to mean they feel confused — that means you confuse others! 'Confuse X with Y' = mix up.

examples.en: The instructions confused everyone.
examples.hi: निर्देशों ने सबको उलझन में डाल दिया।

examples.en: I always confuse him with his brother.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा उसे उसके भाई से गड़बड़ा देता हूँ।

examples.en: Don't confuse being busy with being productive.
examples.hi: व्यस्त रहने को उत्पादक होने से मत मिलाओ।

examples.en: I'm confused about which form to fill in.
examples.hi: मुझे उलझन है कि कौन-सा फ़ॉर्म भरूँ।

examples.en: The map was so confusing that we got lost.
examples.hi: नक़्शा इतना उलझा हुआ था कि हम रास्ता भटक गए।

examples.en: Too many options confuse customers.
examples.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा विकल्प ग्राहकों को भ्रमित करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am confusing about the timings.
common_mistake.right: I am confused about the timings.
common_mistake.why: 'confused' describes how you feel; 'confusing' describes the thing that causes it.

cloze.sentence: People often ____ 'affect' with 'effect'.

en_def: to be made of particular parts or things
hi_def: से बना होना, से मिलकर बना होना
hi_nuance: Always 'consist of', never passive ('is consisted of' ✗). Hindi speakers copy 'composed of' and write 'consisted of'; keep it active.

examples.en: The team consists of five engineers.
examples.hi: टीम पाँच इंजीनियरों से मिलकर बनी है।

examples.en: Breakfast consisted of tea and toast.
examples.hi: नाश्ते में चाय और टोस्ट था।

examples.en: The exam consists of three parts.
examples.hi: परीक्षा तीन भागों से बनी है।

examples.en: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.hi: पानी हाइड्रोजन और ऑक्सीजन से बना होता है।

examples.en: The course consists mainly of practical work.
examples.hi: कोर्स में मुख्य रूप से व्यावहारिक काम है।

examples.en: Her job consists of answering calls all day.
examples.hi: उसके काम में दिन भर कॉल का जवाब देना शामिल है।

common_mistake.wrong: The kit is consisted of four tools.
common_mistake.right: The kit consists of four tools.
common_mistake.why: 'consist of' is never used in the passive.

cloze.sentence: A standard deck ____ of 52 cards.

en_def: to phone, write to, or email someone
hi_nuance: 'contact' takes a direct object — 'contact me', not 'contact to me' or 'contact with me'. 'Get in touch with' and 'be in contact with' need 'with'.

examples.en: Please contact me if you have any questions.
examples.hi: अगर कोई सवाल हो तो मुझसे संपर्क करें।

examples.en: I've lost contact with my school friends.
examples.hi: मेरा अपने स्कूल के दोस्तों से संपर्क टूट गया है।

examples.en: You can contact the helpline 24 hours a day.
examples.hi: आप हेल्पलाइन से दिन के 24 घंटे संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: Are you still in contact with Priya?
examples.hi: क्या तुम अब भी प्रिया के संपर्क में हो?

examples.en: Avoid contact with the chemical.
examples.hi: इस रसायन के संपर्क से बचें।

examples.en: Her contact details are on the website.
examples.hi: उसके संपर्क विवरण वेबसाइट पर हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please contact to the HR department.
common_mistake.right: Please contact the HR department.
common_mistake.why: 'contact' + object directly; no 'to' or 'with'.

cloze.sentence: If the problem continues, ____ our support team.

en_def: a legal written agreement between people or companies
hi_nuance: Noun stress on the first syllable: CON-tract; the verb (to shrink, or to sign) stresses the second: con-TRACT. You 'sign a contract', are 'under contract', or 'on a fixed-term contract'.

examples.en: She signed a two-year contract with the company.
examples.hi: उसने कंपनी के साथ दो साल का अनुबंध किया।

examples.en: Read the contract carefully before signing.
examples.hi: हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले अनुबंध ध्यान से पढ़ें।

examples.en: He is on a temporary contract.
examples.hi: वह अस्थायी अनुबंध पर है।

examples.en: They won the contract to build the bridge.
examples.hi: उन्हें पुल बनाने का ठेका मिला।

examples.en: The contract ends in June.
examples.hi: अनुबंध जून में समाप्त होता है।

examples.en: Breaking the contract could cost you.
examples.hi: अनुबंध तोड़ना आपको महँगा पड़ सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am doing contract job in a bank.
common_mistake.right: I am doing contract work at a bank.
common_mistake.why: 'contract work' or 'a contract job' (with article); and 'at' a bank.

cloze.sentence: Under the ____, the supplier must deliver within thirty days.

en_def: to make someone believe that something is true or to do something
hi_nuance: Indian English 'convince him for the plan' → 'convince him of the plan' or 'convince him to accept the plan'. 'Convinced' = certain ('I'm convinced he's right').

examples.en: She convinced me to apply for the job.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे नौकरी के लिए आवेदन करने के लिए राज़ी किया।

examples.en: I'm convinced that we made the right choice.
examples.hi: मुझे पूरा यक़ीन है कि हमने सही चुनाव किया।

examples.en: He tried to convince his parents to let him go.
examples.hi: उसने अपने माता-पिता को जाने देने के लिए मनाने की कोशिश की।

examples.en: The evidence convinced the jury of his guilt.
examples.hi: सबूतों ने जूरी को उसके दोषी होने का विश्वास दिलाया।

examples.en: I'm not convinced by his explanation.
examples.hi: उसकी सफ़ाई से मुझे भरोसा नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: It took a lot to convince the client.
examples.hi: ग्राहक को राज़ी करने में बहुत मेहनत लगी।

common_mistake.wrong: I convinced him for joining the team.
common_mistake.right: I convinced him to join the team.
common_mistake.why: 'convince someone to' + verb, or 'convince someone of' + noun; never 'for'.

cloze.sentence: It wasn't easy to ____ my father to buy a smartphone.

en_def: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
hi_nuance: 'cope with', never 'cope up with' — 'cope up' is a very common Indian English error. 'Can't cope' = the situation is too much.

examples.en: How do you cope with stress at work?
examples.hi: आप काम के तनाव से कैसे निपटते हैं?

examples.en: She's coping well after the surgery.
examples.hi: सर्जरी के बाद वह अच्छी तरह सँभल रही है।

examples.en: The system can't cope with so many users.
examples.hi: सिस्टम इतने सारे उपयोगकर्ताओं को नहीं सँभाल सकता।

examples.en: I couldn't cope with two jobs at once.
examples.hi: मैं एक साथ दो नौकरियाँ नहीं सँभाल सकता था।

examples.en: He found it hard to cope after his wife died.
examples.hi: पत्नी की मृत्यु के बाद उसके लिए सँभलना मुश्किल था।

examples.en: Small children often cope better than we expect.
examples.hi: छोटे बच्चे अक्सर हमारी उम्मीद से बेहतर सँभल जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I can't cope up with the workload.
common_mistake.right: I can't cope with the workload.
common_mistake.why: 'cope up' does not exist; the phrase is 'cope with'.

cloze.sentence: New parents often struggle to ____ with lack of sleep.

en_def: comments that say what is wrong with something; also, careful judgement of a book, film, etc.
hi_nuance: Uncountable in general ('a lot of criticism'); 'a criticism' = one specific point. The verb is 'criticise', the person is a 'critic', the adjective 'critical'.

examples.en: The plan received a lot of criticism.
examples.hi: योजना की काफ़ी आलोचना हुई।

examples.en: She accepts criticism well.
examples.hi: वह आलोचना को अच्छे से स्वीकार करती है।

examples.en: My only criticism is that the talk was too long.
examples.hi: मेरी एकमात्र आलोचना यह है कि भाषण बहुत लंबा था।

examples.en: Constructive criticism helps you improve.
examples.hi: रचनात्मक आलोचना आपको बेहतर बनाती है।

examples.en: He faced strong criticism from the press.
examples.hi: उसे प्रेस की कड़ी आलोचना का सामना करना पड़ा।

examples.en: Don't take the criticism personally.
examples.hi: आलोचना को व्यक्तिगत रूप से मत लो।

common_mistake.wrong: He always criticises on my work.
common_mistake.right: He always criticises my work.
common_mistake.why: 'criticise' takes a direct object; no 'on'.

cloze.sentence: The new policy has come in for heavy ____ from teachers.

en_def: the way of life, art, and beliefs of a group of people; also the shared attitudes in an organisation
hi_nuance: Indian English 'cultured' means well-mannered; in English it means refined in arts. 'Culture' in companies = 'work culture'. Hindi 'सभ्यता' is 'civilisation', not 'culture'.

examples.en: Indian culture is famous for its festivals.
examples.hi: भारतीय संस्कृति अपने त्योहारों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

examples.en: The company has a friendly work culture.
examples.hi: कंपनी की कार्य-संस्कृति दोस्ताना है।

examples.en: Travelling teaches you about other cultures.
examples.hi: यात्रा आपको दूसरी संस्कृतियों के बारे में सिखाती है।

examples.en: Pop culture changes fast.
examples.hi: पॉप संस्कृति तेज़ी से बदलती है।

examples.en: There's a culture of blame in that team.
examples.hi: उस टीम में दोषारोपण की संस्कृति है।

examples.en: She grew up between two cultures.
examples.hi: वह दो संस्कृतियों के बीच पली-बढ़ी।

common_mistake.wrong: Our office has a very good culture of working.
common_mistake.right: Our office has a very good work culture.
common_mistake.why: The fixed collocation is 'work culture'.

cloze.sentence: Food is a big part of any ____.

en_def: happening or existing now
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'present' where 'current' is more natural ('present job' → 'current job'). Note: 'currently' = now, but 'actually' ≠ now (it means 'in fact').

examples.en: What is your current address?
examples.hi: आपका वर्तमान पता क्या है?

examples.en: The current situation is difficult.
examples.hi: मौजूदा स्थिति मुश्किल है।

examples.en: I'm currently working on a security project.
examples.hi: मैं इस समय एक सुरक्षा प्रोजेक्ट पर काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The current version has a known bug.
examples.hi: मौजूदा संस्करण में एक ज्ञात बग है।

examples.en: She is the current champion.
examples.hi: वह वर्तमान चैंपियन है।

examples.en: Keep your software up to date with the current release.
examples.hi: अपने सॉफ़्टवेयर को वर्तमान रिलीज़ के साथ अद्यतन रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: Actually I am working in Bangalore.
common_mistake.right: Currently I am working in Bangalore.
common_mistake.why: 'actually' means 'in fact'; for 'at the moment' use 'currently'.

cloze.sentence: Under the ____ rules, you must renew your licence every five years.

en_def: physical harm to something; (verb) to harm something
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'a lot of damage', never 'damages' (that means money paid in court). Pronounced DAM-ij, not 'da-MAGE'. People are 'hurt' or 'injured', not 'damaged'.

examples.en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
examples.hi: तूफ़ान से बहुत नुक़सान हुआ।

examples.en: Smoking damages your lungs.
examples.hi: धूम्रपान आपके फेफड़ों को नुक़सान पहुँचाता है।

examples.en: The phone was badly damaged in the fall.
examples.hi: गिरने से फ़ोन को काफ़ी नुक़सान पहुँचा।

examples.en: The scandal damaged his reputation.
examples.hi: इस घोटाले ने उसकी प्रतिष्ठा को नुक़सान पहुँचाया।

examples.en: Is the damage covered by insurance?
examples.hi: क्या यह नुक़सान बीमा से कवर होता है?

examples.en: The malware did serious damage to the network.
examples.hi: मैलवेयर ने नेटवर्क को गंभीर नुक़सान पहुँचाया।

common_mistake.wrong: The floods caused many damages to the roads.
common_mistake.right: The floods caused a lot of damage to the roads.
common_mistake.why: 'damage' is uncountable; 'damages' is a legal term for compensation.

cloze.sentence: Water can seriously ____ electronic devices.

en_def: to become smaller or less; to make something smaller
hi_nuance: Verb stress: de-CREASE; noun: DE-crease. Hindi speakers say 'the price got decreased' — just 'the price decreased' or 'was reduced'. 'Decrease in' + noun.

examples.en: Sales decreased by 10% last quarter.
examples.hi: पिछली तिमाही में बिक्री 10% घटी।

examples.en: The number of accidents has decreased.
examples.hi: दुर्घटनाओं की संख्या घटी है।

examples.en: There has been a decrease in crime.
examples.hi: अपराध में कमी आई है।

examples.en: Exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
examples.hi: व्यायाम दिल की बीमारी का जोखिम घटा सकता है।

examples.en: Temperatures will decrease overnight.
examples.hi: रात में तापमान घटेगा।

examples.en: The dosage should be decreased gradually.
examples.hi: दवा की मात्रा धीरे-धीरे घटानी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: The temperature is decreased in December.
common_mistake.right: The temperature decreases in December.
common_mistake.why: 'decrease' is used actively for things that go down; no passive needed.

cloze.sentence: Battery life ____ as the phone gets older.

en_def: without any doubt; certainly
hi_nuance: Spelled 'definitely' (not 'definately' or 'definitly'). Hindi speakers overuse 'surely' and 'confirm' — 'definitely' is the natural strong 'yes'. 'Definitely not' for strong 'no'.

examples.en: I'll definitely be there on time.
examples.hi: मैं पक्का समय पर वहाँ रहूँगा।

examples.en: This is definitely the best biryani in town.
examples.hi: यह निश्चित रूप से शहर की सबसे अच्छी बिरयानी है।

examples.en: Are you coming? Definitely!
examples.hi: क्या तुम आ रहे हो? बिल्कुल!

examples.en: It's definitely not a virus; the logs are clean.
examples.hi: यह निश्चित रूप से वायरस नहीं है; लॉग साफ़ हैं।

examples.en: We should definitely book early.
examples.hi: हमें ज़रूर जल्दी बुकिंग करनी चाहिए।

examples.en: She has definitely improved since last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल से उसमें निश्चित रूप से सुधार हुआ है।

common_mistake.wrong: Surely I will come tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I'll definitely come tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'Surely' expresses surprise or a challenge in English; use 'definitely' for certainty.

cloze.sentence: You should ____ see a doctor about that cough.

en_def: a situation where something happens later than planned; (verb) to make something late
hi_nuance: 'delay in' + noun; 'delayed by' + time. Indian English 'sorry for the delay in replying' ✓. Don't say 'the train is late by delay' — 'delayed by twenty minutes'.

examples.en: Sorry for the delay in replying.
examples.hi: जवाब देने में देरी के लिए माफ़ी।

examples.en: The flight was delayed by two hours.
examples.hi: उड़ान दो घंटे देर से थी।

examples.en: We can't delay the decision any longer.
examples.hi: हम फ़ैसले को और नहीं टाल सकते।

examples.en: There are long delays on the highway today.
examples.hi: आज हाईवे पर लंबी देरी हो रही है।

examples.en: Please report the issue without delay.
examples.hi: कृपया बिना देरी के समस्या की सूचना दें।

examples.en: The launch was delayed because of a bug.
examples.hi: एक बग की वजह से लॉन्च में देरी हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: The train is late by delay of thirty minutes.
common_mistake.right: The train is delayed by thirty minutes.
common_mistake.why: 'late' and 'delay' are not combined; use 'delayed by'.

cloze.sentence: Heavy rain caused a two-hour ____ to the match.

en_def: a strong request; the amount of something people want to buy; (verb) to ask firmly
hi_nuance: 'demand' as a verb is strong and can sound rude — don't use it for polite requests. 'In demand' = wanted. 'Demand for' + noun. Indian English 'demanding money from him' is correct.

examples.en: There is a high demand for data scientists.
examples.hi: डेटा वैज्ञानिकों की भारी माँग है।

examples.en: The workers demanded higher pay.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों ने ज़्यादा वेतन की माँग की।

examples.en: Good developers are always in demand.
examples.hi: अच्छे डेवलपर की हमेशा माँग रहती है।

examples.en: The job is demanding but rewarding.
examples.hi: नौकरी कठिन है लेकिन फ़ायदेमंद है।

examples.en: Supply can't keep up with demand.
examples.hi: आपूर्ति माँग के साथ तालमेल नहीं रख पा रही।

examples.en: She demanded to see the manager.
examples.hi: उसने मैनेजर से मिलने की माँग की।

common_mistake.wrong: I demand you to send the file today.
common_mistake.right: I need you to send the file today.
common_mistake.why: 'demand' is aggressive for everyday requests; also 'demand' + 'that', not 'demand someone to'.

cloze.sentence: There's little ____ for paper maps now that everyone has GPS.

en_def: to have earned something because of what you have done
hi_nuance: 'deserve' + noun or 'deserve to' + verb. Hindi 'हक़दार' → 'deserve', not 'have right' ('you deserve a break', not 'you have right for break'). Not used in continuous.

examples.en: You deserve a holiday after all that work.
examples.hi: इतने काम के बाद तुम छुट्टी के हक़दार हो।

examples.en: She deserved to win.
examples.hi: वह जीतने की हक़दार थी।

examples.en: He got the punishment he deserved.
examples.hi: उसे वही सज़ा मिली जिसका वह हक़दार था।

examples.en: The team deserves credit for the launch.
examples.hi: लॉन्च के लिए टीम श्रेय की हक़दार है।

examples.en: I don't deserve this kind of treatment.
examples.hi: मैं इस तरह के बर्ताव के लायक़ नहीं हूँ।

examples.en: Good work deserves good pay.
examples.hi: अच्छे काम के लिए अच्छा वेतन मिलना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: He is deserving for a promotion.
common_mistake.right: He deserves a promotion.
common_mistake.why: Use the simple verb 'deserves' + noun; 'deserving of' is very formal.

cloze.sentence: After ten years of service, she ____ a proper farewell.

en_def: feeling that you will do anything to change a very bad situation; needing something very much
hi_nuance: Spelled 'desperate' (not 'desparate'). 'Desperate for' + noun; 'desperate to' + verb. Hindi speakers use 'hopeless' where 'desperate' (still trying) fits better.

examples.en: I'm desperate for a cup of coffee.
examples.hi: मुझे कॉफ़ी की सख़्त ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: They were desperate to find a place to live.
examples.hi: वे रहने की जगह ढूँढ़ने के लिए बेताब थे।

examples.en: The situation is getting desperate.
examples.hi: हालात बेहद ख़राब होते जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: He made a desperate attempt to save the data.
examples.hi: उसने डेटा बचाने की आख़िरी कोशिश की।

examples.en: Desperate people do desperate things.
examples.hi: मजबूर लोग मजबूरी में कुछ भी कर जाते हैं।

examples.en: She was desperately trying to reach him.
examples.hi: वह उससे संपर्क करने की बेताब कोशिश कर रही थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am desparate for this job.
common_mistake.right: I am desperate for this job.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: des-per-ate.

cloze.sentence: The company is ____ to hire more security engineers.

en_def: a small individual fact or piece of information
hi_nuance: 'in detail' (not 'in details'); 'details' plural for information ('contact details'). Indian English 'give me the detail' → 'give me the details'. Hindi ब्योरा is usually plural in English.

examples.en: Please send me the details of the meeting.
examples.hi: कृपया मुझे बैठक का विवरण भेजें।

examples.en: He explained the plan in detail.
examples.hi: उसने योजना विस्तार से समझाई।

examples.en: Don't worry about the details now.
examples.hi: अभी छोटी-छोटी बातों की चिंता मत करो।

examples.en: Every detail of the design was checked.
examples.hi: डिज़ाइन के हर विवरण की जाँच की गई।

examples.en: She has an eye for detail.
examples.hi: उसकी बारीकियों पर नज़र रहती है।

examples.en: Fill in your bank details below.
examples.hi: नीचे अपने बैंक का विवरण भरें।

common_mistake.wrong: Explain the process in details.
common_mistake.right: Explain the process in detail.
common_mistake.why: The fixed phrase is 'in detail' (singular).

cloze.sentence: The report gives full ____ of every incident.

en_def: having made a firm decision and refusing to change it
hi_nuance: 'determined to' + verb. Hindi speakers use 'firm' or 'strong-minded'; 'determined' is the everyday word. The verb 'determine' means 'to find out or decide', which is different.

examples.en: She is determined to pass the exam this time.
examples.hi: वह इस बार परीक्षा पास करने के लिए दृढ़ है।

examples.en: He was determined not to give up.
examples.hi: उसने हार न मानने का पक्का इरादा किया था।

examples.en: A determined effort got the site back online.
examples.hi: दृढ़ प्रयास से साइट फिर से ऑनलाइन हो गई।

examples.en: They were determined to finish before dark.
examples.hi: वे अँधेरा होने से पहले काम पूरा करने पर अड़े थे।

examples.en: I'm determined to speak English fluently.
examples.hi: मैं धाराप्रवाह अंग्रेज़ी बोलने के लिए संकल्पित हूँ।

examples.en: You have to be determined to succeed in sport.
examples.hi: खेल में सफल होने के लिए दृढ़ निश्चय ज़रूरी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am determined for learning English.
common_mistake.right: I am determined to learn English.
common_mistake.why: 'determined to' + verb; never 'for' + -ing.

cloze.sentence: Despite the injury, he was ____ to run the race.

en_def: not as good as you hoped
hi_nuance: 'disappointing' (the thing) vs 'disappointed' (the person). Say 'I was disappointed with the result', 'the result was disappointing'. Hindi speakers swap these.

examples.en: The film was disappointing after all the hype.
examples.hi: इतने प्रचार के बाद फ़िल्म निराशाजनक थी।

examples.en: Sales figures were disappointing this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने बिक्री के आँकड़े निराशाजनक थे।

examples.en: I was disappointed with my exam results.
examples.hi: मैं अपने परीक्षा परिणाम से निराश था।

examples.en: It's disappointing that so few people came.
examples.hi: यह निराशाजनक है कि इतने कम लोग आए।

examples.en: Don't disappoint your team.
examples.hi: अपनी टीम को निराश मत करो।

examples.en: The hotel was a bit disappointing for the price.
examples.hi: क़ीमत के हिसाब से होटल थोड़ा निराशाजनक था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very disappointing with the service.
common_mistake.right: I am very disappointed with the service.
common_mistake.why: '-ed' for how you feel, '-ing' for what causes the feeling.

cloze.sentence: The team's performance in the final was ____.

en_def: to find something for the first time, or to learn something you did not know
hi_nuance: 'discover' = find something that already existed; 'invent' = create something new. Hindi speakers use 'discover' for inventions ('discovered the telephone' ✗).

examples.en: Scientists discovered a new species of frog.
examples.hi: वैज्ञानिकों ने मेंढक की एक नई प्रजाति खोजी।

examples.en: I discovered that the file had been deleted.
examples.hi: मुझे पता चला कि फ़ाइल मिटा दी गई थी।

examples.en: We discovered a great café near the office.
examples.hi: हमें दफ़्तर के पास एक बढ़िया कैफ़े मिला।

examples.en: She discovered she was allergic to nuts.
examples.hi: उसे पता चला कि उसे मेवों से एलर्जी है।

examples.en: The vulnerability was discovered by a researcher.
examples.hi: यह कमज़ोरी एक शोधकर्ता ने खोजी थी।

examples.en: Who discovered penicillin?
examples.hi: पेनिसिलिन की खोज किसने की?

common_mistake.wrong: Edison discovered the light bulb.
common_mistake.right: Edison invented the light bulb.
common_mistake.why: You 'discover' things that exist in nature and 'invent' new devices.

cloze.sentence: The audit ____ several unpatched servers.

en_def: to interrupt someone; to make someone worried or upset
hi_def: परेशान करना, बाधा डालना, विचलित करना
hi_nuance: Indian English 'I am disturbed' often means 'I'm upset/distracted'; in standard English 'disturbed' can suggest mental illness. Say 'upset' or 'I couldn't concentrate'. 'Sorry to disturb you' is fine.

examples.en: Sorry to disturb you, but there's a call for you.
examples.hi: परेशान करने के लिए माफ़ी, लेकिन आपके लिए फ़ोन है।

examples.en: Please don't disturb me while I'm working.
examples.hi: काम करते समय कृपया मुझे परेशान न करें।

examples.en: The news disturbed her deeply.
examples.hi: उस ख़बर ने उसे गहराई से विचलित कर दिया।

examples.en: Put the phone on 'Do not disturb'.
examples.hi: फ़ोन को 'डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब' पर रख दो।

examples.en: The loud music disturbed the neighbours.
examples.hi: तेज़ संगीत से पड़ोसी परेशान हुए।

examples.en: Don't disturb the evidence until the police arrive.
examples.hi: पुलिस के आने तक सबूतों को मत छेड़ो।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very disturbed because of the noise outside.
common_mistake.right: I can't concentrate because of the noise outside.
common_mistake.why: 'disturbed' about a person suggests mental illness; describe the effect instead.

cloze.sentence: Try not to ____ the baby; she's just fallen asleep.

en_def: a feeling of not being sure; (verb) to think something is probably not true
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'doubt' to mean 'question' ('I have a doubt about this line'). In standard English, 'doubt' = disbelief; say 'I have a question'. The 'b' is silent: /daʊt/.

examples.en: I doubt he'll come; he's always busy.
examples.hi: मुझे शक है कि वह आएगा; वह हमेशा व्यस्त रहता है।

examples.en: There's no doubt that she's talented.
examples.hi: इसमें कोई शक नहीं कि वह प्रतिभाशाली है।

examples.en: If in doubt, ask.
examples.hi: अगर संदेह हो तो पूछ लो।

examples.en: I have my doubts about this plan.
examples.hi: मुझे इस योजना पर संदेह है।

examples.en: No doubt the price will go up again.
examples.hi: बेशक क़ीमत फिर बढ़ेगी।

examples.en: She never doubted her decision.
examples.hi: उसे अपने फ़ैसले पर कभी संदेह नहीं हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: Sir, I have one doubt in this formula.
common_mistake.right: Sir, I have a question about this formula.
common_mistake.why: 'doubt' means disbelief in standard English; for asking, say 'question'.

cloze.sentence: I ____ we'll finish before the weekend.

en_def: the system of money, trade, and industry in a country; also careful use of money
hi_nuance: Stress on the second syllable: e-CON-o-my; the adjective 'economic' (of the economy) stresses 'NOM', and 'economical' means cheap to run. Hindi speakers mix 'economic' and 'economical'.

examples.en: The economy grew by 7% last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल अर्थव्यवस्था 7% बढ़ी।

examples.en: A weak economy means fewer jobs.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर अर्थव्यवस्था का मतलब कम नौकरियाँ।

examples.en: We flew economy class to save money.
examples.hi: पैसे बचाने के लिए हमने इकॉनमी क्लास में उड़ान भरी।

examples.en: Small cars are more economical to run.
examples.hi: छोटी कारें चलाने में ज़्यादा किफ़ायती होती हैं।

examples.en: The global economy is slowing down.
examples.hi: वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था धीमी हो रही है।

examples.en: The government's economic policy is under fire.
examples.hi: सरकार की आर्थिक नीति आलोचना के घेरे में है।

common_mistake.wrong: This car is very economic.
common_mistake.right: This car is very economical.
common_mistake.why: 'economical' = cheap to use; 'economic' relates to the economy.

cloze.sentence: Tourism is a big part of the local ____.

en_def: working well without wasting time, money, or energy
hi_nuance: 'efficient' (no waste) vs 'effective' (gets the result). A process can be efficient but not effective. Hindi 'कुशल' covers both, so choose carefully.

examples.en: The new system is much more efficient.
examples.hi: नई प्रणाली कहीं ज़्यादा कुशल है।

examples.en: She's a very efficient assistant.
examples.hi: वह बहुत कुशल सहायक है।

examples.en: LED bulbs are more energy-efficient.
examples.hi: एलईडी बल्ब ऊर्जा के मामले में ज़्यादा कुशल होते हैं।

examples.en: Is there a more efficient way to do this?
examples.hi: क्या इसे करने का कोई ज़्यादा कारगर तरीक़ा है?

examples.en: The team works efficiently under pressure.
examples.hi: टीम दबाव में भी कुशलता से काम करती है।

examples.en: Caching makes the app more efficient.
examples.hi: कैशिंग ऐप को ज़्यादा कुशल बनाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The medicine is very efficient for headaches.
common_mistake.right: The medicine is very effective for headaches.
common_mistake.why: 'effective' = produces the result; 'efficient' = without waste.

cloze.sentence: Automating the tests made the whole process far more ____.

en_def: physical or mental energy used to do something; an attempt
hi_nuance: 'make an effort', 'put effort into' — not 'give effort' or 'do effort'. Indian English 'put efforts' (plural) → 'put in effort' (uncountable).

examples.en: She made a real effort to be on time.
examples.hi: उसने समय पर पहुँचने की सच्ची कोशिश की।

examples.en: It takes a lot of effort to learn a language.
examples.hi: भाषा सीखने में बहुत मेहनत लगती है।

examples.en: Thanks for all your effort on this project.
examples.hi: इस प्रोजेक्ट में आपकी मेहनत के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: He put a lot of effort into the presentation.
examples.hi: उसने प्रेज़ेंटेशन में बहुत मेहनत की।

examples.en: Despite our efforts, the server stayed down.
examples.hi: हमारी कोशिशों के बावजूद सर्वर बंद रहा।

examples.en: Make an effort to speak English every day.
examples.hi: हर दिन अंग्रेज़ी बोलने की कोशिश करो।

common_mistake.wrong: I have given my best efforts.
common_mistake.right: I have made my best effort.
common_mistake.why: 'make an effort' (singular, uncountable); 'give' is not used.

cloze.sentence: It took a huge ____ to get the report finished by Friday.

en_def: a sudden serious and dangerous situation needing immediate action
hi_nuance: Indian English 'urgent' and 'emergency' overlap; an 'emergency' involves danger. 'In an emergency' / 'in case of emergency'. 'Emergency leave' is Indian usage — 'urgent leave' or 'time off for a family emergency'.

examples.en: Call 112 in an emergency.
examples.hi: आपात स्थिति में 112 पर कॉल करें।

examples.en: The hospital's emergency department was full.
examples.hi: अस्पताल का आपातकालीन विभाग भरा हुआ था।

examples.en: This is not an emergency; it can wait.
examples.hi: यह आपात स्थिति नहीं है; यह इंतज़ार कर सकता है।

examples.en: Keep an emergency fund for unexpected costs.
examples.hi: अप्रत्याशित ख़र्चों के लिए आपातकालीन कोष रखें।

examples.en: The plane made an emergency landing.
examples.hi: विमान ने आपातकालीन लैंडिंग की।

examples.en: We have an emergency plan for data breaches.
examples.hi: डेटा उल्लंघन के लिए हमारे पास आपातकालीन योजना है।

common_mistake.wrong: I need emergency leave for two days.
common_mistake.right: I need two days off for a family emergency.
common_mistake.why: 'emergency leave' is Indian corporate English; describe the reason instead.

cloze.sentence: Everyone knew what to do because we had practised the ____ drill.

en_def: to pay someone to work for you; (formal) to use something
hi_def: नौकरी देना, नियुक्त करना; इस्तेमाल करना
hi_nuance: 'employer' (company) vs 'employee' (worker) — Hindi speakers swap them. 'Be employed by/at'. 'Self-employed' = your own business.

examples.en: The factory employs 300 people.
examples.hi: कारख़ाने में 300 लोग काम करते हैं।

examples.en: She is employed by a software company.
examples.hi: वह एक सॉफ़्टवेयर कंपनी में नौकरी करती है।

examples.en: We employed a lawyer to check the contract.
examples.hi: हमने अनुबंध जाँचने के लिए एक वकील रखा।

examples.en: He has been self-employed for five years.
examples.hi: वह पाँच साल से अपना काम कर रहा है।

examples.en: The attackers employed a new technique.
examples.hi: हमलावरों ने एक नई तकनीक इस्तेमाल की।

examples.en: The company is looking to employ more staff.
examples.hi: कंपनी और कर्मचारी रखना चाहती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am an employer at Infosys.
common_mistake.right: I am an employee at Infosys.
common_mistake.why: 'employer' is the company; 'employee' is the worker.

cloze.sentence: The hotel ____ extra staff during the wedding season.

en_def: to give someone confidence or support to do something
hi_nuance: 'encourage someone to' + verb. Indian English 'encourage for' ✗. Pronounced en-KUR-ij, not 'en-cour-AGE'. The opposite is 'discourage'.

examples.en: My teacher encouraged me to apply abroad.
examples.hi: मेरे शिक्षक ने मुझे विदेश में आवेदन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया।

examples.en: We encourage staff to report security issues.
examples.hi: हम कर्मचारियों को सुरक्षा समस्याएँ रिपोर्ट करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।

examples.en: Her success encouraged others to try.
examples.hi: उसकी सफलता ने दूसरों को कोशिश करने का हौसला दिया।

examples.en: Parents should encourage reading at home.
examples.hi: माता-पिता को घर पर पढ़ने को बढ़ावा देना चाहिए।

examples.en: The results are very encouraging.
examples.hi: नतीजे बहुत उत्साहजनक हैं।

examples.en: Don't discourage him; he's trying his best.
examples.hi: उसका हौसला मत तोड़ो; वह अपनी पूरी कोशिश कर रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: She encouraged me for taking the course.
common_mistake.right: She encouraged me to take the course.
common_mistake.why: 'encourage someone to' + base verb.

cloze.sentence: Good managers ____ their teams to learn from mistakes.

en_def: extremely large
hi_nuance: 'enormous' is already extreme, so don't say 'very enormous' — say 'absolutely enormous'. Hindi speakers overuse 'huge'; 'enormous' adds variety.

examples.en: The new mall is enormous.
examples.hi: नया मॉल विशाल है।

examples.en: They paid an enormous amount for the flat.
examples.hi: उन्होंने फ़्लैट के लिए बहुत बड़ी रक़म चुकाई।

examples.en: The project was an enormous success.
examples.hi: यह प्रोजेक्ट बहुत बड़ी सफलता थी।

examples.en: An enormous crowd gathered outside the stadium.
examples.hi: स्टेडियम के बाहर विशाल भीड़ जमा हो गई।

examples.en: The breach had enormous consequences.
examples.hi: इस उल्लंघन के बहुत बड़े परिणाम हुए।

examples.en: He has an enormous appetite.
examples.hi: उसकी भूख बहुत ज़्यादा है।

common_mistake.wrong: The stadium is very enormous.
common_mistake.right: The stadium is absolutely enormous.
common_mistake.why: 'enormous' is an extreme adjective; use 'absolutely', not 'very'.

cloze.sentence: The company made an ____ profit last year.

en_def: to make certain that something happens
hi_nuance: 'ensure that' + clause, or 'ensure' + noun. Don't confuse with 'insure' (buy insurance) or 'assure' (tell someone something is true). Indian English 'kindly ensure to send' ✗ → 'please ensure you send'.

examples.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked.
examples.hi: कृपया सुनिश्चित करें कि सभी दरवाज़े बंद हों।

examples.en: Backups ensure you don't lose data.
examples.hi: बैकअप सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि आपका डेटा न खोए।

examples.en: We must ensure the safety of the passengers.
examples.hi: हमें यात्रियों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करनी चाहिए।

examples.en: Testing ensures the code works as expected.
examples.hi: परीक्षण सुनिश्चित करता है कि कोड अपेक्षा के अनुसार काम करे।

examples.en: How can we ensure fairness?
examples.hi: हम निष्पक्षता कैसे सुनिश्चित कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Practice ensures progress.
examples.hi: अभ्यास से प्रगति सुनिश्चित होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly ensure to update the sheet.
common_mistake.right: Please make sure you update the sheet.
common_mistake.why: 'ensure' is not followed by 'to'; use 'ensure that' or 'make sure'.

cloze.sentence: Two-factor authentication ____ that only you can log in.

en_def: whole; complete
hi_nuance: 'entire' goes before the noun with 'the': 'the entire day', 'the entire team'. Hindi speakers use 'whole' in every case; 'entire' is a stronger, slightly more formal choice.

examples.en: I spent the entire weekend studying.
examples.hi: मैंने पूरा वीकेंड पढ़ाई में बिताया।

examples.en: The entire building was evacuated.
examples.hi: पूरी इमारत ख़ाली करा ली गई।

examples.en: She read the entire report in one sitting.
examples.hi: उसने पूरी रिपोर्ट एक बार में पढ़ ली।

examples.en: The outage affected the entire network.
examples.hi: इस ख़राबी ने पूरे नेटवर्क को प्रभावित किया।

examples.en: That's entirely up to you.
examples.hi: यह पूरी तरह आप पर निर्भर है।

examples.en: The entire team worked through the night.
examples.hi: पूरी टीम ने रात भर काम किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Entire the class was silent.
common_mistake.right: The entire class was silent.
common_mistake.why: 'the' comes before 'entire'.

cloze.sentence: He ate the ____ pizza by himself.

en_def: the natural world; the surroundings or conditions in which you live or work
hi_nuance: Don't forget the 'n' before 'ment': environ-ment. 'The environment' = nature; 'a working environment' = conditions. In tech, 'production environment' = the live system.

examples.en: Plastic waste harms the environment.
examples.hi: प्लास्टिक कचरा पर्यावरण को नुक़सान पहुँचाता है।

examples.en: We want a friendly working environment.
examples.hi: हम एक दोस्ताना कार्य वातावरण चाहते हैं।

examples.en: Never test on the production environment.
examples.hi: प्रोडक्शन एनवायरनमेंट पर कभी टेस्ट न करें।

examples.en: Children need a safe environment to grow.
examples.hi: बच्चों को बढ़ने के लिए सुरक्षित माहौल चाहिए।

examples.en: The company has cut its environmental impact.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने अपना पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव कम किया है।

examples.en: It's an environment where questions are welcome.
examples.hi: यह ऐसा माहौल है जहाँ सवालों का स्वागत है।

common_mistake.wrong: We should save the enviroment.
common_mistake.right: We should protect the environment.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: environment (with 'n'); and 'protect' is the natural verb.

cloze.sentence: Cycling to work is better for the ____.

en_def: completely necessary; extremely important
hi_nuance: 'essential for/to' + noun; 'it is essential that' + clause. Stronger than 'important'. Hindi speakers use 'compulsory' where 'essential' (necessary, not imposed) fits better.

examples.en: Water is essential for life.
examples.hi: पानी जीवन के लिए अनिवार्य है।

examples.en: It's essential that you back up your data.
examples.hi: यह ज़रूरी है कि आप अपने डेटा का बैकअप लें।

examples.en: Good communication is essential in a team.
examples.hi: टीम में अच्छा संवाद बेहद ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Pack only the essentials.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ ज़रूरी चीज़ें ही रखो।

examples.en: Patching is an essential part of security.
examples.hi: पैचिंग सुरक्षा का एक अनिवार्य हिस्सा है।

examples.en: Experience isn't essential, but it helps.
examples.hi: अनुभव अनिवार्य नहीं है, लेकिन मदद करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Helmet is compulsory for your safety.
common_mistake.right: A helmet is essential for your safety.
common_mistake.why: 'compulsory' means required by rule; 'essential' means necessary; and 'helmet' needs an article.

cloze.sentence: A good night's sleep is ____ before an exam.

en_def: to start an organisation or system; to find out facts for certain
hi_nuance: Indian signboards say 'Estd. 1985' — that's 'established'. Second meaning: 'establish the cause' = find out for sure (common in incident reports).

examples.en: The company was established in 1998.
examples.hi: कंपनी की स्थापना 1998 में हुई थी।

examples.en: We need to establish what caused the outage.
examples.hi: हमें पता लगाना होगा कि ख़राबी की वजह क्या थी।

examples.en: She has established herself as a top designer.
examples.hi: उसने ख़ुद को एक शीर्ष डिज़ाइनर के रूप में स्थापित कर लिया है।

examples.en: The police have established his identity.
examples.hi: पुलिस ने उसकी पहचान पता कर ली है।

examples.en: Let's establish some ground rules first.
examples.hi: पहले कुछ बुनियादी नियम तय कर लेते हैं।

examples.en: It's an established fact that exercise helps.
examples.hi: यह एक स्थापित तथ्य है कि व्यायाम मदद करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We established that the attacker has used a stolen password.
common_mistake.right: We established that the attacker had used a stolen password.
common_mistake.why: After 'established that' (past), use the past perfect for the earlier action.

cloze.sentence: The investigation ____ that the fire started in the kitchen.

en_def: to guess the size, cost, or value of something using available information
hi_nuance: Verb ends /-meɪt/, noun ends /-mət/. Indian English 'give an estimation' → 'give an estimate'. 'Rough estimate' = approximate figure.

examples.en: We estimate the repair will cost about 5,000 rupees.
examples.hi: हमारा अनुमान है कि मरम्मत में लगभग 5,000 रुपये लगेंगे।

examples.en: Can you give me a rough estimate?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे एक मोटा अनुमान दे सकते हैं?

examples.en: The crowd was estimated at 10,000.
examples.hi: भीड़ का अनुमान 10,000 लगाया गया।

examples.en: I estimate it'll take three days.
examples.hi: मेरा अनुमान है कि इसमें तीन दिन लगेंगे।

examples.en: The builder's estimate was too high.
examples.hi: बिल्डर का अनुमान बहुत ज़्यादा था।

examples.en: It's hard to estimate the damage yet.
examples.hi: अभी नुक़सान का अनुमान लगाना मुश्किल है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please send the estimation for the work.
common_mistake.right: Please send an estimate for the work.
common_mistake.why: The noun for a cost figure is 'estimate'; 'estimation' means judgement or opinion.

cloze.sentence: Experts ____ that a million users were affected.

en_def: in the end, especially after a long time or many problems
hi_nuance: 'eventually' ≠ 'possibly' (a false friend for some languages). Hindi speakers say 'at last' or 'finally' — 'eventually' adds the idea of a long wait or process.

examples.en: We eventually found a parking space.
examples.hi: आख़िरकार हमें पार्किंग की जगह मिल ही गई।

examples.en: He eventually agreed to help.
examples.hi: आख़िरकार वह मदद के लिए राज़ी हो गया।

examples.en: Eventually, the pain went away.
examples.hi: अंततः दर्द चला गया।

examples.en: You'll get used to it eventually.
examples.hi: धीरे-धीरे तुम्हें इसकी आदत हो जाएगी।

examples.en: The bug was eventually traced to a typo.
examples.hi: बग का पता आख़िरकार एक टाइपो में जाकर लगा।

examples.en: She eventually became the CEO.
examples.hi: आख़िरकार वह सीईओ बन गई।

common_mistake.wrong: At last we eventually reached.
common_mistake.right: We eventually reached the hotel.
common_mistake.why: 'at last' and 'eventually' mean the same; use one, and 'reach' needs an object.

cloze.sentence: After many delays, the train ____ arrived at midnight.

en_def: facts or signs that show something is true
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'a piece of evidence', never 'an evidence' or 'evidences'. 'Evidence of/for' + noun; 'evidence that' + clause. Essential in security reports.

examples.en: There is no evidence that he was involved.
examples.hi: इसका कोई सबूत नहीं है कि वह शामिल था।

examples.en: The police found evidence of a break-in.
examples.hi: पुलिस को सेंधमारी के सबूत मिले।

examples.en: We need more evidence before we decide.
examples.hi: फ़ैसला करने से पहले हमें और सबूत चाहिए।

examples.en: The logs are the main piece of evidence.
examples.hi: लॉग सबूत का मुख्य हिस्सा हैं।

examples.en: Scientific evidence supports the theory.
examples.hi: वैज्ञानिक प्रमाण इस सिद्धांत का समर्थन करते हैं।

examples.en: Is there any evidence for this claim?
examples.hi: क्या इस दावे का कोई प्रमाण है?

common_mistake.wrong: We have found many evidences of the attack.
common_mistake.right: We have found a lot of evidence of the attack.
common_mistake.why: 'evidence' is uncountable; use 'a lot of' or 'pieces of'.

cloze.sentence: The screenshot is clear ____ that the account was hacked.

en_def: completely correct in every detail
hi_nuance: Indian English 'exact same' is fine informally. 'Exactly' is also the natural way to strongly agree ('Exactly!'). Hindi 'ठीक' can mean 'okay' — 'exact' does not.

examples.en: What is the exact time of the meeting?
examples.hi: बैठक का सटीक समय क्या है?

examples.en: I don't remember the exact words he used.
examples.hi: मुझे उसके इस्तेमाल किए ठीक-ठीक शब्द याद नहीं हैं।

examples.en: Please give the exact error message.
examples.hi: कृपया सटीक त्रुटि संदेश बताएँ।

examples.en: That's exactly what I meant.
examples.hi: मेरा बिल्कुल यही मतलब था।

examples.en: We need the exact figures, not estimates.
examples.hi: हमें अनुमान नहीं, सटीक आँकड़े चाहिए।

examples.en: It happened at exactly 3.15 pm.
examples.hi: यह ठीक 3.15 बजे दोपहर को हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: Tell me the exact-exact time.
common_mistake.right: Tell me the exact time.
common_mistake.why: Repeating a word for emphasis is a Hindi pattern; English uses 'exact' once.

cloze.sentence: We don't know the ____ number of people affected.

en_def: to look at something carefully to learn about it or check it
hi_nuance: A doctor 'examines' a patient; a teacher 'examines' students (formal); an engineer 'examines' the logs. 'Examination' is the formal word for 'exam'. Don't use 'examine' for 'take an exam'.

examples.en: The doctor examined her carefully.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसकी सावधानी से जाँच की।

examples.en: We examined the logs for suspicious activity.
examples.hi: हमने संदिग्ध गतिविधि के लिए लॉग की जाँच की।

examples.en: Customs officers examined every bag.
examples.hi: कस्टम अधिकारियों ने हर बैग की जाँच की।

examples.en: The report examines the causes of the failure.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट विफलता के कारणों की जाँच करती है।

examples.en: Examine the contract before you sign.
examples.hi: हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले अनुबंध को परखें।

examples.en: Let's examine the evidence again.
examples.hi: चलो सबूतों की फिर से जाँच करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will examine tomorrow for maths.
common_mistake.right: I have a maths exam tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'examine' means to inspect; taking a test is 'have/sit an exam'.

cloze.sentence: The mechanic ____ the engine and found a leak.

en_def: not including; apart from
hi_nuance: 'except' (not including) vs 'accept' (agree to take). Also 'except for' at the start of a sentence. Hindi speakers write 'accept' by mistake in emails.

examples.en: Everyone came except Ravi.
examples.hi: रवि को छोड़कर सब आए।

examples.en: The shop is open every day except Sunday.
examples.hi: दुकान रविवार को छोड़कर हर दिन खुली रहती है।

examples.en: Except for a few typos, the report is fine.
examples.hi: कुछ टाइपो को छोड़कर रिपोर्ट ठीक है।

examples.en: I like all vegetables except bitter gourd.
examples.hi: मुझे करेले को छोड़कर सभी सब्ज़ियाँ पसंद हैं।

examples.en: Nobody knew except me.
examples.hi: मेरे सिवा किसी को नहीं पता था।

examples.en: All ports are closed except 443.
examples.hi: 443 को छोड़कर सभी पोर्ट बंद हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: All members accept John attended.
common_mistake.right: All members except John attended.
common_mistake.why: 'except' = not including; 'accept' = agree to receive.

cloze.sentence: I've finished everything ____ the last question.

en_def: extremely tired
hi_nuance: 'exhausted' is extreme, so 'absolutely exhausted', not 'very exhausted'. Hindi speakers say 'I am very tired' every time — 'exhausted' or 'worn out' is stronger and natural.

examples.en: I was exhausted after the twelve-hour shift.
examples.hi: बारह घंटे की शिफ़्ट के बाद मैं पूरी तरह थक गया था।

examples.en: The children were exhausted by bedtime.
examples.hi: सोने के समय तक बच्चे थककर चूर थे।

examples.en: She looked absolutely exhausted.
examples.hi: वह बिल्कुल थकी-हारी लग रही थी।

examples.en: It was an exhausting journey.
examples.hi: यह एक थका देने वाला सफ़र था।

examples.en: We've exhausted all the options.
examples.hi: हमने सारे विकल्प आज़मा लिए हैं।

examples.en: The battery was completely exhausted.
examples.hi: बैटरी पूरी तरह ख़त्म हो चुकी थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very exhausted today.
common_mistake.right: I am absolutely exhausted today.
common_mistake.why: Extreme adjectives take 'absolutely' or 'completely', not 'very'.

cloze.sentence: After the marathon, the runners were ____.

en_def: to become larger, or to make something larger
hi_nuance: 'expand' (grow in size) vs 'extend' (make longer in time or reach). A company expands; a deadline is extended. Hindi 'बढ़ाना' covers both.

examples.en: The company plans to expand into Europe.
examples.hi: कंपनी यूरोप में विस्तार करने की योजना बना रही है।

examples.en: Metal expands when it is heated.
examples.hi: धातु गर्म होने पर फैलती है।

examples.en: We're expanding the team next quarter.
examples.hi: हम अगली तिमाही में टीम बढ़ा रहे हैं।

examples.en: Can you expand on that point?
examples.hi: क्या आप उस बात को और विस्तार से बता सकते हैं?

examples.en: The city has expanded rapidly.
examples.hi: शहर का तेज़ी से विस्तार हुआ है।

examples.en: Click the arrow to expand the menu.
examples.hi: मेन्यू खोलने के लिए तीर पर क्लिक करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Can we expand the deadline by two days?
common_mistake.right: Can we extend the deadline by two days?
common_mistake.why: Time is 'extended'; size or scope is 'expanded'.

cloze.sentence: The store is ____ its range of organic products.

en_def: a person with special knowledge or skill in a subject
hi_nuance: 'expert in/on/at' something. Indian English 'expert person' — just 'expert'. Don't say 'I am expert' without 'an'.

examples.en: She's an expert in network security.
examples.hi: वह नेटवर्क सुरक्षा की विशेषज्ञ है।

examples.en: Ask an expert before you invest.
examples.hi: निवेश करने से पहले किसी विशेषज्ञ से पूछें।

examples.en: He's an expert at fixing old cars.
examples.hi: वह पुरानी कारें ठीक करने में माहिर है।

examples.en: Experts say the economy will recover.
examples.hi: विशेषज्ञों का कहना है कि अर्थव्यवस्था सुधरेगी।

examples.en: I'm no expert, but that looks wrong.
examples.hi: मैं विशेषज्ञ तो नहीं, पर वह गलत लग रहा है।

examples.en: We got expert advice on the contract.
examples.hi: हमने अनुबंध पर विशेषज्ञ सलाह ली।

common_mistake.wrong: I am expert in Python.
common_mistake.right: I am an expert in Python.
common_mistake.why: Singular countable nouns need an article.

cloze.sentence: The court called a handwriting ____ to check the signature.

en_def: to a very high degree
hi_nuance: Use with normal adjectives (extremely hot), not extreme ones (extremely boiling ✗). Hindi speakers overuse 'too' to mean 'very' — 'too' means 'more than acceptable'.

examples.en: It was extremely hot in Ahmedabad last week.
examples.hi: पिछले हफ़्ते अहमदाबाद में बेहद गर्मी थी।

examples.en: She's extremely good at maths.
examples.hi: वह गणित में बहुत ज़्यादा अच्छी है।

examples.en: The instructions were extremely clear.
examples.hi: निर्देश अत्यंत स्पष्ट थे।

examples.en: I'm extremely sorry for the confusion.
examples.hi: भ्रम के लिए मुझे बेहद खेद है।

examples.en: The exploit is extremely difficult to detect.
examples.hi: इस एक्सप्लॉइट का पता लगाना बेहद मुश्किल है।

examples.en: It's extremely unlikely to rain today.
examples.hi: आज बारिश की संभावना बहुत कम है।

common_mistake.wrong: The food was too delicious.
common_mistake.right: The food was extremely delicious.
common_mistake.why: 'too' means excessive; for strong praise use 'extremely' or 'really'.

cloze.sentence: Be careful; the water is ____ deep here.

en_def: treating everyone equally; reasonable; also light in colour (hair/skin)
hi_nuance: In India 'fair' mostly means light skin; in English the main meaning is 'just'. 'Fair enough' = okay, I accept that. 'A fair amount' = quite a lot.

examples.en: It's not fair that she gets paid more for the same work.
examples.hi: यह उचित नहीं कि उसे एक ही काम के लिए ज़्यादा वेतन मिले।

examples.en: The referee was fair to both teams.
examples.hi: रेफ़री दोनों टीमों के साथ निष्पक्ष था।

examples.en: That's a fair point.
examples.hi: यह एक वाजिब बात है।

examples.en: Fair enough, we'll do it your way.
examples.hi: ठीक है, हम तुम्हारे तरीक़े से करेंगे।

examples.en: We've made a fair amount of progress.
examples.hi: हमने काफ़ी प्रगति की है।

examples.en: He has fair hair and blue eyes.
examples.hi: उसके बाल सुनहरे और आँखें नीली हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: She is very fair and beautiful.
common_mistake.right: She has a light complexion.
common_mistake.why: Praising light skin sounds odd in English; 'fair' mainly means 'just'.

cloze.sentence: To be ____, he did warn us about the risk.

en_def: well known to you; easy to recognise
hi_nuance: Two patterns: 'X is familiar to me' (I know X) and 'I am familiar with X' (I know about X). Hindi speakers mix 'to' and 'with'. Not the same as 'family'.

examples.en: Are you familiar with Linux?
examples.hi: क्या आप लिनक्स से परिचित हैं?

examples.en: His face looks familiar.
examples.hi: उसका चेहरा जाना-पहचाना लगता है।

examples.en: The name is familiar to most people.
examples.hi: यह नाम ज़्यादातर लोगों के लिए जाना-पहचाना है।

examples.en: I'm not familiar with this part of town.
examples.hi: मैं शहर के इस हिस्से से परिचित नहीं हूँ।

examples.en: The song sounded familiar.
examples.hi: गाना सुना-सुना लग रहा था।

examples.en: Make yourself familiar with the fire exits.
examples.hi: आग से बचने के रास्तों से ख़ुद को परिचित कर लें।

common_mistake.wrong: I am familiar to this software.
common_mistake.right: I am familiar with this software.
common_mistake.why: A person is familiar 'with' something; a thing is familiar 'to' a person.

cloze.sentence: Read the manual until you're ____ with every setting.

en_def: responsibility for a mistake; a problem or weakness in something
hi_nuance: 'It's my fault' (responsibility) vs 'a fault in the wiring' (defect). Hindi 'गलती' is also 'mistake', but you don't say 'I did a fault'. 'At fault' = responsible.

examples.en: It's not your fault; the system crashed.
examples.hi: यह तुम्हारी गलती नहीं है; सिस्टम क्रैश हो गया था।

examples.en: The accident was the driver's fault.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना ड्राइवर की गलती थी।

examples.en: There's a fault in the wiring.
examples.hi: वायरिंग में ख़राबी है।

examples.en: Whose fault is it that we're late?
examples.hi: हमारे देर से आने में किसकी गलती है?

examples.en: She has her faults, but she's honest.
examples.hi: उसमें कमियाँ हैं, लेकिन वह ईमानदार है।

examples.en: The engineer found a fault in the code.
examples.hi: इंजीनियर को कोड में एक दोष मिला।

common_mistake.wrong: I did a fault in the calculation.
common_mistake.right: I made a mistake in the calculation.
common_mistake.why: You 'make a mistake'; 'fault' is used as 'it's my fault' or 'a fault in something'.

cloze.sentence: Don't worry, it was my ____ for not checking the date.

en_def: an important or noticeable part or quality of something
hi_nuance: In tech, 'feature' = function of a product. In writing, 'feature' (verb) = include prominently. Hindi speakers say 'facilities' for phone features — use 'features'.

examples.en: The phone's best feature is its camera.
examples.hi: फ़ोन की सबसे अच्छी ख़ासियत उसका कैमरा है।

examples.en: Security is a key feature of the new app.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा नए ऐप की एक मुख्य विशेषता है।

examples.en: The film features a famous actor.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म में एक मशहूर अभिनेता है।

examples.en: We're adding a dark mode feature.
examples.hi: हम डार्क मोड फ़ीचर जोड़ रहे हैं।

examples.en: The house has some unusual features.
examples.hi: घर में कुछ असामान्य विशेषताएँ हैं।

examples.en: That's a bug, not a feature.
examples.hi: यह बग है, फ़ीचर नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: This phone has many facilities like face unlock.
common_mistake.right: This phone has many features like face unlock.
common_mistake.why: Product functions are 'features'; 'facilities' are buildings or services.

cloze.sentence: The new ____ lets you edit messages after sending.

en_def: a number or amount; a person's body shape; a diagram; (verb) to think or work out
hi_nuance: 'figures' = numbers (sales figures). 'Figure out' = understand or solve. Indian English says 'find out' where 'figure out' fits. British pronunciation has no 'y' sound: FIG-uh.

examples.en: The sales figures look good this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने के बिक्री के आँकड़े अच्छे लग रहे हैं।

examples.en: I can't figure out why the test fails.
examples.hi: मैं समझ नहीं पा रहा कि टेस्ट क्यों फ़ेल हो रहा है।

examples.en: See Figure 3 for the network diagram.
examples.hi: नेटवर्क आरेख के लिए चित्र 3 देखें।

examples.en: A dark figure stood at the door.
examples.hi: दरवाज़े पर एक काली आकृति खड़ी थी।

examples.en: She's a well-known figure in the industry.
examples.hi: वह उद्योग की एक जानी-मानी हस्ती है।

examples.en: I figured you'd be busy, so I didn't call.
examples.hi: मैंने सोचा तुम व्यस्त होगे, इसलिए फ़ोन नहीं किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I could not find out how to fix it.
common_mistake.right: I couldn't figure out how to fix it.
common_mistake.why: 'figure out' = solve by thinking; 'find out' = discover information.

cloze.sentence: It took me an hour to ____ out the new software.

en_def: able to change or be changed easily; able to bend
hi_nuance: 'flexible hours', 'flexible about' + something. Hindi speakers say 'adjustable' or 'I can adjust' — in English, 'I'm flexible' is the natural way to say you can fit in.

examples.en: My working hours are flexible.
examples.hi: मेरे काम के घंटे लचीले हैं।

examples.en: I'm flexible about the meeting time.
examples.hi: बैठक के समय को लेकर मैं लचीला हूँ।

examples.en: Yoga keeps your body flexible.
examples.hi: योग शरीर को लचीला रखता है।

examples.en: We need a more flexible approach.
examples.hi: हमें ज़्यादा लचीले तरीक़े की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: The plan is flexible; we can change it later.
examples.hi: योजना लचीली है; हम इसे बाद में बदल सकते हैं।

examples.en: The cable is thin and flexible.
examples.hi: केबल पतली और लचीली है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am adjustable with any time.
common_mistake.right: I am flexible about the time.
common_mistake.why: People are 'flexible'; 'adjustable' describes objects like straps or chairs.

cloze.sentence: The company offers ____ working to parents of young children.

en_def: to give all your attention to one thing; (noun) the main subject of attention
hi_nuance: 'focus on', never 'focus in' or 'focus at'. Very common in work English: 'let's focus on the main issue'. The noun: 'the focus of the report'.

examples.en: Let's focus on the most urgent bug first.
examples.hi: चलो सबसे पहले सबसे ज़रूरी बग पर ध्यान देते हैं।

examples.en: I can't focus with so much noise.
examples.hi: इतने शोर में मैं ध्यान नहीं लगा पाता।

examples.en: The focus of the meeting was the budget.
examples.hi: बैठक का केंद्र बजट था।

examples.en: She needs to focus more on her studies.
examples.hi: उसे अपनी पढ़ाई पर ज़्यादा ध्यान देना चाहिए।

examples.en: The camera won't focus properly.
examples.hi: कैमरा ठीक से फ़ोकस नहीं कर रहा।

examples.en: Our main focus this year is quality.
examples.hi: इस साल हमारा मुख्य ध्यान गुणवत्ता पर है।

common_mistake.wrong: We should focus in improving the response time.
common_mistake.right: We should focus on improving the response time.
common_mistake.why: 'focus on' is the fixed preposition.

cloze.sentence: This week, the team will ____ on fixing the login issues.

en_def: used to say that something good happened by luck
hi_nuance: Usually at the start of a sentence with a comma. Hindi speakers say 'luckily' or 'thank God'; 'fortunately' is slightly more formal and common in writing. Opposite: 'unfortunately'.

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.hi: सौभाग्य से, दुर्घटना में किसी को चोट नहीं आई।

examples.en: Fortunately, I had backed up the files.
examples.hi: ख़ुशक़िस्मती से मैंने फ़ाइलों का बैकअप ले लिया था।

examples.en: The rain stopped, fortunately, just before the match.
examples.hi: सौभाग्य से, मैच से ठीक पहले बारिश रुक गई।

examples.en: Fortunately for us, the shop was still open.
examples.hi: हमारी ख़ुशक़िस्मती थी कि दुकान अभी भी खुली थी।

examples.en: Unfortunately, the flight was cancelled.
examples.hi: दुर्भाग्य से, उड़ान रद्द कर दी गई।

examples.en: Fortunately, the patch was applied before the attack.
examples.hi: सौभाग्य से, हमले से पहले पैच लगा दिया गया था।

common_mistake.wrong: Thank God nobody was hurt.
common_mistake.right: Fortunately, nobody was hurt.
common_mistake.why: 'Thank God' is fine in speech, but 'fortunately' is the neutral choice in writing and at work.

cloze.sentence: ____, the fire alarm went off before the smoke spread.

en_def: often; many times
hi_nuance: More formal than 'often'. The adjective is 'frequent'. Hindi speakers say 'many times' or 'again and again'; 'frequently' sounds more natural in reports.

examples.en: He frequently travels for work.
examples.hi: वह अक्सर काम के लिए यात्रा करता है।

examples.en: The site crashes frequently under heavy load.
examples.hi: भारी लोड में साइट अक्सर क्रैश हो जाती है।

examples.en: Passwords should be changed frequently.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड बार-बार बदलने चाहिए।

examples.en: This is a frequently asked question.
examples.hi: यह अक्सर पूछा जाने वाला सवाल है।

examples.en: Frequent flyers get extra benefits.
examples.hi: अक्सर उड़ान भरने वालों को अतिरिक्त लाभ मिलते हैं।

examples.en: She visits her parents frequently.
examples.hi: वह अक्सर अपने माता-पिता से मिलने जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The server goes down many many times.
common_mistake.right: The server goes down frequently.
common_mistake.why: Repeating 'many' is Hindi emphasis; English uses 'frequently' or 'very often'.

cloze.sentence: Buses run ____ during rush hour.

en_def: real, not fake; sincere
hi_nuance: Pronounced JEN-yoo-in (not '-wine'). Indian English uses 'genuine' for people ('he's a genuine person' = honest) — that's fine. 'Genuine leather' = real.

examples.en: Is this a genuine Rolex?
examples.hi: क्या यह असली रोलेक्स है?

examples.en: She showed genuine interest in the project.
examples.hi: उसने प्रोजेक्ट में सच्ची दिलचस्पी दिखाई।

examples.en: It was a genuine mistake, not fraud.
examples.hi: यह एक सच्ची भूल थी, धोखाधड़ी नहीं।

examples.en: He seems like a genuine person.
examples.hi: वह एक सच्चा इंसान लगता है।

examples.en: The email looked genuine but was phishing.
examples.hi: ईमेल असली लग रहा था लेकिन फ़िशिंग था।

examples.en: There is genuine concern about the safety of the bridge.
examples.hi: पुल की सुरक्षा को लेकर वास्तविक चिंता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The website is original, not a copy.
common_mistake.right: The website is genuine, not a fake.
common_mistake.why: 'original' means the first version; 'genuine' means not fake.

cloze.sentence: The signature was checked and confirmed as ____.

en_def: something you hope to achieve; (sport) a point scored
hi_nuance: 'set a goal', 'reach/achieve a goal'. Indian English overuses 'aim' and 'target'; 'goal' is the most common everyday word for a personal objective.

examples.en: My goal is to speak English confidently.
examples.hi: मेरा लक्ष्य आत्मविश्वास से अंग्रेज़ी बोलना है।

examples.en: Set small goals and celebrate each one.
examples.hi: छोटे-छोटे लक्ष्य तय करो और हर एक का जश्न मनाओ।

examples.en: We reached our sales goal early.
examples.hi: हमने अपना बिक्री लक्ष्य जल्दी पूरा कर लिया।

examples.en: He scored two goals in the final.
examples.hi: उसने फ़ाइनल में दो गोल किए।

examples.en: What are your career goals?
examples.hi: आपके करियर के लक्ष्य क्या हैं?

examples.en: The team's goal is zero critical bugs by June.
examples.hi: टीम का लक्ष्य जून तक शून्य गंभीर बग है।

common_mistake.wrong: My target is to become fluent.
common_mistake.right: My goal is to become fluent.
common_mistake.why: 'target' is for numbers and deadlines; personal ambitions are 'goals'.

cloze.sentence: Writing down your ____ makes you more likely to achieve them.

en_def: slowly, over a period of time
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'slowly slowly' (धीरे-धीरे); English says 'gradually' or 'little by little'. Opposite: 'suddenly'.

examples.en: The weather is gradually getting warmer.
examples.hi: मौसम धीरे-धीरे गर्म हो रहा है।

examples.en: She gradually improved her pronunciation.
examples.hi: उसने धीरे-धीरे अपना उच्चारण सुधारा।

examples.en: Gradually, the crowd went home.
examples.hi: धीरे-धीरे भीड़ घर चली गई।

examples.en: Increase the speed gradually.
examples.hi: रफ़्तार धीरे-धीरे बढ़ाएँ।

examples.en: Prices have gradually risen over the year.
examples.hi: साल भर में क़ीमतें धीरे-धीरे बढ़ी हैं।

examples.en: He gradually realised something was wrong.
examples.hi: उसे धीरे-धीरे एहसास हुआ कि कुछ गड़बड़ है।

common_mistake.wrong: Slowly slowly my English is improving.
common_mistake.right: My English is gradually improving.
common_mistake.why: Word repetition is Hindi grammar; English uses 'gradually'.

cloze.sentence: The patient is ____ recovering from the operation.

en_def: having done something wrong; feeling bad because you did something wrong
hi_nuance: 'guilty of' + crime; 'feel guilty about' + action. Hindi speakers say 'I feel guilt' — use 'guilty' (adjective) after 'feel'. Opposite in law: 'innocent'.

examples.en: The jury found him guilty of fraud.
examples.hi: जूरी ने उसे धोखाधड़ी का दोषी पाया।

examples.en: I feel guilty about missing her birthday.
examples.hi: उसका जन्मदिन भूलने पर मुझे अपराधबोध होता है।

examples.en: He looked guilty when I asked about the money.
examples.hi: जब मैंने पैसों के बारे में पूछा तो वह दोषी-सा दिखा।

examples.en: Don't feel guilty for taking a day off.
examples.hi: एक दिन की छुट्टी लेने पर ख़ुद को दोषी मत समझो।

examples.en: She pleaded not guilty.
examples.hi: उसने ख़ुद को निर्दोष बताया।

examples.en: I'm guilty of checking my phone too often.
examples.hi: मैं भी अपना फ़ोन बहुत बार देखने का दोषी हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I feel guilt for not calling my mother.
common_mistake.right: I feel guilty for not calling my mother.
common_mistake.why: After 'feel' use the adjective 'guilty'.

cloze.sentence: He was found ____ and sentenced to two years.

en_def: something you do regularly, often without thinking
hi_nuance: 'have a habit of' + -ing; 'get into/out of the habit'. Indian English 'I have the habit of smoking' is correct; 'habitual' is the adjective. 'Bad habit' is the fixed phrase.

examples.en: He has a habit of interrupting people.
examples.hi: उसे लोगों की बात काटने की आदत है।

examples.en: Biting your nails is a bad habit.
examples.hi: नाख़ून चबाना एक बुरी आदत है।

examples.en: I'm trying to get into the habit of exercising daily.
examples.hi: मैं रोज़ व्यायाम करने की आदत डालने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Old habits die hard.
examples.hi: पुरानी आदतें आसानी से नहीं छूटतीं।

examples.en: She checks her email out of habit.
examples.hi: वह आदतन अपना ईमेल देखती है।

examples.en: Reading before bed is a good habit.
examples.hi: सोने से पहले पढ़ना एक अच्छी आदत है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a habit to wake up late.
common_mistake.right: I have a habit of waking up late.
common_mistake.why: 'habit of' + -ing, not 'habit to'.

cloze.sentence: It's hard to break the ____ of checking your phone at night.

en_def: to deal with a situation or person; to touch or hold something
hi_nuance: Indian English 'handle' is fine for people and tasks ('I'll handle it'). 'Handle with care' on parcels. Don't use 'handle' for driving a car — that's 'drive'.

examples.en: Can you handle the client call this afternoon?
examples.hi: क्या आप आज दोपहर ग्राहक की कॉल संभाल सकते हैं?

examples.en: She handled the complaint very well.
examples.hi: उसने शिकायत को बहुत अच्छे से संभाला।

examples.en: Handle the glass with care.
examples.hi: काँच को सावधानी से पकड़ें।

examples.en: The server can handle a thousand requests per second.
examples.hi: सर्वर प्रति सेकंड एक हज़ार अनुरोध संभाल सकता है।

examples.en: I can't handle the pressure any more.
examples.hi: मैं अब यह दबाव नहीं झेल सकता।

examples.en: Who handles security incidents at your company?
examples.hi: आपकी कंपनी में सुरक्षा घटनाओं को कौन संभालता है?

common_mistake.wrong: He handles the car very well.
common_mistake.right: He drives very well.
common_mistake.why: You 'drive' a car; 'handle' is for situations or objects.

cloze.sentence: The new intern ____ the angry customer surprisingly well.

en_def: to pause before doing or saying something because you are unsure
hi_nuance: 'Don't hesitate to contact me' is the standard email phrase — much better than Indian English 'feel free to revert'. 'Hesitate to' + verb.

examples.en: Don't hesitate to ask if you have questions.
examples.hi: अगर सवाल हों तो पूछने में हिचकिचाएँ नहीं।

examples.en: She hesitated before answering.
examples.hi: जवाब देने से पहले वह झिझकी।

examples.en: He hesitated to accept the offer.
examples.hi: वह प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करने में हिचकिचाया।

examples.en: If you hesitate, you'll miss the chance.
examples.hi: अगर तुम हिचकिचाए तो मौक़ा चूक जाओगे।

examples.en: I wouldn't hesitate to recommend her.
examples.hi: मैं उसकी सिफ़ारिश करने में बिल्कुल नहीं हिचकिचाऊँगा।

examples.en: Without hesitation, he jumped into the water.
examples.hi: बिना झिझक वह पानी में कूद गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please feel free to revert in case of any doubts.
common_mistake.right: Please don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
common_mistake.why: 'revert' and 'doubts' are Indian English; this is the standard closing phrase.

cloze.sentence: She ____ for a moment, then signed the form.

en_def: to recognise someone or something and say who or what they are
hi_nuance: 'identify' = recognise/name; 'identify with' = feel the same as. Common in security: 'identify the root cause'. Hindi speakers use 'find' where 'identify' is more precise.

examples.en: Can you identify the man in this photo?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस तस्वीर में आदमी को पहचान सकते हैं?

examples.en: We identified three critical vulnerabilities.
examples.hi: हमने तीन गंभीर कमज़ोरियों की पहचान की।

examples.en: The body was identified by his brother.
examples.hi: शव की पहचान उसके भाई ने की।

examples.en: First, identify the problem; then fix it.
examples.hi: पहले समस्या पहचानो; फिर उसे ठीक करो।

examples.en: Many readers identify with the main character.
examples.hi: कई पाठक मुख्य पात्र से ख़ुद को जोड़ पाते हैं।

examples.en: Please identify yourself before entering.
examples.hi: प्रवेश से पहले अपनी पहचान बताएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: We found out the root cause as a memory leak.
common_mistake.right: We identified the root cause as a memory leak.
common_mistake.why: 'identify X as Y' is the natural pattern in technical reports.

cloze.sentence: The scanner ____ the malware within seconds.

en_def: to deliberately pay no attention to someone or something
hi_nuance: 'ignore' is deliberate; if you didn't notice, say 'overlook' or 'miss'. Indian English 'kindly ignore my last mail' ✓. Not 'ignore to do' — 'fail to do'.

examples.en: She ignored my message for two days.
examples.hi: उसने मेरे संदेश को दो दिन तक नज़रअंदाज़ किया।

examples.en: Please ignore the previous email.
examples.hi: कृपया पिछले ईमेल को अनदेखा करें।

examples.en: Don't ignore the warning signs.
examples.hi: चेतावनी के संकेतों को नज़रअंदाज़ मत करो।

examples.en: He ignored the doctor's advice.
examples.hi: उसने डॉक्टर की सलाह को अनदेखा किया।

examples.en: The alert was ignored for hours.
examples.hi: अलर्ट को घंटों तक नज़रअंदाज़ किया गया।

examples.en: It's rude to ignore people when they speak to you.
examples.hi: जब कोई आपसे बात करे तो उसे अनदेखा करना अशिष्टता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I ignored to check the logs.
