common_mistake.right: I forgot to check the logs.
common_mistake.why: 'ignore' is not followed by 'to'; use 'forgot to' or 'failed to'.

cloze.sentence: You can't just ____ the problem and hope it goes away.

en_def: to form a picture or idea in your mind; to suppose
hi_nuance: 'imagine' + -ing, or 'imagine that'. Never 'imagine to do'. 'I imagine so' = I suppose so. Hindi speakers use 'think' for everything; 'imagine' adds picture-making.

examples.en: Imagine living without the internet.
examples.hi: इंटरनेट के बिना रहने की कल्पना करो।

examples.en: I can't imagine how hard that was for you.
examples.hi: मैं कल्पना नहीं कर सकता कि यह तुम्हारे लिए कितना मुश्किल था।

examples.en: Just imagine: a house by the sea.
examples.hi: ज़रा सोचो: समुद्र के किनारे एक घर।

examples.en: I imagine she'll be late again.
examples.hi: मुझे लगता है वह फिर देर से आएगी।

examples.en: He imagined that everyone was laughing at him.
examples.hi: उसे लगा कि सब उस पर हँस रहे हैं।

examples.en: You're imagining things; nobody said that.
examples.hi: तुम बेकार की बातें सोच रहे हो; किसी ने ऐसा नहीं कहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I can't imagine to live in another city.
common_mistake.right: I can't imagine living in another city.
common_mistake.why: 'imagine' + -ing, never 'imagine to'.

cloze.sentence: ____ how much time we'd save with automation.

en_def: a strong effect or influence; the force of one object hitting another
hi_nuance: 'impact on/of' + noun. Using 'impact' as a verb ('impacted the users') is common in business but some consider it jargon; 'affect' is safer. Stress: IM-pact (noun).

examples.en: The new policy had a big impact on small businesses.
examples.hi: नई नीति का छोटे व्यवसायों पर बड़ा असर पड़ा।

examples.en: What's the impact of this bug on customers?
examples.hi: इस बग का ग्राहकों पर क्या प्रभाव है?

examples.en: The car was destroyed on impact.
examples.hi: टक्कर लगते ही कार नष्ट हो गई।

examples.en: Social media has a huge impact on teenagers.
examples.hi: सोशल मीडिया का किशोरों पर बहुत बड़ा प्रभाव है।

examples.en: We measured the environmental impact of the factory.
examples.hi: हमने कारख़ाने के पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव को मापा।

examples.en: The breach had a limited impact.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन का प्रभाव सीमित रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: The change will impact on users.
common_mistake.right: The change will have an impact on users.
common_mistake.why: As a verb, 'impact' takes a direct object (impact users); with 'on' use the noun.

cloze.sentence: The outage had a serious ____ on sales.

en_def: not controlled by others; able to do things without help
hi_nuance: 'independent of/from'. Spelled with '-ent', not '-ant'. Indian English uses 'independent' for a girl living alone — fine, but 'self-reliant' is also used.

examples.en: India became independent in 1947.
examples.hi: भारत 1947 में स्वतंत्र हुआ।

examples.en: She's very independent and lives alone.
examples.hi: वह बहुत आत्मनिर्भर है और अकेली रहती है।

examples.en: We need an independent review of the code.
examples.hi: हमें कोड की एक स्वतंत्र समीक्षा चाहिए।

examples.en: The two systems are independent of each other.
examples.hi: दोनों प्रणालियाँ एक-दूसरे से स्वतंत्र हैं।

examples.en: He works as an independent consultant.
examples.hi: वह एक स्वतंत्र सलाहकार के रूप में काम करता है।

examples.en: Children should learn to be independent.
examples.hi: बच्चों को आत्मनिर्भर बनना सीखना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: India got independance in 1947.
common_mistake.right: India gained independence in 1947.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: independence (-ence); and 'gain/win independence'.

cloze.sentence: The audit was carried out by an ____ firm.

en_def: a single person; (adjective) for or relating to one person or thing
hi_nuance: As a noun it's formal (used in reports, law). As an adjective: 'individual attention', 'each individual file'. Hindi speakers sometimes say 'individual person' — redundant.

examples.en: Each individual is responsible for their own password.
examples.hi: हर व्यक्ति अपने पासवर्ड के लिए ख़ुद ज़िम्मेदार है।

examples.en: The teacher gives individual attention to every student.
examples.hi: शिक्षक हर छात्र पर व्यक्तिगत ध्यान देते हैं।

examples.en: Check each individual file for errors.
examples.hi: हर एक फ़ाइल को अलग-अलग जाँचें।

examples.en: The rules apply to companies, not individuals.
examples.hi: ये नियम कंपनियों पर लागू होते हैं, व्यक्तियों पर नहीं।

examples.en: She has a very individual style.
examples.hi: उसकी अपनी अलग ही शैली है।

examples.en: A suspicious individual was seen near the gate.
examples.hi: गेट के पास एक संदिग्ध व्यक्ति देखा गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Every individual person must sign.
common_mistake.right: Every individual must sign.
common_mistake.why: 'individual' already means 'person'; 'individual person' repeats itself.

cloze.sentence: Prices are shown for ____ items, not for the set.

en_def: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves; (verb) to have this effect
hi_nuance: 'influence on/over' someone. Verb takes a direct object: 'influence people', not 'influence on people'. 'Under the influence' = drunk.

examples.en: Her teacher had a big influence on her.
examples.hi: उसके शिक्षक का उस पर बड़ा प्रभाव था।

examples.en: Advertising influences what we buy.
examples.hi: विज्ञापन इस बात को प्रभावित करता है कि हम क्या ख़रीदते हैं।

examples.en: He used his influence to get a job for his nephew.
examples.hi: उसने अपने भतीजे को नौकरी दिलाने के लिए अपने प्रभाव का इस्तेमाल किया।

examples.en: Don't let others influence your decision.
examples.hi: दूसरों को अपने फ़ैसले पर असर मत डालने दो।

examples.en: He was driving under the influence of alcohol.
examples.hi: वह शराब के नशे में गाड़ी चला रहा था।

examples.en: Social media is a powerful influence on young people.
examples.hi: सोशल मीडिया युवाओं पर एक शक्तिशाली प्रभाव है।

common_mistake.wrong: Bad friends influence on your habits.
common_mistake.right: Bad friends influence your habits.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'influence' takes a direct object; 'on' goes only with the noun.

cloze.sentence: Parents have a strong ____ on their children's eating habits.

en_def: to hurt a person or animal physically
hi_nuance: People and animals are 'injured'; things are 'damaged'. 'Injury' is the noun. Hindi speakers say 'he got hurt' (fine) or 'got damaged' (wrong for people).

examples.en: Two people were injured in the crash.
examples.hi: टक्कर में दो लोग घायल हो गए।

examples.en: He injured his knee playing cricket.
examples.hi: क्रिकेट खेलते हुए उसके घुटने में चोट लग गई।

examples.en: Nobody was seriously injured.
examples.hi: किसी को गंभीर चोट नहीं आई।

examples.en: Be careful not to injure yourself.
examples.hi: ध्यान रखो कि तुम्हें चोट न लगे।

examples.en: The injured were taken to hospital.
examples.hi: घायलों को अस्पताल ले जाया गया।

examples.en: She has a minor injury to her hand.
examples.hi: उसके हाथ में मामूली चोट है।

common_mistake.wrong: My leg got damaged in the accident.
common_mistake.right: My leg was injured in the accident.
common_mistake.why: Body parts and people are 'injured'; objects are 'damaged'.

cloze.sentence: The player was ____ in the first half and had to leave.

en_def: to say firmly that something must happen or is true
hi_nuance: 'insist on' + noun/-ing; 'insist that' + clause. Hindi speakers write 'insist to do' ✗. Also 'I insist' alone = polite pressure ('let me pay, I insist').

examples.en: She insisted on paying for dinner.
examples.hi: उसने रात के खाने का बिल देने पर ज़ोर दिया।

examples.en: He insists that he locked the door.
examples.hi: वह ज़ोर देकर कहता है कि उसने दरवाज़ा बंद किया था।

examples.en: They insisted we stay for tea.
examples.hi: उन्होंने ज़ोर दिया कि हम चाय के लिए रुकें।

examples.en: If you insist, I'll have one more.
examples.hi: अगर आप ज़ोर देते हैं तो मैं एक और ले लूँगा।

examples.en: The client insists on daily updates.
examples.hi: ग्राहक रोज़ अपडेट पर ज़ोर देता है।

examples.en: I insist on a written apology.
examples.hi: मैं लिखित माफ़ी की माँग करता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: He insisted to come with us.
common_mistake.right: He insisted on coming with us.
common_mistake.why: 'insist on' + -ing, never 'insist to'.

cloze.sentence: My grandmother ____ that we eat before we leave.

en_def: to have a plan in your mind to do something
hi_nuance: 'intend to' + verb. More formal than 'plan to'. 'Intended for' = designed for. Hindi speakers say 'I am intending' — use the simple form 'I intend'.

examples.en: I intend to finish the course by December.
examples.hi: मेरा इरादा दिसंबर तक कोर्स पूरा करने का है।

examples.en: We didn't intend to cause any trouble.
examples.hi: हमारा कोई परेशानी पैदा करने का इरादा नहीं था।

examples.en: This tool is intended for advanced users.
examples.hi: यह टूल उन्नत उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए बना है।

examples.en: What do you intend to do about it?
examples.hi: इस बारे में आप क्या करने का इरादा रखते हैं?

examples.en: She intends to apply for a visa next year.
examples.hi: वह अगले साल वीज़ा के लिए आवेदन करने का इरादा रखती है।

examples.en: The joke wasn't intended to offend anyone.
examples.hi: मज़ाक का इरादा किसी को ठेस पहुँचाना नहीं था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am intending to change my job.
common_mistake.right: I intend to change my job.
common_mistake.why: 'intend' is a state verb; use the simple present.

cloze.sentence: The message was ____ for my manager, not for the whole team.

en_def: to include something as a necessary part; to make someone take part
hi_nuance: 'involve' + -ing; 'be involved in' something. Indian English 'involve into' ✗. 'Get involved' = take part. Not used in continuous when meaning 'include'.

examples.en: The job involves a lot of travel.
examples.hi: इस नौकरी में बहुत यात्रा शामिल है।

examples.en: Don't involve me in your argument.
examples.hi: मुझे अपनी बहस में मत घसीटो।

examples.en: She's involved in a new project.
examples.hi: वह एक नए प्रोजेक्ट में शामिल है।

examples.en: Fixing this will involve rewriting the module.
examples.hi: इसे ठीक करने में मॉड्यूल को फिर से लिखना शामिल होगा।

examples.en: How many people were involved in the attack?
examples.hi: हमले में कितने लोग शामिल थे?

examples.en: I want to get more involved in the community.
examples.hi: मैं समुदाय में और ज़्यादा शामिल होना चाहता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: He is involved into some illegal business.
common_mistake.right: He is involved in some illegal business.
common_mistake.why: 'involved in' is the fixed preposition.

cloze.sentence: The role ____ managing a team of five.

en_def: to form an opinion about something; (noun) the person who decides in a court or competition
hi_nuance: 'judge by/from' evidence; 'judging by' = based on. 'Don't judge me' = don't criticise. The noun 'judgement' (British) / 'judgment' (US) — Indian spelling uses 'judgement'.

examples.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
examples.hi: किताब को उसके कवर से मत आँको।

examples.en: Judging by his accent, he's from Gujarat.
examples.hi: उसके लहजे से लगता है वह गुजरात से है।

examples.en: The judge sentenced him to five years.
examples.hi: न्यायाधीश ने उसे पाँच साल की सज़ा सुनाई।

examples.en: It's hard to judge the size from a photo.
examples.hi: तस्वीर से आकार का अंदाज़ा लगाना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: She was one of the judges at the science fair.
examples.hi: वह विज्ञान मेले की जजों में से एक थी।

examples.en: You can't judge people by their clothes.
examples.hi: लोगों को उनके कपड़ों से नहीं आँका जा सकता।

common_mistake.wrong: According to my judgement, he is right.
common_mistake.right: In my judgement, he is right.
common_mistake.why: The phrase is 'in my judgement' or simply 'I think'.

cloze.sentence: ____ from the queue outside, the restaurant must be good.

en_def: the state of not having something, or not having enough of it
hi_nuance: 'lack of' + noun (noun); 'lack' + noun (verb, no 'of'). Indian English 'due to lack of time' ✓; 'he lacks of confidence' ✗ → 'he lacks confidence'.

examples.en: The project failed because of a lack of funding.
examples.hi: धन की कमी के कारण प्रोजेक्ट विफल हो गया।

examples.en: He lacks the experience for this role.
examples.hi: उसमें इस भूमिका के लिए अनुभव की कमी है।

examples.en: There's no lack of talent in this team.
examples.hi: इस टीम में प्रतिभा की कोई कमी नहीं है।

examples.en: Lack of sleep affects concentration.
examples.hi: नींद की कमी एकाग्रता पर असर डालती है।

examples.en: The report lacks detail.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट में विवरण की कमी है।

examples.en: Many rural areas lack clean water.
examples.hi: कई ग्रामीण इलाक़ों में साफ़ पानी की कमी है।

common_mistake.wrong: She lacks of confidence.
common_mistake.right: She lacks confidence.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'lack' takes a direct object; 'of' is only used with the noun 'a lack of'.

cloze.sentence: The main problem in the village is a ____ of doctors.

en_def: the greatest amount or level allowed; (verb) to keep something below a certain amount
hi_nuance: 'limit on' + noun; 'limit to' + amount; 'limit yourself to'. 'Limited' = restricted. Indian English 'time limit' ✓; 'speed limit' ✓.

examples.en: There's a limit on how much you can withdraw.
examples.hi: आप कितना पैसा निकाल सकते हैं, इसकी एक सीमा है।

examples.en: He was driving over the speed limit.
examples.hi: वह गति सीमा से ऊपर गाड़ी चला रहा था।

examples.en: Limit your screen time to two hours a day.
examples.hi: अपना स्क्रीन समय दिन में दो घंटे तक सीमित रखें।

examples.en: Our budget is limited.
examples.hi: हमारा बजट सीमित है।

examples.en: Everything has its limits.
examples.hi: हर चीज़ की एक हद होती है।

examples.en: We limited access to the admin panel.
examples.hi: हमने एडमिन पैनल तक पहुँच सीमित कर दी।

common_mistake.wrong: The government limited on the number of visas.
common_mistake.right: The government limited the number of visas.
common_mistake.why: The verb 'limit' takes a direct object; 'on' is for the noun 'a limit on'.

cloze.sentence: There's no ____ to what you can achieve with practice.

en_def: to keep something in good condition or at the same level; to state firmly
hi_nuance: Indian English 'maintain' is often used for records ('maintain a register') — correct. Also 'maintain a distance', 'maintain silence'. The noun is 'maintenance' (spelling!).

examples.en: It's expensive to maintain an old car.
examples.hi: पुरानी कार का रख-रखाव महँगा है।

examples.en: Try to maintain a healthy weight.
examples.hi: स्वस्थ वज़न बनाए रखने की कोशिश करें।

examples.en: Who maintains this code now?
examples.hi: अब इस कोड का रख-रखाव कौन करता है?

examples.en: She maintained that she was innocent.
examples.hi: वह लगातार कहती रही कि वह निर्दोष है।

examples.en: We need to maintain good relations with the client.
examples.hi: हमें ग्राहक के साथ अच्छे संबंध बनाए रखने होंगे।

examples.en: The site is down for maintenance.
examples.hi: साइट रख-रखाव के लिए बंद है।

common_mistake.wrong: The lift is under maintainance.
common_mistake.right: The lift is under maintenance.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: main-ten-ance.

cloze.sentence: Regular updates help ____ the security of the system.

en_def: to succeed in doing something difficult; to be in charge of
hi_nuance: 'manage to' + verb = succeed after difficulty. Indian English 'I will manage' (I'll cope) is correct and natural. 'Manage a team' = be the boss of.

examples.en: I managed to finish the report on time.
examples.hi: मैं समय पर रिपोर्ट पूरी कर पाया।

examples.en: She manages a team of ten developers.
examples.hi: वह दस डेवलपरों की टीम का प्रबंधन करती है।

examples.en: How do you manage with three kids and a job?
examples.hi: तीन बच्चों और नौकरी के साथ आप कैसे संभालती हैं?

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll manage.
examples.hi: चिंता मत करो, मैं संभाल लूँगा।

examples.en: We couldn't manage without your help.
examples.hi: आपकी मदद के बिना हम नहीं संभाल पाते।

examples.en: He manages his time very well.
examples.hi: वह अपना समय बहुत अच्छे से प्रबंधित करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I managed for finishing the work.
common_mistake.right: I managed to finish the work.
common_mistake.why: 'manage to' + base verb.

cloze.sentence: Despite the traffic, we ____ to reach the airport in time.

en_def: to find the size, amount, or degree of something; (noun) an action taken to achieve something
hi_nuance: Noun sense 'take measures' = take action (common in security: 'security measures'). Hindi speakers say 'take steps' — both are fine. Pronounced MEZH-uh.

examples.en: Measure the room before you buy the carpet.
examples.hi: कालीन ख़रीदने से पहले कमरा नाप लो।

examples.en: The table measures two metres by one.
examples.hi: मेज़ दो मीटर गुणा एक मीटर की है।

examples.en: We took measures to prevent another breach.
examples.hi: हमने एक और उल्लंघन रोकने के लिए क़दम उठाए।

examples.en: How do you measure success?
examples.hi: आप सफलता को कैसे मापते हैं?

examples.en: Security measures were tightened at the airport.
examples.hi: हवाई अड्डे पर सुरक्षा उपाय कड़े कर दिए गए।

examples.en: The doctor measured my blood pressure.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने मेरा रक्तचाप मापा।

common_mistake.wrong: We did measures to secure the network.
common_mistake.right: We took measures to secure the network.
common_mistake.why: 'take measures' is the fixed collocation.

cloze.sentence: The app ____ how many steps you walk each day.

en_def: the way you feel at a particular time
hi_nuance: 'in a good/bad mood', 'in the mood for' + noun/-ing. Indian English 'mood off' ✗ → 'in a bad mood'. Also 'not in the mood' = don't feel like it.

examples.en: He's in a bad mood this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह उसका मूड ख़राब है।

examples.en: I'm not in the mood for a party.
examples.hi: मेरा पार्टी का मन नहीं है।

examples.en: The good news put everyone in a great mood.
examples.hi: अच्छी ख़बर ने सबका मूड बढ़िया कर दिया।

examples.en: Her mood changes very quickly.
examples.hi: उसका मिज़ाज बहुत जल्दी बदलता है।

examples.en: Are you in the mood for pizza?
examples.hi: क्या पिज़्ज़ा खाने का मन है?

examples.en: Music can lift your mood.
examples.hi: संगीत आपका मूड बेहतर कर सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Today my mood is off.
common_mistake.right: I'm in a bad mood today.
common_mistake.why: 'mood off' is Indian English; use 'in a bad mood'.

cloze.sentence: After the win, the whole office was in a great ____.

en_def: easy to see or understand; clear
hi_nuance: 'It is obvious that' / 'obvious to' someone. 'Obviously' at the start can sound rude (as if the listener is stupid); use 'clearly' in formal writing.

examples.en: It's obvious that he's lying.
examples.hi: यह ज़ाहिर है कि वह झूठ बोल रहा है।

examples.en: The answer was obvious to everyone.
examples.hi: जवाब सबके लिए स्पष्ट था।

examples.en: For obvious reasons, we can't share the password.
examples.hi: ज़ाहिर कारणों से हम पासवर्ड साझा नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: There's no obvious cause for the crash.
examples.hi: क्रैश का कोई स्पष्ट कारण नहीं है।

examples.en: Obviously, we need more time.
examples.hi: ज़ाहिर है, हमें और समय चाहिए।

examples.en: The typo was so obvious that I missed it.
examples.hi: टाइपो इतना ज़ाहिर था कि मुझसे छूट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Obviously you don't know how to use it.
common_mistake.right: It looks like you're not familiar with it yet.
common_mistake.why: 'obviously' about a person can sound insulting; soften it.

cloze.sentence: The most ____ solution is often the right one.

en_def: a particular time when something happens; a special event
hi_nuance: 'on this occasion', 'on several occasions', 'a special occasion'. Hindi 'मौक़ा' is also 'opportunity/chance', which is a different English word. Spelling: one 'c', two 's'.

examples.en: We only eat out on special occasions.
examples.hi: हम सिर्फ़ ख़ास मौक़ों पर बाहर खाना खाते हैं।

examples.en: I've met him on several occasions.
examples.hi: मैं उससे कई मौक़ों पर मिल चुका हूँ।

examples.en: A wedding is a big occasion in India.
examples.hi: भारत में शादी एक बड़ा समारोह है।

examples.en: On this occasion, I'll let it go.
examples.hi: इस बार मैं इसे जाने देता हूँ।

examples.en: She wore a sari for the occasion.
examples.hi: उसने इस अवसर के लिए साड़ी पहनी।

examples.en: Occasionally we work on Saturdays.
examples.hi: कभी-कभी हम शनिवार को काम करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I did not get an occasion to meet him.
common_mistake.right: I did not get a chance to meet him.
common_mistake.why: 'occasion' is an event; a possibility to do something is a 'chance' or 'opportunity'.

cloze.sentence: Diwali is an ____ for the whole family to come together.

en_def: to plan and arrange an event or activity; to put things in order
hi_nuance: British spelling 'organise'; US 'organize'. Indian English 'organise' is fine for events. 'Organised' (adjective) = tidy and efficient; 'organisation' = a company or group.

examples.en: Who is organising the team outing?
examples.hi: टीम की सैर का आयोजन कौन कर रहा है?

examples.en: I need to organise my files.
examples.hi: मुझे अपनी फ़ाइलें व्यवस्थित करनी हैं।

examples.en: She's very organised and never misses a deadline.
examples.hi: वह बहुत व्यवस्थित है और कभी समय-सीमा नहीं चूकती।

examples.en: They organised a protest outside the office.
examples.hi: उन्होंने दफ़्तर के बाहर विरोध प्रदर्शन आयोजित किया।

examples.en: The workshop was well organised.
examples.hi: कार्यशाला का आयोजन अच्छे से हुआ था।

examples.en: Let's organise the tasks by priority.
examples.hi: चलो कामों को प्राथमिकता के हिसाब से व्यवस्थित करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We are organising a get-together on coming Saturday.
common_mistake.right: We are organising a get-together next Saturday.
common_mistake.why: 'coming Saturday' is Indian English; say 'next Saturday' or 'this Saturday'.

cloze.sentence: The college ____ a job fair every spring.

en_def: if not; in a different way; apart from that
hi_nuance: 'otherwise' = 'if not', usually after a comma or semicolon. Hindi speakers use 'or else' (a threat) or 'if not so'. Also 'unless otherwise stated' in formal texts.

examples.en: Leave now; otherwise you'll miss the train.
examples.hi: अभी निकलो; वरना ट्रेन छूट जाएगी।

examples.en: Back up your data, otherwise you could lose it.
examples.hi: अपने डेटा का बैकअप लो, नहीं तो वह खो सकता है।

examples.en: The room was small but otherwise fine.
examples.hi: कमरा छोटा था लेकिन बाक़ी सब ठीक था।

examples.en: Unless otherwise stated, all prices include tax.
examples.hi: जब तक अन्यथा न कहा जाए, सभी क़ीमतों में कर शामिल है।

examples.en: I thought otherwise.
examples.hi: मैंने कुछ और ही सोचा था।

examples.en: Wear a jacket; otherwise you'll be cold.
examples.hi: जैकेट पहन लो; वरना ठंड लगेगी।

common_mistake.wrong: Finish it today, or else.
common_mistake.right: Finish it today; otherwise we'll miss the deadline.
common_mistake.why: 'or else' alone is a threat in English; 'otherwise' states the consequence neutrally.

cloze.sentence: Set a reminder; ____ you'll forget the appointment.

en_def: to take part in an activity or event
hi_nuance: 'participate in', never 'participate at' or 'participate to'. More formal than 'take part in' or 'join in'. Noun: 'participant'.

examples.en: Everyone is welcome to participate in the survey.
examples.hi: सर्वेक्षण में भाग लेने के लिए सभी का स्वागत है।

examples.en: She participated in the marathon last year.
examples.hi: उसने पिछले साल मैराथन में भाग लिया।

examples.en: Only a few students participated in the discussion.
examples.hi: केवल कुछ छात्रों ने चर्चा में भाग लिया।

examples.en: Thank you for participating.
examples.hi: भाग लेने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: All participants will receive a certificate.
examples.hi: सभी प्रतिभागियों को प्रमाणपत्र मिलेगा।

examples.en: He refused to participate in the strike.
examples.hi: उसने हड़ताल में भाग लेने से इनकार कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I participated the competition.
common_mistake.right: I participated in the competition.
common_mistake.why: 'participate in' always needs 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Over 200 companies ____ in the security conference.

en_def: to do a task or action; to entertain an audience; to work well or badly
hi_nuance: 'perform a task/test/operation' (formal 'do'); 'the app performs well' = works well. Indian English 'perform the needful' ✗. Noun: 'performance' (also for job reviews).

examples.en: The surgeon performed the operation in two hours.
examples.hi: सर्जन ने दो घंटे में ऑपरेशन किया।

examples.en: The band performed for a huge crowd.
examples.hi: बैंड ने विशाल भीड़ के सामने प्रदर्शन किया।

examples.en: The new laptop performs much better.
examples.hi: नया लैपटॉप कहीं बेहतर काम करता है।

examples.en: We performed a full scan of the network.
examples.hi: हमने नेटवर्क का पूरा स्कैन किया।

examples.en: She performed well in the interview.
examples.hi: उसने इंटरव्यू में अच्छा प्रदर्शन किया।

examples.en: Your performance review is next week.
examples.hi: तुम्हारी प्रदर्शन समीक्षा अगले हफ़्ते है।

common_mistake.wrong: The team has performed very good this quarter.
common_mistake.right: The team has performed very well this quarter.
common_mistake.why: After a verb, use the adverb 'well', not the adjective 'good'.

cloze.sentence: The system ____ poorly under heavy load.

en_def: to make someone agree to do something by giving good reasons
hi_nuance: 'persuade someone to' + verb. 'Convince' = make someone believe; 'persuade' = make someone act. Hindi 'मनाना' also means 'celebrate', which is a different word.

examples.en: I persuaded my boss to give me Friday off.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने बॉस को शुक्रवार की छुट्टी देने के लिए मना लिया।

examples.en: She wasn't easy to persuade.
examples.hi: उसे मनाना आसान नहीं था।

examples.en: They persuaded him not to resign.
examples.hi: उन्होंने उसे इस्तीफ़ा न देने के लिए राज़ी किया।

examples.en: Nothing will persuade me to fly in this weather.
examples.hi: इस मौसम में उड़ान भरने के लिए मुझे कोई नहीं मना सकता।

examples.en: The salesman persuaded us to buy the extended warranty.
examples.hi: सेल्समैन ने हमें बढ़ी हुई वारंटी ख़रीदने के लिए राज़ी कर लिया।

examples.en: His argument was very persuasive.
examples.hi: उसका तर्क बहुत प्रभावशाली था।

common_mistake.wrong: I persuaded him for joining the gym.
common_mistake.right: I persuaded him to join the gym.
common_mistake.why: 'persuade someone to' + base verb.

cloze.sentence: Can you ____ her to come to the party?

en_def: to have or own something, especially a quality or skill (formal)
hi_def: रखना, के पास होना, स्वामी होना
hi_nuance: Formal; in everyday speech use 'have' or 'own'. Common in CVs: 'possess strong communication skills'. Not used in continuous forms. Spelling: double s twice.

examples.en: She possesses excellent analytical skills.
examples.hi: उसके पास बेहतरीन विश्लेषणात्मक कौशल हैं।

examples.en: He was arrested for possessing stolen goods.
examples.hi: चोरी का सामान रखने के लिए उसे गिरफ़्तार किया गया।

examples.en: The company possesses valuable patents.
examples.hi: कंपनी के पास मूल्यवान पेटेंट हैं।

examples.en: The attacker possessed valid credentials.
examples.hi: हमलावर के पास वैध क्रेडेंशियल थे।

examples.en: Do you possess a driving licence?
examples.hi: क्या आपके पास ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस है?

examples.en: What possessed you to say that?
examples.hi: तुम्हें ऐसा कहने की क्या सूझी?

common_mistake.wrong: I am possessing three years of experience.
common_mistake.right: I have three years of experience.
common_mistake.why: 'possess' is a state verb and formal; use simple 'have' in most contexts.

cloze.sentence: The ideal candidate will ____ strong problem-solving skills.

en_def: the force of trying to persuade or making demands on someone; physical force pressing on something
hi_nuance: 'under pressure', 'put pressure on', 'pressure to' + verb. Indian English 'work pressure' and 'BP (blood pressure)' are correct. Pronounced PRESH-uh.

examples.en: I'm under a lot of pressure at work.
examples.hi: काम पर मुझ पर बहुत दबाव है।

examples.en: Don't put pressure on him to decide today.
examples.hi: आज ही फ़ैसला करने के लिए उस पर दबाव मत डालो।

examples.en: She works well under pressure.
examples.hi: वह दबाव में अच्छा काम करती है।

examples.en: Check the tyre pressure before a long trip.
examples.hi: लंबी यात्रा से पहले टायर का दबाव जाँच लें।

examples.en: There's pressure to release before the competitor does.
examples.hi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी से पहले रिलीज़ करने का दबाव है।

examples.en: His blood pressure is a bit high.
examples.hi: उसका रक्तचाप थोड़ा ज़्यादा है।

common_mistake.wrong: My boss is giving me pressure to finish it.
common_mistake.right: My boss is putting pressure on me to finish it.
common_mistake.why: 'put pressure on' is the correct collocation, not 'give pressure'.

cloze.sentence: The goalkeeper stayed calm under ____ and saved the penalty.

en_def: to stop something from happening or someone from doing something
hi_nuance: 'prevent something' or 'prevent someone from doing'. Hindi speakers write 'prevent to do' ✗. 'Prevention is better than cure' is the fixed proverb.

examples.en: Regular hand-washing prevents infection.
examples.hi: नियमित हाथ धोने से संक्रमण से बचाव होता है।

examples.en: The rain prevented us from going out.
examples.hi: बारिश ने हमें बाहर जाने से रोक दिया।

examples.en: A firewall helps prevent unauthorised access.
examples.hi: फ़ायरवॉल अनधिकृत पहुँच को रोकने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: Nothing could prevent the accident.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना को कुछ भी नहीं रोक सका।

examples.en: Prevention is better than cure.
examples.hi: इलाज से बचाव बेहतर है।

examples.en: We took steps to prevent it happening again.
examples.hi: हमने इसे दोबारा होने से रोकने के लिए क़दम उठाए।

common_mistake.wrong: The lock prevents to open the door.
common_mistake.right: The lock prevents the door from being opened.
common_mistake.why: 'prevent' + object (+ 'from' + -ing); never 'prevent to'.

cloze.sentence: Wearing a seatbelt can ____ serious injury.

en_def: happening or existing before the one you are talking about
hi_nuance: 'previous' comes before the noun: 'the previous day', 'my previous job'. 'Previously' = before. Indian English uses 'last' where 'previous' is clearer (last = most recent).

examples.en: In my previous job, I worked on firewalls.
examples.hi: अपनी पिछली नौकरी में मैं फ़ायरवॉल पर काम करता था।

examples.en: See the previous page for details.
examples.hi: विवरण के लिए पिछला पेज देखें।

examples.en: The previous owner never serviced the car.
examples.hi: पिछले मालिक ने कभी कार की सर्विस नहीं कराई।

examples.en: He had no previous experience of coding.
examples.hi: उसे कोडिंग का कोई पूर्व अनुभव नहीं था।

examples.en: As previously mentioned, the deadline is Friday.
examples.hi: जैसा पहले बताया गया, समय-सीमा शुक्रवार है।

examples.en: The previous version had a security flaw.
examples.hi: पिछले संस्करण में सुरक्षा की खामी थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I have told you in my last mail itself.
common_mistake.right: I told you in my previous email.
common_mistake.why: 'itself' for emphasis is Indian English; 'previous' is clearer than 'last'.

cloze.sentence: This year's results are much better than the ____ year's.

en_def: to give someone a higher job; to encourage or advertise something
hi_def: पदोन्नति देना; बढ़ावा देना, प्रचार करना
hi_nuance: 'be promoted to' + position. Indian English 'get promotion' → 'get a promotion' or 'be promoted'. Also 'promote a product', 'promote good health'.

examples.en: She was promoted to senior engineer last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने उसे सीनियर इंजीनियर के पद पर पदोन्नत किया गया।

examples.en: The campaign promotes healthy eating.
examples.hi: यह अभियान स्वस्थ खान-पान को बढ़ावा देता है।

examples.en: They're promoting the new phone on TV.
examples.hi: वे टीवी पर नए फ़ोन का प्रचार कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: Good managers promote teamwork.
examples.hi: अच्छे मैनेजर टीमवर्क को बढ़ावा देते हैं।

examples.en: He hopes to get promoted this year.
examples.hi: उसे उम्मीद है कि इस साल उसकी पदोन्नति होगी।

examples.en: The school promotes reading from an early age.
examples.hi: स्कूल कम उम्र से ही पढ़ने को बढ़ावा देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I got promotion as team lead.
common_mistake.right: I was promoted to team lead.
common_mistake.why: 'be promoted to' + role; or 'get a promotion' with the article.

cloze.sentence: The company ____ from within whenever possible.

en_def: facts or documents that show something is true
hi_nuance: Usually uncountable: 'proof of', 'have proof'. Indian English 'ID proof' and 'address proof' are fine locally; internationally say 'proof of identity/address'. The verb is 'prove'.

examples.en: Do you have any proof that he took it?
examples.hi: क्या आपके पास कोई सबूत है कि उसने इसे लिया?

examples.en: Bring proof of address to open an account.
examples.hi: खाता खोलने के लिए पते का प्रमाण लाएँ।

examples.en: There's no proof the email came from him.
examples.hi: इसका कोई सबूत नहीं कि ईमेल उसने भेजा था।

examples.en: The burden of proof is on the prosecution.
examples.hi: सबूत का भार अभियोजन पक्ष पर है।

examples.en: We need proof of concept before funding.
examples.hi: धन देने से पहले हमें अवधारणा का प्रमाण चाहिए।

examples.en: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
examples.hi: ख़रीद के प्रमाण के रूप में रसीद रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please carry one ID proof.
common_mistake.right: Please bring proof of identity.
common_mistake.why: 'ID proof' is Indian English; 'proof of identity' is standard.

cloze.sentence: The screenshot was ____ that the message had been sent.

en_def: the reason for doing or making something
hi_nuance: 'the purpose of' + noun; 'for the purpose of'; 'on purpose' = deliberately. Indian English 'what is the purpose of your visit' ✓. Pronounced PUR-puss (not 'pur-pose').

examples.en: What's the purpose of this meeting?
examples.hi: इस बैठक का उद्देश्य क्या है?

examples.en: He broke it on purpose.
examples.hi: उसने जानबूझकर इसे तोड़ा।

examples.en: The purpose of the test is to find weak points.
examples.hi: परीक्षण का उद्देश्य कमज़ोर बिंदु ढूँढ़ना है।

examples.en: She travelled to Delhi for business purposes.
examples.hi: वह व्यावसायिक उद्देश्य से दिल्ली गई।

examples.en: This tool is not fit for purpose.
examples.hi: यह उपकरण अपने काम के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है।

examples.en: Learning gives my mornings a purpose.
examples.hi: सीखने से मेरी सुबह को एक मक़सद मिलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He did it purposely to annoy me.
common_mistake.right: He did it on purpose to annoy me.
common_mistake.why: 'on purpose' is the everyday phrase; 'purposely' is rare and formal.

cloze.sentence: The main ____ of the audit is to check compliance.

en_def: not common; not happening often
hi_nuance: 'rarely' = not often (formal 'seldom'). For steak, 'rare' = lightly cooked. Hindi speakers say 'very less found' — use 'rare'.

examples.en: Snow is rare in Mumbai.
examples.hi: मुंबई में बर्फ़बारी दुर्लभ है।

examples.en: It's rare to see him angry.
examples.hi: उसे गुस्से में देखना विरला ही होता है।

examples.en: She collects rare coins.
examples.hi: वह दुर्लभ सिक्के इकट्ठा करती है।

examples.en: I rarely eat fast food.
examples.hi: मैं शायद ही कभी फ़ास्ट फ़ूड खाता हूँ।

examples.en: This is a rare opportunity; don't miss it.
examples.hi: यह एक दुर्लभ अवसर है; इसे मत गँवाओ।

examples.en: Such attacks are rare but very damaging.
examples.hi: ऐसे हमले दुर्लभ हैं लेकिन बहुत नुक़सानदेह हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Such birds are very less in this area.
common_mistake.right: Such birds are very rare in this area.
common_mistake.why: 'very less' is not English; use 'rare' or 'few'.

cloze.sentence: It's ____ for the whole team to be in the office at once.

en_def: fair and sensible; (of prices) not too expensive
hi_nuance: 'reasonable price' = not too high; 'reasonable person' = sensible. Indian English 'cheap and best' ✗ → 'good value' or 'reasonably priced'.

examples.en: The hotel was clean and the prices were reasonable.
examples.hi: होटल साफ़ था और क़ीमतें वाजिब थीं।

examples.en: Be reasonable; we can't finish it in one day.
examples.hi: समझदारी से सोचो; हम इसे एक दिन में पूरा नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: It's reasonable to ask for a refund.
examples.hi: रिफ़ंड माँगना उचित है।

examples.en: She gave a reasonable explanation.
examples.hi: उसने एक वाजिब सफ़ाई दी।

examples.en: The restaurant is reasonably priced.
examples.hi: रेस्तराँ की क़ीमतें किफ़ायती हैं।

examples.en: We have reasonable grounds to suspect fraud.
examples.hi: हमारे पास धोखाधड़ी का संदेह करने के उचित आधार हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This shop is cheap and best.
common_mistake.right: This shop is good value for money.
common_mistake.why: 'cheap and best' is Indian English; use 'good value' or 'reasonably priced'.

cloze.sentence: Two weeks is a ____ amount of time to review the contract.

en_def: to know someone or something because you have seen them before; to accept that something is true or valuable
hi_nuance: 'recognise' (identify a known face/voice) ≠ 'realise' (understand). Hindi 'पहचानना' = recognise. Also 'recognise someone's work' = give credit.

examples.en: I didn't recognise you with your new haircut.
examples.hi: नए बाल कटवाने के बाद मैं तुम्हें पहचान नहीं पाया।

examples.en: Do you recognise this voice?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस आवाज़ को पहचानते हैं?

examples.en: The company recognises hard work with bonuses.
examples.hi: कंपनी मेहनत को बोनस से मान्यता देती है।

examples.en: He recognised that he had made a mistake.
examples.hi: उसने माना कि उससे गलती हुई है।

examples.en: The certificate is recognised worldwide.
examples.hi: यह प्रमाणपत्र दुनिया भर में मान्य है।

examples.en: The antivirus failed to recognise the threat.
examples.hi: एंटीवायरस ख़तरे को पहचानने में विफल रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I realised him from his voice.
common_mistake.right: I recognised him from his voice.
common_mistake.why: 'recognise' = identify someone known; 'realise' = understand.

cloze.sentence: The system ____ your fingerprint and unlocks the door.

en_def: to make something smaller or less
hi_nuance: 'reduce by' (amount) vs 'reduce to' (final level). Indian English 'reduce the weight' → 'lose weight'. Noun: 'reduction'.

examples.en: We need to reduce costs by 15%.
examples.hi: हमें लागत 15% घटानी होगी।

examples.en: The speed limit was reduced to 30 km/h.
examples.hi: गति सीमा घटाकर 30 किमी/घंटा कर दी गई।

examples.en: Exercise reduces stress.
examples.hi: व्यायाम तनाव कम करता है।

examples.en: Prices have been reduced for the sale.
examples.hi: सेल के लिए क़ीमतें घटाई गई हैं।

examples.en: Caching reduced the load time by half.
examples.hi: कैशिंग ने लोड समय आधा कर दिया।

examples.en: We must reduce our plastic use.
examples.hi: हमें प्लास्टिक का उपयोग कम करना होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to reduce my weight.
common_mistake.right: I want to lose weight.
common_mistake.why: The natural collocation is 'lose weight'; 'reduce' is for costs, risks, and amounts.

cloze.sentence: The new filter ____ spam by about 90%.

en_def: the way two people, groups, or things are connected or behave towards each other
hi_nuance: 'relationship with/between'. In Indian English 'relation' is used for family members ('he is my relation'); English says 'relative'. 'Relationship' also means a romantic partnership.

examples.en: She has a good relationship with her manager.
examples.hi: उसके अपने मैनेजर के साथ अच्छे संबंध हैं।

examples.en: The relationship between sleep and memory is well known.
examples.hi: नींद और याददाश्त के बीच का संबंध जाना-पहचाना है।

examples.en: They've been in a relationship for two years.
examples.hi: वे दो साल से रिश्ते में हैं।

examples.en: Trust is the basis of any relationship.
examples.hi: भरोसा किसी भी रिश्ते का आधार है।

examples.en: We want a long-term relationship with our clients.
examples.hi: हम अपने ग्राहकों के साथ दीर्घकालिक संबंध चाहते हैं।

examples.en: Their working relationship broke down.
examples.hi: उनका कामकाजी रिश्ता टूट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: He is my close relation.
common_mistake.right: He is a close relative of mine.
common_mistake.why: A family member is a 'relative'; 'relation' is used abstractly (in relation to).

cloze.sentence: A good ____ with your neighbours makes life easier.

en_def: able to be trusted to work well or behave as expected
hi_nuance: Used for people, machines, information. Indian English 'trustworthy' is fine for people, but a car or a source is 'reliable'. Noun: 'reliability'.

examples.en: He's a reliable colleague; he never lets you down.
examples.hi: वह भरोसेमंद सहकर्मी है; वह कभी निराश नहीं करता।

examples.en: Is this website a reliable source?
examples.hi: क्या यह वेबसाइट एक विश्वसनीय स्रोत है?

examples.en: The old bike is slow but reliable.
examples.hi: पुरानी बाइक धीमी है लेकिन भरोसेमंद है।

examples.en: We need a more reliable internet connection.
examples.hi: हमें ज़्यादा भरोसेमंद इंटरनेट कनेक्शन चाहिए।

examples.en: The tests make the code more reliable.
examples.hi: टेस्ट कोड को ज़्यादा विश्वसनीय बनाते हैं।

examples.en: Reliable data is hard to find on this topic.
examples.hi: इस विषय पर विश्वसनीय डेटा मिलना मुश्किल है।

common_mistake.wrong: This information is not trustable.
common_mistake.right: This information is not reliable.
common_mistake.why: 'trustable' is not standard; use 'reliable' or 'trustworthy'.

cloze.sentence: We chose the supplier because they are ____ and deliver on time.

en_def: to depend on someone or something; to trust them to do what you need
hi_nuance: Always 'rely on', never 'rely upon' in speech or 'rely in'. Spelling changes: rely → relies → relied → relying.

examples.en: You can rely on me.
examples.hi: तुम मुझ पर भरोसा कर सकते हो।

examples.en: Many farmers rely on the monsoon.
examples.hi: कई किसान मानसून पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

examples.en: Don't rely on one backup.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ एक बैकअप पर निर्भर मत रहो।

examples.en: The app relies on a stable connection.
examples.hi: ऐप एक स्थिर कनेक्शन पर निर्भर करता है।

examples.en: She relied heavily on her notes during the talk.
examples.hi: भाषण के दौरान वह अपने नोट्स पर बहुत निर्भर रही।

examples.en: We can't rely on luck.
examples.hi: हम क़िस्मत पर भरोसा नहीं कर सकते।

common_mistake.wrong: We are relying in the vendor for support.
common_mistake.right: We rely on the vendor for support.
common_mistake.why: 'rely on' is the only correct preposition.

cloze.sentence: Small businesses often ____ on word of mouth.

en_def: to make someone remember something; to make someone think of something similar
hi_nuance: 'remind someone to do', 'remind someone of/about something'. 'Remind' (someone else) vs 'remember' (yourself). Indian English 'kindly remind' ✗ → 'please remind me'.

examples.en: Remind me to call the bank tomorrow.
examples.hi: मुझे कल बैंक को फ़ोन करने की याद दिलाना।

examples.en: This song reminds me of my college days.
examples.hi: यह गाना मुझे मेरे कॉलेज के दिनों की याद दिलाता है।

examples.en: Can you remind him about the meeting?
examples.hi: क्या तुम उसे बैठक के बारे में याद दिला सकते हो?

examples.en: She reminds me of my sister.
examples.hi: वह मुझे मेरी बहन की याद दिलाती है।

examples.en: I set a reminder for the deadline.
examples.hi: मैंने समय-सीमा के लिए रिमाइंडर लगाया।

examples.en: Thanks for reminding me.
examples.hi: याद दिलाने के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: Please remember me to send the file.
common_mistake.right: Please remind me to send the file.
common_mistake.why: 'remind' = make someone remember; 'remember' = keep in your own memory.

cloze.sentence: The app ____ you to drink water every hour.

en_def: having the duty to deal with something; being the cause of something; able to be trusted
hi_nuance: 'responsible for' + noun/-ing (duty or cause); 'responsible to' + person (report to). Indian English 'responsible person' ✓. Spelling: -ible, not -able.

examples.en: Who is responsible for backups?
examples.hi: बैकअप के लिए कौन ज़िम्मेदार है?

examples.en: The driver was responsible for the accident.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना के लिए ड्राइवर ज़िम्मेदार था।

examples.en: She's a responsible adult now.
examples.hi: वह अब एक ज़िम्मेदार वयस्क है।

examples.en: I'm responsible to the head of security.
examples.hi: मैं सुरक्षा प्रमुख के प्रति उत्तरदायी हूँ।

examples.en: Parents are responsible for their children's safety.
examples.hi: माता-पिता अपने बच्चों की सुरक्षा के लिए ज़िम्मेदार हैं।

examples.en: A phishing email was responsible for the breach.
examples.hi: एक फ़िशिंग ईमेल उल्लंघन के लिए ज़िम्मेदार था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am responsable for the servers.
common_mistake.right: I am responsible for the servers.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: respons-ible.

cloze.sentence: You'll be ____ for testing the new release.

en_def: to agree that something is true, often unwillingly; to allow someone to enter
hi_nuance: 'admit' + -ing or 'admit that'. Indian English 'admitted in hospital' → 'admitted to hospital'. 'Get admission' → 'be admitted' or 'get a place'.

examples.en: He admitted that he had forgotten the password.
examples.hi: उसने माना कि वह पासवर्ड भूल गया था।

examples.en: I admit I was wrong.
examples.hi: मैं मानता हूँ कि मैं गलत था।

examples.en: She admitted breaking the vase.
examples.hi: उसने गुलदान तोड़ने की बात स्वीकार की।

examples.en: He was admitted to hospital with chest pain.
examples.hi: सीने में दर्द के साथ उसे अस्पताल में भर्ती किया गया।

examples.en: The ticket admits two people.
examples.hi: इस टिकट से दो लोग अंदर जा सकते हैं।

examples.en: The company admitted to a data breach.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने डेटा उल्लंघन की बात स्वीकार की।

common_mistake.wrong: My father is admitted in the hospital.
common_mistake.right: My father has been admitted to hospital.
common_mistake.why: 'admitted to' + hospital, and the present perfect for a recent event.

cloze.sentence: She finally ____ that the report had errors.

en_def: to accept something as true without proof; to take on a role or responsibility
hi_def: मान लेना, समझ लेना; ग्रहण करना
hi_nuance: 'assume that' + clause. 'I assume so' = I suppose. Hindi speakers use 'think' — 'assume' implies you have no proof. Noun: 'assumption'.

examples.en: I assumed you'd already left.
examples.hi: मैंने मान लिया था कि तुम पहले ही जा चुके हो।

examples.en: Don't assume the network is safe.
examples.hi: यह मत मान लो कि नेटवर्क सुरक्षित है।

examples.en: Let's assume the meeting starts at ten.
examples.hi: मान लेते हैं कि बैठक दस बजे शुरू होगी।

examples.en: She assumed control of the project.
examples.hi: उसने प्रोजेक्ट का नियंत्रण संभाल लिया।

examples.en: We shouldn't make assumptions about users.
examples.hi: हमें उपयोगकर्ताओं के बारे में अनुमान नहीं लगाने चाहिए।

examples.en: I assume so, but I'll check.
examples.hi: मुझे तो ऐसा ही लगता है, पर मैं जाँच लूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I was assuming that you know it.
common_mistake.right: I assumed that you knew.
common_mistake.why: Use the simple past for a completed assumption, and match the tense in the clause.

cloze.sentence: Never ____ that a link in an email is safe.

en_def: to be grateful for something; to understand the value or difficulty of something
hi_nuance: 'I appreciate it' = thank you. 'Appreciate' + -ing or noun, never 'appreciate to'. Indian English 'appreciate your kind cooperation' is over-formal; 'thanks for your help' is fine.

examples.en: I really appreciate your help.
examples.hi: मैं आपकी मदद की सचमुच क़द्र करता हूँ।

examples.en: We'd appreciate a quick reply.
examples.hi: जल्दी जवाब मिले तो अच्छा रहेगा।

examples.en: She doesn't appreciate how hard I work.
examples.hi: वह नहीं समझती कि मैं कितनी मेहनत करता हूँ।

examples.en: I appreciate that you're busy, but this is urgent.
examples.hi: मैं समझता हूँ कि आप व्यस्त हैं, लेकिन यह ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Thanks for staying late; I appreciate it.
examples.hi: देर तक रुकने के लिए धन्यवाद; मैं इसकी क़द्र करता हूँ।

examples.en: Property in this area has appreciated in value.
examples.hi: इस इलाक़े में संपत्ति का मूल्य बढ़ा है।

common_mistake.wrong: I would appreciate to get your feedback.
common_mistake.right: I would appreciate your feedback.
common_mistake.why: 'appreciate' + noun or -ing, never 'to'.

cloze.sentence: I'd ____ it if you could send the file today.

en_def: a result of an action, often a bad one
hi_nuance: 'consequence of'; 'as a consequence' = as a result; 'face the consequences'. More formal than 'result'. Hindi 'अंजाम' captures the negative tone.

examples.en: Ignoring the warning had serious consequences.
examples.hi: चेतावनी को नज़रअंदाज़ करने के गंभीर परिणाम हुए।

examples.en: As a consequence of the strike, trains were cancelled.
examples.hi: हड़ताल के नतीजे में ट्रेनें रद्द हो गईं।

examples.en: You'll have to face the consequences.
examples.hi: तुम्हें अंजाम भुगतना पड़ेगा।

examples.en: One consequence of the breach was a fine.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन का एक परिणाम जुर्माना था।

examples.en: Think about the consequences before you act.
examples.hi: कुछ करने से पहले उसके नतीजों के बारे में सोचो।

examples.en: The delay had no real consequences.
examples.hi: देरी का कोई असली नतीजा नहीं हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: Because of this consequence, we lost data.
common_mistake.right: As a consequence, we lost data.
common_mistake.why: 'as a consequence' is the fixed phrase meaning 'as a result'.

cloze.sentence: Every decision has ____, so choose carefully.

en_def: to give money, ideas, or help to something shared; to be one of the causes
hi_nuance: 'contribute to' + noun; 'contribute something to'. Stress: con-TRIB-ute. Indian English 'contribute in' ✗. Noun: 'contribution'.

examples.en: Everyone contributed to the farewell gift.
examples.hi: सबने विदाई उपहार में योगदान दिया।

examples.en: Poor sleep contributed to his mistakes.
examples.hi: ख़राब नींद ने उसकी गलतियों में योगदान दिया।

examples.en: She contributes articles to a tech blog.
examples.hi: वह एक टेक ब्लॉग के लिए लेख लिखती है।

examples.en: Thank you for contributing to the discussion.
examples.hi: चर्चा में योगदान देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Several factors contributed to the outage.
examples.hi: कई कारकों ने ख़राबी में योगदान दिया।

examples.en: He made a big contribution to the project.
examples.hi: उसने प्रोजेक्ट में बड़ा योगदान दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to contribute in open-source projects.
common_mistake.right: I want to contribute to open-source projects.
common_mistake.why: 'contribute to' is the fixed preposition.

cloze.sentence: Stress can ____ to high blood pressure.

en_def: to say that something is not true; to refuse to give something
hi_def: इनकार करना, खंडन करना; मना करना
hi_nuance: 'deny' + -ing or 'deny that'. 'Deny' ≠ 'refuse': you deny an accusation, you refuse a request. Indian English 'denied to come' ✗ → 'refused to come'.

examples.en: He denied stealing the money.
examples.hi: उसने पैसे चुराने से इनकार किया।

examples.en: The company denies any wrongdoing.
examples.hi: कंपनी किसी भी गलत काम से इनकार करती है।

examples.en: She denied that she had seen the email.
examples.hi: उसने इनकार किया कि उसने ईमेल देखा था।

examples.en: They were denied entry to the club.
examples.hi: उन्हें क्लब में प्रवेश से वंचित कर दिया गया।

examples.en: There's no denying that prices have risen.
examples.hi: इससे इनकार नहीं किया जा सकता कि क़ीमतें बढ़ी हैं।

examples.en: Access was denied for the wrong password.
examples.hi: गलत पासवर्ड के कारण पहुँच अस्वीकृत कर दी गई।

common_mistake.wrong: He denied to attend the meeting.
common_mistake.right: He refused to attend the meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'deny' means 'say it is not true'; for 'say no to doing', use 'refuse'.

cloze.sentence: The minister ____ any involvement in the scandal.

en_def: without being affected by; in spite of
hi_nuance: 'despite' + noun/-ing, never 'despite of' (that's the most common error) and never 'despite' + clause. 'In spite of' means the same. For a clause, use 'although'.

examples.en: Despite the rain, the match went ahead.
examples.hi: बारिश के बावजूद मैच हुआ।

examples.en: She passed despite not studying much.
examples.hi: ज़्यादा न पढ़ने के बावजूद वह पास हो गई।

examples.en: Despite his age, he runs every morning.
examples.hi: अपनी उम्र के बावजूद वह हर सुबह दौड़ता है।

examples.en: The site stayed up despite the attack.
examples.hi: हमले के बावजूद साइट चलती रही।

examples.en: Despite everything, I still love this city.
examples.hi: सब कुछ के बावजूद मुझे यह शहर अब भी पसंद है।

examples.en: He came to work despite feeling ill.
examples.hi: बीमार महसूस करने के बावजूद वह काम पर आया।

common_mistake.wrong: Despite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
common_mistake.right: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
common_mistake.why: 'despite' is never followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: ____ the high price, the phone sold out in a day.

en_def: a sudden event causing great damage; a complete failure
hi_nuance: 'natural disaster' (flood, earthquake); informally 'the party was a disaster' = went very badly. Adjective: 'disastrous'. In IT: 'disaster recovery'.

examples.en: The flood was the worst disaster in decades.
examples.hi: यह बाढ़ दशकों की सबसे बड़ी आपदा थी।

examples.en: The presentation was a complete disaster.
examples.hi: प्रेज़ेंटेशन पूरी तरह विफल रहा।

examples.en: We have a disaster recovery plan.
examples.hi: हमारे पास आपदा से उबरने की योजना है।

examples.en: Cutting the safety budget is a recipe for disaster.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा बजट में कटौती आपदा को न्योता देना है।

examples.en: Earthquakes are natural disasters.
examples.hi: भूकंप प्राकृतिक आपदाएँ हैं।

examples.en: The launch was disastrous; nothing worked.
examples.hi: लॉन्च विनाशकारी रहा; कुछ भी काम नहीं किया।

common_mistake.wrong: The trip was very disaster.
common_mistake.right: The trip was a disaster.
common_mistake.why: 'disaster' is a noun; use 'a disaster' or the adjective 'disastrous'.

cloze.sentence: Without backups, a server failure would be a ____.

en_def: producing the result that is wanted; (of a rule) in operation
hi_nuance: 'effective' (works) vs 'efficient' (no waste). 'Effective from' + date (a rule starts). Hindi 'असरदार' = effective. Indian English 'with effect from' (w.e.f.) → 'effective from'.

examples.en: Is this medicine effective against fever?
examples.hi: क्या यह दवा बुख़ार के लिए असरदार है?

examples.en: The new policy is effective from 1 April.
examples.hi: नई नीति 1 अप्रैल से प्रभावी है।

examples.en: Practice is the most effective way to learn.
examples.hi: अभ्यास सीखने का सबसे कारगर तरीक़ा है।

examples.en: Two-factor login is highly effective.
examples.hi: टू-फ़ैक्टर लॉगिन बेहद प्रभावी है।

examples.en: She's a very effective communicator.
examples.hi: वह बहुत प्रभावी संवादक है।

examples.en: The ad was cheap but effective.
examples.hi: विज्ञापन सस्ता था लेकिन कारगर था।

common_mistake.wrong: The new rule is applicable w.e.f. Monday.
common_mistake.right: The new rule is effective from Monday.
common_mistake.why: 'w.e.f.' is Indian bureaucratic shorthand; use 'effective from'.

cloze.sentence: Short daily practice is more ____ than one long session a week.

en_def: annoyed because you cannot achieve what you want
hi_nuance: 'frustrated with/by' + noun; 'frustrating' for the thing. Indian English uses 'frustrated' for depression — in English it's about being blocked. 'I'm frustrated' ≠ 'I'm sad'.

examples.en: I'm frustrated with the slow internet.
examples.hi: धीमे इंटरनेट से मैं खीझ गया हूँ।

examples.en: It's frustrating when the app crashes.
examples.hi: ऐप के क्रैश होने पर खीझ होती है।

examples.en: She felt frustrated by the lack of progress.
examples.hi: प्रगति की कमी से वह हताश महसूस कर रही थी।

examples.en: Frustrated customers left bad reviews.
examples.hi: खीझे हुए ग्राहकों ने ख़राब समीक्षाएँ दीं।

examples.en: Don't get frustrated; learning takes time.
examples.hi: खीझो मत; सीखने में समय लगता है।

examples.en: His frustration showed in his voice.
examples.hi: उसकी खीझ उसकी आवाज़ में झलक रही थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very frustrating with this bug.
common_mistake.right: I am very frustrated with this bug.
common_mistake.why: '-ed' for the person's feeling, '-ing' for the cause.

cloze.sentence: He grew ____ after the third failed login attempt.

en_def: feeling or showing thanks
hi_nuance: 'grateful to' + person, 'grateful for' + thing. Spelled 'grateful', not 'greatful'. Indian English 'I shall be highly obliged' → 'I'd be grateful'.

examples.en: I'm grateful to my parents for their support.
examples.hi: मैं अपने माता-पिता का उनके सहयोग के लिए आभारी हूँ।

examples.en: We're grateful for your quick response.
examples.hi: आपके त्वरित जवाब के लिए हम आभारी हैं।

examples.en: I'd be grateful if you could check this.
examples.hi: अगर आप इसे जाँच लें तो मैं आभारी रहूँगा।

examples.en: She was grateful to be alive.
examples.hi: वह ज़िंदा होने के लिए कृतज्ञ थी।

examples.en: He sent a grateful message to the team.
examples.hi: उसने टीम को आभार भरा संदेश भेजा।

examples.en: Gratitude makes people happier.
examples.hi: कृतज्ञता लोगों को ज़्यादा ख़ुश बनाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I shall be highly obliged if you do the needful.
common_mistake.right: I'd be grateful if you could help with this.
common_mistake.why: 'highly obliged' and 'do the needful' are Indian formal English; this is the natural phrase.

cloze.sentence: I'm so ____ for everything you've done.

en_def: to promise that something will definitely happen or be true; (noun) a written promise to repair or replace
hi_nuance: Spelling: guar-an-tee. 'Guarantee that' or 'guarantee' + noun. Indian English 'warranty' vs 'guarantee' — both exist; a 'warranty' is the manufacturer's document.

examples.en: I can't guarantee we'll finish by Friday.
examples.hi: मैं गारंटी नहीं दे सकता कि हम शुक्रवार तक पूरा कर लेंगे।

examples.en: The phone comes with a two-year guarantee.
examples.hi: फ़ोन के साथ दो साल की गारंटी है।

examples.en: Practice doesn't guarantee success, but it helps.
examples.hi: अभ्यास सफलता की गारंटी नहीं देता, पर मदद करता है।

examples.en: The bank guaranteed the loan.
examples.hi: बैंक ने ऋण की गारंटी दी।

examples.en: There's no guarantee the patch will fix it.
examples.hi: इसकी कोई गारंटी नहीं कि पैच इसे ठीक कर देगा।

examples.en: We guarantee delivery within 24 hours.
examples.hi: हम 24 घंटे के भीतर डिलीवरी की गारंटी देते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This product has one year gaurantee.
common_mistake.right: This product has a one-year guarantee.
common_mistake.why: Spelling 'guarantee', and 'a one-year' with a hyphen.

cloze.sentence: Nobody can ____ that the system will never fail.

en_def: causing admiration because of size, skill, or quality
hi_nuance: 'impressive' (thing) vs 'impressed' (person). 'Impressed by/with'. Hindi speakers say 'I am impressive' to mean 'impressed'. 'Impressive' is a strong compliment.

examples.en: Her presentation was very impressive.
examples.hi: उसकी प्रेज़ेंटेशन बहुत प्रभावशाली थी।

examples.en: That's an impressive score for a first attempt.
examples.hi: पहली कोशिश के लिए यह शानदार स्कोर है।

examples.en: I was impressed by his knowledge of security.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा के बारे में उसकी जानकारी से मैं प्रभावित हुआ।

examples.en: The view from the top is impressive.
examples.hi: ऊपर से नज़ारा प्रभावशाली है।

examples.en: The team made impressive progress.
examples.hi: टीम ने प्रभावशाली प्रगति की।

examples.en: He has an impressive list of clients.
examples.hi: उसके पास ग्राहकों की प्रभावशाली सूची है।

common_mistake.wrong: I was very impressive with the hotel.
common_mistake.right: I was very impressed with the hotel.
common_mistake.why: 'impressed' = how you feel; 'impressive' = what the thing is.

cloze.sentence: The new stadium is an ____ piece of engineering.

en_def: probably going to happen or be true
hi_nuance: 'likely to' + verb; 'it is likely that'. Opposite: 'unlikely'. Hindi speakers use 'may be' for everything; 'likely' expresses higher probability. In reports: 'the most likely cause'.

examples.en: It's likely to rain this evening.
examples.hi: आज शाम बारिश होने की संभावना है।

examples.en: The most likely cause is a misconfigured firewall.
examples.hi: सबसे संभावित कारण गलत तरीक़े से सेट किया गया फ़ायरवॉल है।

examples.en: She's likely to get the job.
examples.hi: उसे नौकरी मिलने की संभावना है।

examples.en: It's unlikely that he'll change his mind.
examples.hi: इसकी संभावना कम है कि वह अपना मन बदलेगा।

examples.en: Prices will very likely rise again.
examples.hi: क़ीमतें बहुत संभव है फिर बढ़ेंगी।

examples.en: Which is more likely: a bug or an attack?
examples.hi: क्या ज़्यादा संभव है: बग या हमला?

common_mistake.wrong: May be the server is down.
common_mistake.right: The server is probably down.
common_mistake.why: 'may be' is a verb phrase; the adverb is 'maybe', and 'probably/likely' is clearer.

cloze.sentence: Users are more ____ to click a link that looks familiar.

en_def: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement
hi_def: बातचीत करना, मोल-भाव करना, समझौता वार्ता करना
hi_nuance: 'negotiate with' + person, 'negotiate' + deal/price. For markets, Indian English says 'bargain'; 'negotiate' is for salaries and contracts. Pronounced ne-GO-shee-ate.

examples.en: We negotiated a better price with the supplier.
examples.hi: हमने आपूर्तिकर्ता के साथ बेहतर क़ीमत पर बातचीत की।

examples.en: Always negotiate your salary.
examples.hi: अपने वेतन पर हमेशा बातचीत करो।

examples.en: The two countries are negotiating a trade deal.
examples.hi: दोनों देश एक व्यापार समझौते पर बातचीत कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: The price is not negotiable.
examples.hi: क़ीमत पर मोल-भाव नहीं होगा।

examples.en: She's good at negotiating with clients.
examples.hi: वह ग्राहकों के साथ बातचीत में अच्छी है।

examples.en: Negotiations broke down after two days.
examples.hi: दो दिन बाद बातचीत टूट गई।

common_mistake.wrong: I negotiated the vendor for a discount.
common_mistake.right: I negotiated a discount with the vendor.
common_mistake.why: 'negotiate' + the thing, 'with' + the person.

cloze.sentence: The union will ____ with management next week.

en_def: to get something, especially by effort or through a process (formal)
hi_nuance: Formal; in speech use 'get'. Common in reports: 'the attacker obtained credentials'. Indian English 'obtain marks' is fine in exam contexts. Don't say 'obtain to'.

examples.en: You must obtain permission before entering.
examples.hi: प्रवेश से पहले आपको अनुमति प्राप्त करनी होगी।

examples.en: The attacker obtained the admin password.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने एडमिन पासवर्ड हासिल कर लिया।

examples.en: She obtained a degree in computer science.
examples.hi: उसने कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में डिग्री प्राप्त की।

examples.en: Copies can be obtained from the office.
examples.hi: प्रतियाँ दफ़्तर से प्राप्त की जा सकती हैं।

examples.en: We obtained the data legally.
examples.hi: हमने डेटा क़ानूनी तरीक़े से प्राप्त किया।

examples.en: It's hard to obtain a visa at short notice.
examples.hi: कम समय में वीज़ा प्राप्त करना मुश्किल है।

common_mistake.wrong: Can you obtain me a coffee?
common_mistake.right: Can you get me a coffee?
common_mistake.why: 'obtain' is formal and for things gained through a process; use 'get' in daily speech.

cloze.sentence: The researcher ____ access by exploiting a weak password.

en_def: to change an event to a later time or date
hi_nuance: The opposite of Indian English 'prepone' (which does not exist in standard English — say 'bring forward'). 'Postpone until/to' + time; 'postpone' + -ing.

examples.en: The meeting has been postponed until Monday.
examples.hi: बैठक सोमवार तक स्थगित कर दी गई है।

examples.en: They postponed the wedding because of the storm.
examples.hi: तूफ़ान के कारण उन्होंने शादी टाल दी।

examples.en: Don't postpone applying the patch.
examples.hi: पैच लगाने को मत टालो।

examples.en: Can we postpone the call to three o'clock?
examples.hi: क्या हम कॉल को तीन बजे तक टाल सकते हैं?

examples.en: The launch was postponed twice.
examples.hi: लॉन्च दो बार स्थगित हुआ।

examples.en: I've postponed my trip until next month.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी यात्रा अगले महीने तक टाल दी है।

common_mistake.wrong: Can we prepone the meeting to Tuesday?
common_mistake.right: Can we bring the meeting forward to Tuesday?
common_mistake.why: 'prepone' is Indian English only; the standard phrase is 'bring forward'.

cloze.sentence: The exam was ____ because the papers hadn't arrived.

en_def: something that is more important than other things and should be dealt with first
hi_nuance: 'top/high/low priority', 'give priority to', 'make something a priority'. Indian English 'on priority' ✗ → 'as a priority' or 'urgently'. Verb: 'prioritise'.

examples.en: Security is our top priority.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा हमारी सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता है।

examples.en: Fixing the login bug is a high priority.
examples.hi: लॉगिन बग ठीक करना उच्च प्राथमिकता है।

examples.en: You need to sort out your priorities.
examples.hi: तुम्हें अपनी प्राथमिकताएँ तय करनी होंगी।

examples.en: We give priority to critical alerts.
examples.hi: हम गंभीर अलर्ट को प्राथमिकता देते हैं।

examples.en: Make your health a priority.
examples.hi: अपनी सेहत को प्राथमिकता दो।

examples.en: Let's prioritise the tasks for this sprint.
examples.hi: चलो इस स्प्रिंट के कामों को प्राथमिकता के हिसाब से लगाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do this on priority.
common_mistake.right: Please treat this as a priority.
common_mistake.why: 'on priority' is Indian English; say 'as a priority' or 'urgently'.

cloze.sentence: Patching the critical vulnerability is our first ____.

en_def: to become well again after illness; to get back something lost; to return to a normal state
hi_nuance: 'recover from' + illness/shock; 'recover' + lost thing (recover the data). Noun: 'recovery'. Indian English 'he is recovering' ✓. Not 'recover back'.

examples.en: She's recovering from surgery.
examples.hi: वह सर्जरी से उबर रही है।

examples.en: We managed to recover the deleted files.
examples.hi: हम मिटाई गई फ़ाइलें वापस पाने में कामयाब रहे।

examples.en: The economy is slowly recovering.
examples.hi: अर्थव्यवस्था धीरे-धीरे उबर रही है।

examples.en: It took him weeks to recover from the shock.
examples.hi: सदमे से उबरने में उसे हफ़्तों लगे।

examples.en: Police recovered the stolen laptop.
examples.hi: पुलिस ने चोरी हुआ लैपटॉप बरामद कर लिया।

examples.en: The system recovered after a restart.
examples.hi: रीस्टार्ट के बाद सिस्टम फिर से ठीक हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: We recovered back the lost data.
common_mistake.right: We recovered the lost data.
common_mistake.why: 'recover' already means 'get back'; 'back' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: It can take months to fully ____ from a serious injury.

en_def: to feel sorry about something you did or did not do
hi_nuance: 'regret' + -ing (past action) or 'regret to' + verb (formal bad news: 'we regret to inform you'). Hindi speakers say 'I am regretting' — use the simple form.

examples.en: I regret not learning English earlier.
examples.hi: मुझे अफ़सोस है कि मैंने अंग्रेज़ी पहले नहीं सीखी।

examples.en: You'll regret it if you don't back up your files.
examples.hi: अगर तुमने फ़ाइलों का बैकअप नहीं लिया तो पछताओगे।

examples.en: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
examples.hi: हमें यह बताते हुए खेद है कि आपका आवेदन सफल नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: She regrets leaving her old job.
examples.hi: उसे अपनी पुरानी नौकरी छोड़ने का पछतावा है।

examples.en: I have no regrets.
examples.hi: मुझे कोई पछतावा नहीं है।

examples.en: He deeply regretted his angry words.
examples.hi: उसे अपने गुस्से भरे शब्दों पर गहरा पछतावा हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am regretting for my decision.
common_mistake.right: I regret my decision.
common_mistake.why: 'regret' is a state verb; no continuous form and no 'for'.

cloze.sentence: He ____ shouting at his colleague as soon as he'd done it.

en_def: closely connected to the subject being discussed
hi_nuance: 'relevant to' + noun. Spelled 'relevant', not 'relevent'. Indian English uses 'related' where 'relevant' is more precise. Opposite: 'irrelevant'.

examples.en: Is this information relevant to the case?
examples.hi: क्या यह जानकारी मामले के लिए प्रासंगिक है?

examples.en: Only include relevant experience on your CV.
examples.hi: अपने सीवी में केवल प्रासंगिक अनुभव शामिल करें।

examples.en: That point isn't relevant here.
examples.hi: वह बात यहाँ प्रासंगिक नहीं है।

examples.en: Please attach all relevant documents.
examples.hi: कृपया सभी संबंधित दस्तावेज़ संलग्न करें।

examples.en: The article is still relevant today.
examples.hi: यह लेख आज भी प्रासंगिक है।

examples.en: His comment was completely irrelevant.
examples.hi: उसकी टिप्पणी पूरी तरह अप्रासंगिक थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please share the related logs for this issue.
common_mistake.right: Please share the relevant logs for this issue.
common_mistake.why: 'relevant' = directly connected to the matter; 'related' is looser.

cloze.sentence: Skip the history and get to the ____ part.

en_def: large or important enough to have an effect or be noticed
hi_nuance: Common in reports: 'a significant increase/risk'. 'Significantly' = by a large amount. Hindi speakers overuse 'important'; 'significant' adds the idea of measurable size.

examples.en: There has been a significant rise in phishing attacks.
examples.hi: फ़िशिंग हमलों में उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि हुई है।

examples.en: It's a small but significant change.
examples.hi: यह एक छोटा लेकिन महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव है।

examples.en: The new engine is significantly faster.
examples.hi: नया इंजन काफ़ी ज़्यादा तेज़ है।

examples.en: She played a significant role in the project.
examples.hi: उसने प्रोजेक्ट में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

examples.en: The results were not statistically significant.
examples.hi: नतीजे सांख्यिकीय रूप से महत्वपूर्ण नहीं थे।

examples.en: This is a significant security risk.
examples.hi: यह एक महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा जोखिम है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a big-big difference between the two.
common_mistake.right: There is a significant difference between the two.
common_mistake.why: Repeating adjectives for emphasis is a Hindi pattern; use 'significant' or 'huge'.

cloze.sentence: The update made a ____ improvement to battery life.

en_def: to try very hard to do something difficult; to fight
hi_nuance: 'struggle to' + verb; 'struggle with' + noun. Indian English 'I am struggling for a job' ✓. The noun 'struggle' is also used for independence movements.

examples.en: I'm struggling to understand this code.
examples.hi: मैं इस कोड को समझने में जूझ रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Many students struggle with grammar.
examples.hi: कई छात्र व्याकरण से जूझते हैं।

examples.en: The company is struggling to pay its staff.
examples.hi: कंपनी अपने कर्मचारियों को वेतन देने के लिए संघर्ष कर रही है।

examples.en: He struggled to his feet after the fall.
examples.hi: गिरने के बाद वह मुश्किल से खड़ा हुआ।

examples.en: It was a long struggle, but we won.
examples.hi: यह एक लंबा संघर्ष था, लेकिन हम जीते।

examples.en: The server struggles when traffic spikes.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक बढ़ने पर सर्वर जूझने लगता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am struggling in English speaking.
common_mistake.right: I struggle with speaking English.
common_mistake.why: 'struggle with' + noun/-ing; 'English speaking' is Hindi word order.

cloze.sentence: New employees often ____ to remember everyone's name.

en_def: to experience something bad, such as pain, illness, or loss
hi_nuance: 'suffer from' + illness (long-term); 'suffer' + loss/damage/injury (no preposition). Indian English 'suffering from fever' is fine; 'suffer with' ✗.

examples.en: He suffers from asthma.
examples.hi: वह दमे से पीड़ित है।

examples.en: The company suffered heavy losses last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल कंपनी को भारी नुक़सान हुआ।

examples.en: Many people suffered in the heatwave.
examples.hi: लू में कई लोग परेशान हुए।

examples.en: Your work will suffer if you don't sleep.
examples.hi: अगर तुम नहीं सोए तो तुम्हारा काम प्रभावित होगा।

examples.en: She suffered a minor injury.
examples.hi: उसे मामूली चोट आई।

examples.en: The website suffered a major outage.
examples.hi: वेबसाइट में बड़ी ख़राबी आई।

common_mistake.wrong: I am suffering with headache since morning.
common_mistake.right: I've had a headache since this morning.
common_mistake.why: 'suffer with' is wrong, and 'since' needs the present perfect; also 'a headache'.

cloze.sentence: The region ____ badly during the drought.

en_def: right or acceptable for a particular purpose or situation
hi_nuance: 'suitable for' + purpose/person. Indian English 'suitable time as per your convenience' → 'a time that suits you'. The verb 'suit' takes a direct object: 'Monday suits me'.

examples.en: This film isn't suitable for young children.
examples.hi: यह फ़िल्म छोटे बच्चों के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है।

examples.en: Is Tuesday suitable for you?
examples.hi: क्या मंगलवार आपके लिए ठीक रहेगा?

examples.en: We're looking for a suitable candidate.
examples.hi: हम एक उपयुक्त उम्मीदवार की तलाश में हैं।

examples.en: These shoes aren't suitable for hiking.
examples.hi: ये जूते ट्रेकिंग के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

examples.en: Choose a password of suitable length.
examples.hi: उपयुक्त लंबाई का पासवर्ड चुनें।

examples.en: The flat is suitable for a small family.
examples.hi: यह फ़्लैट एक छोटे परिवार के लिए उपयुक्त है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please suggest a suitable time as per your convenience.
common_mistake.right: Please suggest a time that suits you.
common_mistake.why: 'as per your convenience' is Indian English; 'suits you' is natural.

cloze.sentence: The room is ____ for meetings of up to ten people.

en_def: lasting only for a limited time
hi_nuance: Pronounced TEM-pruh-ree (three syllables in British English). Opposite: 'permanent'. Indian English 'temporary basis' → 'temporarily' or 'on a temporary basis' (formal).

examples.en: It's only a temporary fix; we need a proper solution.
examples.hi: यह सिर्फ़ अस्थायी समाधान है; हमें पक्का हल चाहिए।

examples.en: She has a temporary job at the hospital.
examples.hi: उसकी अस्पताल में अस्थायी नौकरी है।

examples.en: The road is temporarily closed.
examples.hi: सड़क अस्थायी रूप से बंद है।

examples.en: The pain is temporary; it'll pass.
examples.hi: दर्द अस्थायी है; यह चला जाएगा।

examples.en: A temporary password was sent to your email.
examples.hi: एक अस्थायी पासवर्ड आपके ईमेल पर भेजा गया है।

examples.en: The service is temporarily unavailable.
examples.hi: सेवा अस्थायी रूप से अनुपलब्ध है।

common_mistake.wrong: We have blocked the IP on temporary basis.
common_mistake.right: We have temporarily blocked the IP.
common_mistake.why: 'on temporary basis' is Indian English; use the adverb 'temporarily'.

cloze.sentence: The pop-up shop is ____ and closes next month.

en_def: needing attention or action immediately
hi_nuance: 'urgent' = must be done now; 'important' = matters a lot. Indian English marks everything 'URGENT' — reserve it. Adverb: 'urgently'. Noun: 'urgency'.

examples.en: I have an urgent message for the manager.
examples.hi: मेरे पास मैनेजर के लिए एक ज़रूरी संदेश है।

examples.en: This bug needs urgent attention.
examples.hi: इस बग पर तत्काल ध्यान देने की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: Is it urgent, or can it wait until Monday?
examples.hi: क्या यह अत्यावश्यक है, या सोमवार तक इंतज़ार कर सकता है?

examples.en: We urgently need more staff.
examples.hi: हमें तत्काल और कर्मचारियों की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: There's no urgency; take your time.
examples.hi: कोई जल्दी नहीं है; आराम से करो।

examples.en: The patient needs urgent surgery.
examples.hi: मरीज़ को तत्काल सर्जरी की ज़रूरत है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly treat this as most urgent and revert.
common_mistake.right: This is urgent. Please reply as soon as you can.
common_mistake.why: 'most urgent' and 'revert' are Indian English; state the urgency plainly.

cloze.sentence: The doctor said the operation was ____ and could not wait.

en_def: to tell someone about a possible danger or problem
hi_nuance: 'warn someone about/of' + noun; 'warn someone not to' + verb; 'warn that'. Pronounced /wɔːn/ (rhymes with 'born'), not 'warn' like 'barn'. Noun: 'warning'.

examples.en: I warned you not to click that link.
examples.hi: मैंने तुम्हें उस लिंक पर क्लिक न करने की चेतावनी दी थी।

examples.en: The doctor warned him about the risks of smoking.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसे धूम्रपान के ख़तरों के बारे में चेताया।

examples.en: They were warned that the road was flooded.
examples.hi: उन्हें चेतावनी दी गई थी कि सड़क पर बाढ़ है।

examples.en: The system warns you if your password is weak.
examples.hi: अगर आपका पासवर्ड कमज़ोर है तो सिस्टम चेतावनी देता है।

examples.en: Consider yourself warned.
examples.hi: समझ लो कि तुम्हें चेतावनी दी जा चुकी है।

examples.en: The forecast warns of heavy rain tonight.
examples.hi: पूर्वानुमान आज रात भारी बारिश की चेतावनी देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He warned me for not going there.
common_mistake.right: He warned me not to go there.
common_mistake.why: 'warn someone not to' + verb; 'for' is not used.

cloze.sentence: The antivirus ____ me that the file was unsafe.
